rnams dang / 'od chung ba rnams dang / tshad med 'od pa rnams dang /'od gsal ba rnams dang / dge chung ba rnams dang / tshad med dge rnams dang / dge rgyas pa rnams dang / sprin med pa rnams dang / bsod nams skyes pa rnams dang / 'bras bu che ba rnams dang / mi che ba rnams dang /mi gdung ba rnams dang / gya nom snang ba rnams dang / shin tu mthong ba rnams dang / 'og min kyi lha rnams kyang de gos gyon bzhin du skye'o/ /byang gi sgra mi snyan gyi mi rnams kyi dpag bsam shing las byung ba'i gos kyang 1rnam pa bzhi ste/ sngon po dang / ser po dang / dmar po dang / dkar po rnams so—/ / gzhan gos kyang 1rnam pa bzhi ste/ sngon po dang / ser po dang /dmar po dang / dkar po rnams so/ /dpag bsam shing las byung ba'i gos kyang rnam pa bzhi ste/ sngon po dang / ser po dang / dmar po dang /dkar po rnams te1 / dpag bsam shing las byung ba'i gos ji lta bu 'dod pa de lta bu skyes pa'am/ bud med dag gis ④sems bskyed ma thag tu de la yal ga 'dud par byed do/ /rgyal chen bzhi'i lha rnams kyi dpag bsam shing las byung ba'i gos kyi shing rnams kyang rnam pa bzhi ste/ sngon po dang / ser bo dang /dmar po dang / dkar po rnams dang / gzhan byegos kyang rnam pa bzhi ste/sngon po dang / ser po dang / dmar po dang / dkar po rnams so/ /dpag bsam gyi pya shing las byung ba'i gos kyang rnam pa bzhi ste/ sngon po dang /ser po dang / dmar po dang / dkar po rnams te/ dpag bsam shing las byung ba'i gos ji lta bu 'dod pa de lta bu lha'i bu'am/ lha'i bu mo dag gis tsu sems bskyed ma thag tu yal ga 'dud blupar byed dobye/ /de'i lag tu 'ong bar 78—6 47

'gyur ro/ /rgyal chen bzhi pa rnams kyi ji lta ba bzhin du sum cu rtsa gsum pa dang / 'thab bral ba rnams dang / dga' ldan pa rnams dang / 'phrul dga' ba rnams dang / gzhan 'phrul dbang byed pa rnams kyi yang de bzhin no/ /tshangs ris kyi lha rnams la ni dpag bsam shing las byung ba'i gos med do/ /de yan chad la yang med do/ /ji ltar 'dzam bu'i gling gi mi rnams la gding ba dang / bgo ba lci ba dang / yang ba yod pa bzhin du shar gye lus 'phags po hu rnams dang / nub kyi ba lang spyod pa rnams la yang yod do/ /byang gi sgra mi snyan pa rnams kyi dpag bsam gyi zhushing las byung ba'i gos la ni ①srang gcig yod do/ /rgyal chen bzhi'i lha rnams kyi ni srang phyed do/ /sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha rnams kyi ni srang gi bzhi cha gcig go/ /'thab bral ba rnams kyi ni srang gang gi brgyad cha gcig go/ /dga' ldan pa rnams kyi ni srang gi bcu drug cha gcig go/ /'phrul dga' ba rnams kyi ni ④sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi srang gi cha gcig go / /gzhan 'phrul dbang byed pa rnams kyi dpag bsam gyi shing las byung ba'i gos ni srang gi drug cu rtsa bzhi'i cha gcig las med do/ /tshangs ris kyi lha rnams kyi ni gzhal du med pa'i gos yin no/ /tshangs ris pa rnams kyi ji lta ba bzhin du tshangs pa'i mdun tren 'don pa rnams dang / tshangs pa chen po pa rnams dang / 'od chung ba rnams dang / tshad med 'od pa rnams dang /'od gsal ba rnams dang / dge chung ba rnams dang / tshad med dge ba rnams dang / dge rgyas pa rnams dang / sprin med pa rnams dang / bsod nams skyes pa rnams dang / 'bras bu che ba rnams dang / mi che ba rnams dang / mi gdung ba rnams dang / gya nom snang ba rnams dang / shin tu 78—648

mthong ba rnams dang / 'og min gyi stilha rnams kyi yang gzhal du med pa'i gos yin no/ /nyi zer gyi rdul bzhi bcu rtsa dgu'i cha gcig ni rdul phra rab yin no/ /rdul phra rab bdun ni rdul phra mo gcig go/ /rdul phra mo bdun la ni nyi zer gyi rdul gcig go/ /nyi zer kyi rdul bdun la ni ri bong gi rdul gcig go/ /ri bong gi rdul bdun la ni lug rdul gcig go/ /lug rdul bdun la ni glang rdul gcig go/ /glang rdul bdun la ni sro ma gcig go/ /sro ma bdun la ni a ba ga na gcig go/ /a ba ga na bdun gel ni ba nyi ka gcig go/ /ba ti ka bdun la ni nas 'bru gcig go/ /nas 'bru bdun la ni sor gcig go/ /sor nyi shu rtsa bzhi la ni khru gang ngo / /'dzam bu'i gling gi mi rnams kha cig ni khru tshad de ltar brtsis pa'i khru phyed dang bzhi pa'o/ /kha cig ni khru bzhi pa'o/ /shar gyi lus 'phags po zhu rnams ni khru brgyad pa'o/ /nub kyi ba lang spyod pa rnams ni khru bcu drug pa'o/ /byang gi sgra mi snyan gye mi rnams ni khru sum cu rtsa gnyis pa'o/ /rgyal chen bzhi'i lha rnams kyi lus thob pa ni rgyang grags kyi bzhi cha gcig go/ /sum cu rtsa gsum pa rnams kyi ni rgyang grags kyi phyed do/ /'thab bral ba rnams kyi ni rgyang grags kyi bzhi cha gsum pa'orape/ /dga' ldan pa rnams kyi ni rgyang grags gcig go/ /'phrul dga' ba rnams kyi ni 3rgyang grags gcig dang / rgyang grags kyi bzhi cha gcig go/ /gzhan 'phrul dbang byed rnams kyi ni rgyang grags phyed dang gnyis so/ /tshangs ris pa rnams kyi ni dpag tshad phyed do—/ /tshangs pa mdun na 'don pa rnams kyi ni dpag tshad gcig go/ /tshangs pa chen po pa rnams kyi ni dpag tshad phyed dang gnyis so/ /'od chung ba rnams kyi ni dpag tshad gnyis so/ /tshad med 'od pa rnams kyi ni dpag tshad 78—619

bzhi'o / /'od gsal ba rnams kyi ni dpag tshad brgyad do/ /dge chung ba rnams kyi ni dpag tshad bcu drug go/ /tshad med dge ba rnams kyi ni dpag tshad sum cu rtsa gnyis so/ /dge rgyas pa rnams kyi ni dpag tshad drug cu rtsa bzhi'o/ /sprin med pa rnams kyi ni dpag tshad brgya nyi shu rtsa bzhi'o①/ /bsod nams skyes pa rnams kyi ni dpag tshad nyis brgya lnga bcu'o/ /'bras bu che ba'i lha rnams kyi ni dpag tshad lnga brgya'o/ /'du shes med pa'i sems can rnams kyi yang de dang 'dra'o / /mi che ba'i lus thob pa ni dpag tshad stong ngo / /mi gdung ba rnams kyi ni rudapag tshad nyis stong ngo / /gya nom snang ba rnams kyi ni dpag tshad bzhi stong ngo / /shin tu mthong ba pa rnams kyi ni dpag tshad brgyad stong ngo / /'og min gyi lha rnams kyi lus thob pa rnams kyi ni dpag tshad khri drug stong ngo / /gzugs med pa rnams la ni bsags pa'i lus med do/ /nyi zer gyi rdul bzhi bcu rtsa dgu'i cha gcig gi ni rdul phra rab yin no/ /rdul phra rab bdun la ni rdul phra mo gcig go/ /rdul phra mo bdun la ni nyi zer kyi rdul gcig go/ /nyi zer gye rdul bdun la ni ri bong gi rdul gcig go/ /ri bong gi rdul bdun la ni lug rdul gcig go/ /lug rdul bdun la ni glang rdul gcig go/ /glang rdul bdun la ni sro ma gcig go/ /sro ma bdun la ni a ba ga na gcig go/ /a ba ga na bdun la ni ba ti ka gcig go/ /ba ti ka bdun la ni nas 'bru gcig go/ /nas 'bru bdun la ni sor gcig go/ /sor nyi shu rtsa bzhi la khru gang ngo / /'dzam bu'i gling gi mi rnams kha cig gos khru tshad 'di lta bur brtsis pa'i khru brgyad pa gyon no/ /kha cig ni khru bcu pa'o/ /shar rmi lus 'phags pa rnams kyi ni 1 khru nyi shu pa'o/ /nub kyi ba lang spyod pa rnams kyi ni khru bzhi bcu pa'o/ /byang gi 78—650

sgra mi snyan pa rnams kyi ni dpag bsam shing las byung ba'i gos khru brgyad cu pa 2gyon no/ /rgyal chen bzhi pa'i lha rnams kyang lus la ci ran pa'i gos gyon no/ /rgyal chen bzhi pa khyolha rnams kyi ji lta ba bzhin du sum cu rtsa gsum pa rnams dang /'thab bral ba rnams dang / dga' ldan pa rnams dang / 'phrul dga' ba rnams dang / gzhan 'phrul dbang byed pa rnams dang / tshangs ris pa rnams dang / tshangs pa'i mdun na 'don pa rnams dang / tshangs pa chen po pa rnams dang / 'od chung ba rnams dang / tshad med 'od pa rnams dang /'od gsal ba rnams dang / dge chung ba rnams dang / tshad med dge ba rnams dang / dge rgyas pa rnams dang / sprin med pa rnams dang / bsod nams skyes pa rnams dang / 'bras bu che ba rnams dang / mi che ba rnams dang / mi gdung ba rnams dang / gya nom snang ba rnams dang / shin tu mthong ba rnams dang / 'og min pa rnams kyi yang de bzhin no/ /ji ltar 'dzam bu'i gling gi mi rnams dbang po tha dad do/ /kha cig la ni mo'i dbang po dang / kha cig la ni pho'i dbang po yod pa bzhin du shar gyi lus 'phags pa rnams dang / nub kyi ba lang spyod pa rnams dang / byang gi sgra mi snyan pa rnams dang / rgyal chen bzhi pa'i lha rnams dang / sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha rnams dang / 'thab bral ba rnams dang / dga' ldan pa rnams /1dang /'phrul dga' ba rnams dang / gzhan 'phrul dbang byed pa rnams la yang yang 4 yod do/ /tshangs ris kyi lha ⑤rnams la ni mo'i darbeng po yang med6 / pho'i dbang po yang med do/ /tshangs ris pa rnams ji lta ba bzhin du tshangs pa'i mdun na 'don pa rnams dang / tshangs pa chen po rnams dang / 'od chung 78—651

ba rnams dang / tshad med 'od pa rnams dang / 'od gsal ba rnams dang /dge chung ba rnams dang / tshad med dge ba rnams dang / dge rgyas pa rnams dang / sprin med pa rnams dang / bsod nams skyes pa rnams dang /'bras bu che ba rnams dang / mi che ba rnams dang / mi gdung ba rnams dang /gya nom snang 3ba rnams dang / shin tu mthong ba rnams dang / 'og min gye lha rnams kyang de bzhin no/ /ji ltar 'dzam bu'i gling gi mi rnams la bag ma gtong ba dang / bag ma len pa yod pa bzhin du shar gyi lus 'phags pa rnams dang /nub kyi ba lang spyod pa rnams la yang yod rngudo/ /byang gi sgra mi snyan pa tsarnams la ni med do/ /rgyal chen bzhi pa'i lha rnams dang / sum cu rtsa gsum pa rnams dang / 'thab bral ba rnams dang / dga' ldan pa rnams dang /'phrul dga' ba rnams dang / gzhan 'phrul dbang byed pa rnams la yang yod do/ /tshangs ris kyi lha rnams la ni bag ma gtong ba yang med len pa yang med do/ /tshangs ris kyi lha rnams la ji lta ba bzhin du tshangs pa'i mdun na 'don pa rnams dang / tshangs pa chen po pa rnams dang / 'od chung ba rnams dang / tshad med 'od pa rnams dang / 'od gsal ba rnams dang / dge chung ba rnams dang / tshad med dge zirnams dang / dge rgyas pa rnams dang / sprin med pa rnams dang / bsod nams skyes pa rnams dang / 'bras bu che ba rnams dang / mi che ba rnams dang / mi gdung ba rnams dang / gya nom snang ba rnams dang / shin tu mthong ba rnams dang / 'og min gyi lha rnams la yang de bzhin no/ /'jig rten gzhag pa las tshig byebazhi pa'o // //hūṃ78—652

'jig rten gzhag pa/ stibam po gnyis pa/ mdo la/ grang dang tsha dang dus tshigs mtshan mo dang / /pha ma dang ni rje khol dang / /nor dang 'bru dang mngon par zhen/ /bcu tshan yongs su brjod pa yin/ /ji ltar 'dzam bu'i gling gi mi rnams la shin tu grang ba dang / shin tu tsha ba yod pa bzhin du shar gyi lus 'phags pa rnams dang / nub kyi ba lang spyod pa rnams la yang yod do—/ /byang gi sgra mi snyan pa rnams la ni med do/ /rgyal chen bzhi'i lha rnams la yang med do/ /de yan chad la yang med do/ /ji ltar 'dzam bu'i gling gi mi rnams la dus tshigs 'di lta ste/ dgun dang dpyid dang dbyar yod pa bzhin du shar gyi lus 'phags pa rnams dang / nub kyi ba lang spyod pa rnams dang /byang gi sgra mi snyan pa rnams dang / rgyal chen bzhi'i lha rnams dang / sum cu rtsa gsum pa rnams dang / 'thab bral ba rnams dang / dga' ldan pa rnams dang / 'phrul dga' ba rnams dang / gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyi lha rnams la yang yod do/ /tshangs ris kyi lha rnams la ni dus tshigs med do/ /tshangs ris kyi lha rnams la ji lta ba bzhin du tshangs pa'i mdun na 'don pa rnams dang /tshangs pa chen po rnams dang / 'od chung ba rnams dang / tshad med 'od pa rnams dang / 'od gsal ba rnams dang / dge chung ba rnams dang / tshad med dge ba rnams dang / dge rgyas pa rnams dang / sprin med pa rnams dang /bsod nams skyes pa rnams dang / 'bras bu che ba rnams dang / mi che ba rnams dang / mi gdung ba rnams dang / gya nom snang ba rnams dang / shin tu mthong ba rnams dang / 'og min gyi lha rnams la yang de bzhin no/ /ji ltar 'dzam bu'i gling gi mi rnams la mtshan mo dang / nyin mo yod pa bzhin du 78—653

—shar gyi lus 'phags pa rnams dang / nub kyi ba lang spyod pa rnams dang /byang gi sgra mi snyan pa rnams dang / rgyal chen bzhi'i lha rnams ①dang / sum cu rtsa gsum pa rnams dang / 'thab bral ba rnams dang / dga' ldan pa rnams dang / 'phrul dga' ba rnams dang / gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyi lha rnams la ṭayang yod do/ /tshangs ris kyi lha rnams la ni mtshan mo yang med/ nyin mo yang med / tshangs ris pa rnams ji lta ba bzhin du tshangs pa'i mdun na 'dan dang / tshangs pa chen po pa rnams dang / 'od chung ba rnams dang /tshad med 'od nga/ rnams dang / 'od gsal ba rnams dang / dge chung ba rnams dang / tshad med dge ba rnams dang / dge rgyas pa rnams dang /sprin med pa rnams dang / bsod nams skyes pa rnams dang / 'bras bu che ba rnams dang / mi che ba rnams dang / mi gdung ba rnams dang / gya nom snang ba rnams dang / shin tu mthong ba rnams dang / 'og min gyi lha rnams la yang de bzhin no/ /ji lta ba sni'adzam bu'i gling gi mi rnams la pha dang ma yod pa bzhin du shar gyi lus 'phags pa rnams dang / nub kyi ba lang spyod pa rnams dang / byang gi sgra mi snyan pa rnams dang / rgyal chen bzhi'i lha rnams dang /sum cu rtsa gsum pa rnams dang / 'thab bral ba rnams dang / dga' ldan pa rnams dang / 'phrul dga' ba rnams dang / gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyi lha rnams la yang yod do/ /tshangs ris pa 6lha rnams la ni ma yang med pha yang med do/ /tshangs ris kyi lha rnams ji lta ba bzhin du tshangs pa'i mdun na 'don pa rnams dang / tshangs pa chen po pa rnams dang / 'od chung ba rnams dang /tshad med 'od pa rnams dang / 'od gsal ba rnams dang / dge chung ba 78—654

rnams dang / tshad med dge ba rnams dang / dge rgyas pa rnams dang /sprin med pa rnams dang / bsod nams skyes pa rnams dang / 'bras bu che ba rnams dang / mi che ba rnams dang / mi gdung ba rnams dang / gya nom snang ba rnams dang / shin tu mthong ba rnams dang / 'og min gyi lha rnams la yang de bzhin no/ /ji ltar 'dzam bu'i gling gi mi rnams la rje bo dang bran yod pa bzhin du shar gyi lus 'phags pa rnams dang / nub kyi ba lang spyod pa rnams la zhuyod do/ /byang gi sgra mi snyan pa rnams la ni rje bo yang med 27bran kyang med do/ /rgyal chen bzhi'i lha rnams la ni rje bo dang bran kyang yod do/ /rgyal chen bzhi'i lha rnams ji lta ba bzhin du sum cu rtsa gsum pa rnams dang /'thab bral ba rnams dang / dga' ldan pa rnams dang / 'phrul dga' ba rnams dang / gzhan 'phrul dbang byed pa rnams la yang de bzhin no/ /tshangs ris kyi lha rnams la ni rje bo yang med bran yang med do/ /tshangs ris pa rnams la ji lta ba bzhin du tshangs pa'i mdun na 'don pa rnams dang / tshangs pa chen po pa rnams dang / 'od chung ba rnams dang / tshad med 'od pa rnams dang / 'od gsal ba rnams dang / dge chung ba rnams dang / tshad med dge ba rnams dang / dge rgyas pa rnams dang / sprin med pa rnams dang /bsod nams skyes pa rnams dang / 'bras bu che ba rnams dang / mi che ba rnams dang / mi gdung ba rnams dang / gya nom snang ba rnams dang / shin tu mthong ba rnams dang / 'og min gyi lha rnams la yang de bzhin no/ /ji ltar 'dzam bu'i gling gi mi rnams la nor dang 'bru yod pa bzhin du shar gyi lus 'phags pa rnams dang / nub kyi ba lang spyod pa rnams la yang yod do/ /78—655

byang gi sgra mi snyan gyi mi rnams la ni 'bru ni yod/ nor ni med do/ /rgyal chen bzhi'i lha rnams la /1nor ni yod zu'abru ni med do/ /rgyal chen bzhi'i lha rnams ji lta ba bzhin du sum cu rtsa gsum pa rnams dang / 'thab bral ba rnams dang /dga' ldan pa rnams dang / 'phrul dga' ba rnams dang / gzhan 'phrul dbang byed pa rnams la yang de bzhin no/ /tshangs ris kyi lha rnams la ni nor yang med 'bru yang med do/ /tshangs ris kyi lha ji lta ba bzhin du tshangs pa mdun na 'don pa rnams dang / tshangs pa chen po pa rnams dang / 'od chung ba rnams dang / tshad med 'od pa rnams dang / 'od gsal ba rnams dang /dge chung ba rnams dang / tshad med dge ba rnams dang / dge rgyas pa rnams dang / sprin med pa rnams dang / bsod nams skyes pa rnams dang /'bras bu che ba rnams dang / mi che ba rnams dang / mi gdung ba rnams dang /gya nom snang ba rnams dang / shin tu mthong ba rnams dang / 'og min gyi lha rnams la yang de bzhin no/ /ji ltar 'dzam bu'i gling gi mi rnams la pha'am ma'am / bu pho'am bu mo 'am/ rje bo'am/ bran nam/ nor ram/ 'bru la mngon nga/ra zhen pa yod pa bzhin du shar kyi lus 'phags pa rnams dang / nub kyi ba lang spyod pa rnams la — yod do/ /byang gi sgra mi snyan kyi mi rnams la ni ci la yang mngon par zhen pa med do/ /rgyal chen bzhi'i lha rnams la ni 'bru ma gtogs pa rnams la mngon par zhen pa yod do/ /rgyal chen bzhi'i lha rnams ji lta ba bzhin du sum cu rtsa gsum pa rnams dang / 'thab bral ba rnams dang / dga' ldan pa rnams dang / 'phrul dga' ba rnams dang / gzhan 'phrul dbang byed pa rnams kyi yang de bzhin no/ /tshangs ris kyi lha rnams la yang mngon par zhen pa 78—656

med do/ /tshangs ris pa rnams ji lta ba bzhin du tshangs pa'i mdun na 'don pa rnams dang / tshangs pa chen po pa rnams dang / 'od chung ba rnams dang / tshad med 'od pa rnams dang / 'od gsal ba rnams dang / dge chung ba rnams dang /tshad med dge ba rnams dang / dge rgyas pa rnams dang / sprin med pa rnams dang / bsod nams skyes pa rnams dang / 'bras bu che ba rnams dang / mi che ba rnams dang nyu/ mi gdung ba rnams dang / gya nom snang ba rnams dang /shin tu mthong ba rnams dang / 'og min gyi lha rnams kyang de bzhin no/ /'jig rten gzhag pa las tshigs lnga pa'o / / tsumado la/ zla mtshan 'khrig dang khya chu dang / /tsheg ③bsgyur dang ni chu klung brag /sa la rjing bu glang po dang / /srung byem 'khor los sgyur ba'i lam /ji ltar 'dzam bu'i gling gi mi rnams la bud med zla mtshan can dang / sbrum ma dang / bu btsa' ba yod pa bzhin du shar gyi lus 'phags pa rnams dang /nub kyi ba lang spyod pa rnams dang / byang gi sgra mi snyan pa rnams la yang yod do//rgyal chen bzhi'i lha rnams kyi ni 'dzam bu'i gling gi mi rnams kyi khye'u 'am bu mo lo lnga lon pa ji tsam pa de bzhin no/ /lha'am lha'i bu mo 5phrag pa'am phang par sems can rdzus te skye bar 'gyur te/ de la lha 'am lha'i bu mo dag 'di snyam du 'di ni bdag gi bu'am bu mo snyam du sems so/ /khye'u 'am ༄ ༷bu mo de dag kyang 'di snyam du 'di ni bdag cag gi ma'am pha'o snyam du sems so/ /sum cu rtsa gsum pa rnams dang ④ni lo drug lon pa ji tsam pa bzhin no/ /'thab bral ba rnams kyi ni lo bdun lon pa ji tsam pa bzhin no/ /dga' ldan ldan bye pa rnams 78—657

kyi ni lo brgyad lon pa ji tsam pa bzhin no/ /'phrul dga' ba rnams kyi ni lo dgu lon pa ji tsam pa bzhin no/ /gzhan 'phrul dbang byed pa rnams kyi ni 'dzam bu'i gling gi bu pho 3snadang bu mo lo bcu lon pa ji tsam pa de bzhin du lha'am lha'i bu mo'i phrag pa 'am phang par rdzus te/ skye ba'i sems can 'byung bar 'gyur te/ de na lha'am lha'i bu mo dag 'di snyam du 'di ni bdag gi bu'am bu mo snyam du sems so/ /khye'u dang bu mo ②dag kyang 'di snyam du 'di ni bdag cag gi ma'am pha'o snyam du sems so/ /tshangs ris kyi lha rnams ni thog ma nas lus kyi yan lag dang nying lag thams cad rdzogs par skye shing 'chi ba na yang de kho na nyid do/ /tshangs ris kyi lha rnams ji lta ba bzhin du tshangs pa'i mdun na 'don pa rnams dang / tshangs pa chen po pa rnams dang / 'od chung ba rnams dang / tshad med 'od pa rnams dang / 'od gsal ba rnams dang / dge chung ba rnams dang / tshad med dge ba rnams dang / dge rgyas pa rnams dang /sprin med pa rnams dang / bsod nams skyes pa rnams dang / 'bras bu che ba rnams dang / mi che ba rnams dang / mi gdung ba rnams dang / gya nom snang ba rnams dang / shin tu mthong ba rnams dang / 'og min pa rnams kyang de bzhin no/ /gzugs med pa rnams la 3lus kyi gzugs med do/ /de bas na de dag gi skye ba yang mi mngon/ 'chi thub yang mi mngon no/ /ji ltar 'dzam bu'i gling gi mi rnams mi tshangs par spyod pa 'khrig pa'i chos bsten pa ni ⑤gnyis kyis gnyis sbyor ba yod pa bubazhin du shar gyi lus 'phags pa rnams dang /nub kyi ba lang spyod pa rnams dang / byang gi sgra mi snyan pa rnams dang / rgyal chen bzhi'i lha rnams dang / sum cu rtsa gsum pa rnams dang ⑦de bzhin no/ /78—658

'thab bral ba rnams ni 'khyud pa tsam gyis gdung ba zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /dga' ldan pa rnams kyi khyani lag pa nas bzung ba tsam kyis so/ /'phrul dga' ba rnams kyi ni bgad ④pa tsam gyis so/ /gzhan 'phrul dbang byed pa rnams kyi ni bltas pa tsam gyis gdung ba zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /tshangs ris pa rnams la ni 'dod chags med do/ /tshangs ris pa rnams ji lta ba bzhin du tshangs pa'i mdun na 'don pa rnams dang / tshangs pa chen po pa rnams dang / 'od chung ba rnams dang / tshad med 'od pa rnams dang / 'od gsal ba rnams dang /dge chung ba rnams dang / tshad med dge ba rnams dang / dge rgyas pa rnams dang / sprin med pa rnams dang / bsod nams skyes pa rnams dang /'bras bu che ba rnams dang / mi che ba rnams dang / mi gdung ba rnams dang /gya nom snang ba rnams dang / shin tu mthong ba rnams dang / 'og min gyi lha rnams kyang de bzhin no/ /ji ltar 'dzam bu'i gling gi mi rnams la khu chu mi gtsang ba zhuyod pa bzhin du shar gyi lus 'phags pa rnams dang / nub kyi ba lang spyod pa rnams dang / byang gi sgra mi snyan gyi mi rnams la yang de bzhin no/ /rgyal chen bzhi'i lha rnams la ④ rlung 'byung ngo / /rgyal chen bzhi'i lha rnams ji lta ba bzhin du sum cu rtsa gsum pa rnams dang / 'thab bral ba rnams dang /dga' ldan pa rnams dang / 'phrul dga' ba rnams dang / gzhan 'phrul dbang byed pa rnams kyi yang de bzhin no/ /tshangs ris kyi lha rnams la ni 'dod chags med do/ /tshangs ris pa rnams ji lta ba bzhin du tshangs pa'i mdun na 'don pa rnams dang / tshangs pa chen po pa rnams dang / 'od chung ba rnams dang / tshad med 'od pa rnams dang / 'od gsal ba rnams dang / dbe 78—659

chung ba rnams dang / tshad med dge ba rnams dang / dge rgyas pa rnams dang /sprin med pa rnams dang / bsod nams skyes pa rnams dang / 'bras bu che ba rnams dang / mi che ba rnams dang / mi gdung ba rnams dang / gya nom snang ba rnams dang / shin tu mthong ba rnams dang / 'og min gyi lha rnams kyang de bzhin no/ /sems can dmyal ba'i sems can gyi che'i tshad kyi mtha' ni bskal pa gcig ste/ bar ma dor 'chi ba ni yod do/ /dud 'gro'i skye gnas su skyes pa'i sems can rnams kyi che'i tshad ni mtha'i bskal pa ཿgcig ste/bar ma dor 'chi ba ni yod do/ /mi rnams kyi nyin zhag sum cu gang yin pa de ni yi dwags rnams kyi nyin gcig ste/ nyin zhag de sum cu la zla ba gcig /zla ba bcu gnyis la lo gcig ste/ yi dwags rnams kyi che'i tshad kyi mtha' ni lo de lta bur brtsis pa'i lo lnga brgya ste/ bar ma dor 'chi ba ni yod do/ /de mi'i ltar brtsis na lo khri lnga stong yod do/ /shar kyi lus 'phags kyi mi rnams kyi che'i tshad kyi mtha' ni lo nyis brgya lnga bcu ste/ bar ma dor 'chi ba ni yod do/ /nub kyi ba lang spyod kyi mi rnams kyi che'i tshad kyi mtha' ni lo lnga brgya ste/ bar ma dor 'chi ba ni yod do/ /byang gi sgra mi snyan gyi mi rnams kyi tshe'i tshad kyi mtha' ni lo stong ste/ bar ma dor 'chi ba med do/ /ci'i phyir byang gi sgra mi snyan gyi mi rnams ni bar ma dor 'chi ba tremed ce na/ de dag la bdag gi 1med cing yongs su 'dzin pa med de/ tshe nges shing khyad par du ④'gro ba yin pas de'i phyir byang gi sgra mi snyan gyi mi ldurnams la bar ma dor 'chi ba med do/ /'dzam bu'i gling gi mi rnams la ni yiyar skye ba dang / mar 'gro ba ④yod de/ 'dzam bu'i gling gi mi rnams res du'aga' ni tshe dpag tu med par 'gyur la/ res spu78—660

'ga' ni tshe lo bcu par 'gyur la①/ mi rnams kyi tshe lo lnga bcu gang yin pa de ni—/ rgyal chen bzhi'i lha rnams kyi nyin zhag gcig go/ /nyin zhag de sum cu la zla ba gcig gokhru/ /zla ba bcu gnyis la lo gcig ste/ rgyal chen bzhi'i lha rnams kyi tshe'i tshad kyi mtha' ni lo de lta bur brtsis pa'i lha'i lo lnga brgya ste/bar ma dor 'chi ba ni yod do/ /de mi'i ltar brtsis khrun lo sa ya phrag dgu yod do—/ /de ni sems can dmyal ba chen po yang sos kyi nyin zhag gcig go/ /nyin zhag de sum cu la zla ba gcig /zla ba bcu gnyis la lo gcig ste/sems can dmyal ba yang sos kyi sems can rnams kyi che'i tshad kyi mtha' ni de lo lta bur brtsis pa'i sems can dmyal ba pa'i lo lnga brgya ste/ bar ma dor 'chi ba ni yod do/ /de mi'i ltar brtsis na lo bye ba phrag 'bum drug khri nyis stong yod do//mi rnams kyi bo brgya gang yin pa de ni sum cu rtsa gsum kyi nyin zhag gcig go/ /nyin zhag de sum cu la zla ba gcig /zla ba bcu gnyis la lo gcig ste/ sum cu rtsa gsum gyi lha rnams kyi tshe'i tshad kyi mtha' ni de lta bur brtsis pa'i lha'i lo stong ste/ bar ma dor 'chi ba ni yod do/ /de mi'i ltar brtsis na lo bye ba phrag gsum dang sa ya phrag drug yod do/ /de ni sems can dmyal ba chen po thig nag gi nyin zhag gcig go/ /nyin zhag de sum cu la zla ba gcig go/④/ /zla ba bcu gnyis la lo gcig ste/ sems can dmyal ba chen po thig nag gi che'i tshad kyi mtha' ni lo de lta bur brtsis pa'i sems can dmyal ba'i lo stong ste/ bar ma dor 'chi ba ni yod do/ /de mi'i ltar brtsis na lo bye ba phrag 'bum phrag bcu gnyis dang / bye ba phrag dgu khri drug stong yod do/ /mi rnams kyi lo nyis brgya gang yin pa de ni 'thab bral gyi lha rnams kyi nyin zhag gcig go/ /nyin zhag de 78—661

sum cu la zla ba gcig /zla ba bcu gnyis la lo gcig ste/ 'thab bral ba'i lha rnams kyi tshe'i tshad kyi mtha' ni lo de lta bur brtsis pa'i lha'i lo nyis stong ste/bar ma dor 'chi ba ni yod do/ /de mi'i ltar brtsis na lo bye ba phrag bcu bzhi dang sa ya phrag bzhi yod do/ /de ni sems can dmyal ba chen po bsdus gzhom gye nyin zhag gcig go/ /nyin zhag de sum cu la zla ba gcig /zla ba bcu gnyis la lo gcig ste/ sems can dmyal ba chen po bsdus gzhom gyi sems can rnams kyi tshe'i tshad kyi mtha' ni lo de lta bur brtsis pa'i sems can dmyal ba'i lo nyis stong ste/ bar ma dor 'chi ba ni yod do/ /de mi'i ltar brtsis na lo bye ba phrag gcig dang / bye ba phrag gsum 'bum drug khri brgyad stong yod do/ /mi rnams kyi lo bzhi brgya gang yin pa de ni dga' ldan gyi lha rnams kyi nyin zhag gcig go/ /nyin zhag sum cu la zla ba gcig /zla ba bcu gnyis la lo gcig ste / dga' ldan gyi lha rnams kyi che'i tshad kyi mtha' ⑨ni lo de lta bur brtsis pa'i lo bzhi stong yod do/ /bar ma dor 'chi ba ni yod do/ /de mi'i ltar brtsis na lo bye ba ri )lnga bcu rtsa bdun dang / lo sa ya phrag drug yod do/ /de ni sems can dmyal ba chen po ngu 'bod kyi nyin zhag gcig go/ /nyin zhag de sum cu la zla ba gcig /zla ba bcu gnyis la lo gcig ste/ sems can dmyal ba chen po ngu 'bod kyi ༄ —sems can rnams kyi tshe'i tshad kyi mtha' ni lo de lta bur brtsis pa'i lo bzhi stong ste/ bar ma dor 'chi ba ni yod do/ /de mi'i ltar brtsis na lo bye ba phrag bye ba brgya ④dang / bye ba phrag sa ya gnyis dang / bye ba phrag dgu 'bum bzhi khri bzhi stong yod do/ /mi rnams kyi lo brgyad brgya gang yin pa de ni 'phrul dga' 3lha rnams kyi nyin zhag gcig go/ /nyin zhag de ⑥sum cu 78—662

la zla ba gcig go/ /zla ba bcu gnyis la lo gcig ste/ 'phrul dga'i lha rnams kyi tshe'i tshad kyi mtha' ni lo de lta bur brtsis pa'i lha'i lo brgyad stong ste/bar ma do'i 'chi ba ni yod do/ /de mi'i ltar brtsis na lo bye ba phrag nyis ri4 brgya sum cu dang / lo sa ya phrag bzhi yod do/ /de ni sems can dmyal ba chen po ngu 'bod chen po'i nyin zhag gcig go/ /nyin zhag de sum cu la zla ba gcig /zla ba bcu gnyis la lo gcig ste/ sems can dmyal ba chen po ngu 'bod chen po'i tshe'i tshad kyi mtha' ni lo de lta bur brtsis pa'i sems can dmyal ba'i lo brgyad stong yod de/ bar ma dor 'chi ba ni yod do/ /de mi'i ltar brtsis na lo bye ba phrag drug cu rtsa drug dang / bye ba phrag sa ya gsum dang bye ba phrag lnga 'bum lnga khri nyis stong yod do/ /mi rnams kyi lo stong drug brgya gang yin pa de ni gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyi lha rnams kyi nyin zhag gcig go/ /nyin zhag de sum cu la zla ba gcig /zla ba bcu gnyis la lo gcig ste/ gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyi lha rnams kyi che'i tshad kyi mtha' ni lo de lta bur brtsis pa'i lha'i lo khri drug stong ste/ bar ma dor 'chi ba ni yod do/ /de mi'i ltar brtsis na lo bye ba phrag dgu brgya nyi shu rtsa gcig dang / lo sa ya budrug yod dekye/ de ni sems can dmyal ba chen po tsha ba'i nyin zhag gcig go/ /nyin zhag de sum cu la zla ba gcig /zla ba bcu gnyis la lo gcig ste/ sems can dmyal ba chen po tsha ba'i sems can dmyal ba pa'i sems can rnams kyi che'i tshad kyi mtha' zini lo de lta bur brtsis pa'i sems can dmyal ba pa'i lo khri drug stong ste/ bar ma dor 'chi ba ni yod do/ /de mi'i ltar brtsis na lo bye ba phrag lnga brgya dang / lo bye ba phrag bye ba sum cu dang / lo bye ba phrag sa ya brgyad dang / bzhi 'bum dang /78—663

lo bye ba phrag khri drug stong yod do/ /bar gyi mdo la/ dgu dang gsum dang bcu bzhi dang ni lnga bcu rtsa bdun dang / /nyis brgya dgu brgya rnams ni mi yi grangs kyi 7lha tsher bshad/ /de bzhin gcig dang ⑤bcu gnyis gcig dang brgyad dang drug cu dang / /lnga brgya dag ni sems can dmyal ba pa yi 1tsher bshad do/ /tshangs ris kyi lha rnams kyi che'i tshad kyi mtha' ni bskal pa phyed de/bar ma dor 'chi ba ni yod do/ /sems can dmyal ba chen po rab tu tsha ba'i che'i tshad kyi mtha' ni bskal pa phyed de/ bar ma dor 'chi ba ni yod do/ /tshangs pa'i mdun na 4'don pa'i lha rnams kyi che'i tshad kyi mtha' ni bskal pa gcig yin tethu/ bar ma dor 'chi ba ni yod do/ /sems can dmyal ba chen po mnar med pa'i che'i tshad kyi mtha' ni bskal pa gcig ste/ bar ma dor 'chi ba rgo yod do/ /tshangs pa chen po pa'i lha rnams kyi che'i tshad kyi mtha' ni bskal pa phyed dang gnyis te/ bar ma dor 'chi ba ni yod do/ /'od chung gi lha rnams kyi che'i tshad kyi mtha' ni bskal pa gnyis te/ bar ma dor 'chi ba ni yod do / /tshad med 'od kyi lha rnams kyi tshe'i tshad kyi mtha' ni bskal pa bzhi ste/bar ma dor 'chi ba ni yod do/ /'od gsal gyi lha rnams kyi che'i tshad kyi mtha' ni bskal pa brgyad de/ bar ma dor 'chi ba ni yod do/ /dge chung gi lha rnams kyi che'i tshad kyi mtha' ni bskal pa bcu drug ste/ bar ma dor 'chi ba ni yod do/ /tshad med dge ba'i lha rnams kyi che'i tshad kyi mtha' ni bskal pa sum cu rtsa gnyis te/ bar ma dor 'chi ba ni yod do/ /dge rgyas kyi lha rnams kyi tshe'i tshad kyi mtha' ni bskal pa drug cu rtsa bzhi ste/ bar ma dor 'chi ba ni yod do / /sprin med kyi lha rnams kyi che'i tshad kyi mtha' ni bskal pa brgya nyi shu rtsa lnga 78—664

ste—/ bar ma dor 'chi ba ni yod do/ /bsod nams skyes kyi lha rnams kyi che'i tshad kyi mtha' ni bskal pa nyis brgya lnga bcu ste/ bar ma dor 'chi ba ni yod do/ /'bras bu che ba'i lha rnams kyi che'i tshad kyi mtha' ni bskal pa lnga brgya ste/ bar ma dor 'chi ba ni yod do/ /'du shes med pa'i lha rnams kyang de dang ༄1'dra'o/ /mi che ba'i lha rnams kyi che'i tshad kyi mtha' ni bskal pa stong ste/ bar ma dor 'chi ba ni yod do/ /mi gdung ba'i lha rnams kyi che'i tshad kyi mtha' ni bskal pa nyis stong ste/ bar ma dor 'chi ba ni yod do/ /gya nom snang ba'i lha rnams kyi che'i tshad kyi mtha' ni bskal pa bzhi stong ste/ bar ma dor 'chi ba ni yod do/ /shin tu mthong ba'i lha rnams kyi tshe'i tshad kyi mtha' ni bskal pa brgyad stong ste/bar ma dor 'chi ba ni yod do/ /'og min gyi lha rnams kyi che'i tshad kyi mtha' ni bskal pa khri drug stong ste/ bar ma dor 'chi ba ni yod do/ /nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched pa'i che'i tshad kyi mtha' ni bskal pa nyi khri ste/ bar ma dor 'chi ba ni yod do/ /rnam shes mtha' yas skye mched pa'i lha rnams kyi che'i tshad kyi mtha' ni bskal pa bzhi khri ste/ bar ma dor 'chi ba ni yod do/ /ci yang med pa'i skye mched kyi lha rnams kyi che'i tshad kyi mtha' ni bskal pa drug khri ste/bar ma dor 'chi ba ni yod do/ /'du shes med 'du shes med min skye mched pa'i lha rnams kyi tshe'i tshad kyi mtha' ni bskal pa brgyad khri ste/ bar ma dor 'chi ba ni yod do/ /'di nas byang phyogs na ri nag po gsum yod do/ /ri nag po gsum po de dag gi byang phyogs na ri nag po 3gsum yod do/ / ri nag po gzhan gsum po de dag gi byang phyogs na yang ri nag po gzhan gsum yod do/ /1 ri nag po gzhan gsum po de dag gi byang phyogs na ri'i rgyal po gangs zhes bya ba 78—665

yod do/ /ri'i rgyal po gangs kyi byang phyogs na/ ri'i rgyal po spos kyi ngad ldang zhes bya ba yod do/ /ri'i rgyal po spos kyi ngad ldang nas dpag tshad bcu'i tshu rol na mtsho chen po chu zhes bya ba zhig yod de/ ma dros pa zhes kyang bya'o/ /mtsho chen po chu zhes bya ba de la chur dpag tshad lnga bcu ①zheng du dpag tshad lnga bcu yod do/ /mtha' skor du ni dpag tshad nyis brgya yod do/ /dbyibs legs shing blta 5na snyug la mdzes pa chu bsal dze+ezhing chu sbrang rtsi lta bus gang la/me tog ut+pa la dang / pad+ma dang / ku mu ta rjodang / pad+ma dkar pos kun du khebs par 'dug go/ /de'i nang nas chu klung chen po bzhi 'di lta ste/gaṅgā dang / sen+dha dang / se ta dang / pak+ṣu ⑤dang / 'di rnams 'bab ste/gaṅgā ni shar phyogs nas glang po che'i kha nas 'bab ste/ mtsho chen po chu zhes bya ba'i g.yas phyogs su bskor nas/ klung lnga brgya dang lhan cig tu shar phyogs kyi rgya mtsho chen por 'gro'o/ /sidhu ⑥ni lho phyogs nas khyu mchog gi kha nas 'bab ste/de ni mtsho chen po chu zhes bya ba'i g.yas phyogs su bskor nas klung lnga brgya dang lhan cig tu lho phyogs kyi rgya mtsho chen por 'gro'o/ /pak+ṣu ni nub phyogs nas rta'i kha nas 'bab ste/ de ni mtsho chen po chu zhes bya ba'i g.yas phyogs su bskor nas/klung lnga brgya dang lhan cig tu nub phyogs kyi rgya mtsho chen por 'gro'o/ /se ta ni byang phyogs nas seng ge'i kha nas 'bab ste/ de ni mtsho chen po chu zhes bya ba'i g.yas phyogs su bskor nas/ klung lnga brgya dang lhan cig tu byang phyogs kyi rgya mtsho chen bor 'gro'o/ /'di skad du/ byang phyogs kha dgur 'gyur ba yi/ /chu mtsho yod de gzhan dag kyang / /de ni mtsho chen chu zhes bya/ /tha dad rgyu rnams 'byung gnas yod/ /chu klung gaṅgā sen+tu ⑦pak+ṣu dang / /se ta dba' 78—666

rlabs lbu ①ba'i phreng ba can/ /'bab cing thams cad gsal lduba'i chu yin te/ /phyogs bzhi kho ra khor yug dag nas 'byung / /gaṅgā shar phyogs rgya mtshor 'gro ba ste—/ /sen+d+ra ①lho phyogs rgya mtshor 'gro ba yin/ /pak+ṣu yang ni nub phyogs rgya mtshor 'gro/ /de yi byang phyogs rgya mtshor si ta 'gro/ /chu klung rab mchog bzhi po 'di dag ni/ /mchog tu bzang zhing so sor 'bab pa ste/ /re re zhing yang lnga brgya khyer nas ni/ /chu yi rgyun rnams rgya mtsho chen por 'gro/ /zhes kyang bya'o/ /ri spos kyi ngad ldang de'i byang phyogs dpag tshad nyi shu na gser gye brag bya skyibs lha ma yin gyi ngos zhes bya ba yod de/ chur dpag tshad lnga bcu zhing du yang dpag tshad lnga bcu/ mtha' skor du dpag tshad ④nyis brgya 'phang du dpag tshad phyed dang bzhi yod pa/ dbyibs legs shing blta 5na sbug la mdzes pa zhig yod do/ /de'i nang gis ⑥gzhi yang dbyebs legs shing blta )na sdug la/ mdzes pa gser gyi bye ma bdal zhing khrutsan+dan gyi chus chag chag btab pa ste/ der yid du mi 'ong ba ⑨shing ngam/ gseg ma'am/ gang ci yang rung ba dag lhung na de mi ma yin pa rnams kyi ⑫rlung gi mthus phyi rol du gtor ro/ /de'i kho ra khor yug na gser gyi brag bya skyibs can brgya stong yod do/ /de dag thams cad kyang dbyibs 4rmelegs shing blta nyu9na sdug la mdzes pa ste/de dag gi nang na 4)sa gzhi rnams kyang dbyibs legs shing blta tso/4na snyug la/mdzes pa gser gyi phye ma bdal zhing s+dzatsan+dan gyi chus chag chag btab pa⑫/ de dag tu yang yid du mi 'ong ba shing ngam/ gseg ma'am/ gang ci yang rung ba dag lhung ⑩na/ de mi ma yin pa rnams kyi rlung gi mthus phyi rol du 'dor ro/ /de'i lam srid du dpag tshad nyi shu/ zheng du dpag tshad phyed dang gnyis yod pa 78—667

dbyibs legs shing blta khyen sdug la mdzes pa gser gyi phye ma bdal zhing rngutsan+dan gyi chus chag chag btab pa zhig yod de/ de yang yid du mi 'ong ba shing ngam gseg ma'am/ gang ci yang rung ba dag lhung na de mi ma yin pa rnams kyi byerlung gi mthus/ phyi rol du 'dor ro/ /brag bya skyibs lha ma yin gye ngos de'i byang phyogs dpag tshad nyi shu na shing sā la'i rgyal po chen po rab tu brtan pa zhes bya ba sā la'i phreng ba rim pa bdun gyis bskor ba zhig yod do/ /sā la'i rgyal po rab tu brtan pa de'i gertsa ba ni 'dom bcu bzhi thur du zug go/ /sā la'i phreng ba dang po'i rtsa ba ni 'dom bcu gsum thur du zug go/ /gnyis pa'i ni bcu gnyis so/ /gsum pa'i ni snyebacu gcig go/ /bzhi pa'i ni bcu'o/ /lnga pa'i ni dgu'o/ /drug pa'i 6ni brgyad do/ /sā 3la'i phreng ba bdun pa'i rtsa ba ni 'dom bdun thur du zug go/ /sā la'i rgyal po rab tu brtan pa de'i yal ga dang / lo ma dang yal ga 3rnams gang yin pa de ni sā la'i phreng ba dang po la thug go/ /sā la'i phreng ba dang po ni yal ga dang lo ma dang yal ga ⑨gang yin pa de ni gnyis pa la'o/ /gnyis pa'i gang yin pa de 6ni gsum pa la'o/ /gsum pa'i gang yin pa de ni bzhi pa la'o/ /bzhi pa'i gang yin pa de ni lnga pa la'o/ /lnga pa'i gang yin pa de ni drug pa la'o/ /drug pa'i gang yin pa de ni bdun pa la'o / /sā la'i phreng ba bdun pa'i yal ga dang / lo ma dang yal ga gang yin pa de ni nam mkha' khyab par 'dug go/ /de'i nang gi sa gzhi yang dbyibs legs shing blta tsan sdug la/ mdzes pa gser gye phye ma bdal zhing ⑫tsan+dan gyi chus chag chag btab pa ste/ de yang yid du mi 'ong ba shing ngam gseg ⑫ma'am/gang ci yang rung ba dag lhung na ni de mi ma yin pa rnams kyi ④rlung gi mthus phyi 78—668

rol tu 'dor ro/ /de'i lam srid du dpag tshad nyi shu/ zheng du dpag tshad phyed dang gnyis yod pa/ dbyibs legs shing blta na sdug la mdzes pa zhig yod do/ /der yang yid du mi 'ong ba shing ngam gseg ma 'am gang ci yang rung ba dag lhung 1na de mi ma yin pa rnams kyi perlung gi mthus phyi rol du 'dor ro/ /sā la'i rgyal po rab tu brtan pa'i shar phyogs dpag tshad nyi shu na/ rdzing bu dal gyis 'bab ces bya ba chur dpag tshad lnga bcu/ zheng du yang dpag tshad lnga bcu ste—/ mtha' skor du dpag tshad nyis brgya yod pa/ dbyibs legs shing blta na sdug la mdzes pa chu bsel zhing chu sbrang rtsi lta bus gang ba/ me tog ut+pa la dang / pad+ma dang / ku mu ta ①dang / pad+ma dkar pos khebs pa zhig yod do //rdzing bu dal gyis 'bab pa ④de'i nang gi pad+ma'i lo ma rnams che zhing mchog tu che ste/'di lta ste/ ba lang gi ko ba tsam mo/ /pad+ma'i sdong bu rnams che zhing mchog tu che ste/ 'di lta ste/ gshol mda' tsam mo/ /pad+ma'i me tog rnams che zhing mchog tu che buste/ 'di lta ste/ shing rta'i 'phang lo tsam mo/ /pad+ma'i rtsa ba rnams che zhing mchog tu che ste/ 'di lta ste/ skyes bu chen po'i brla tsam mo/ /ro mngar zhing mchog tu mngar ste/ 'di lta ste/ sbrang bu'i sbrang rtsi ma bskol ba bzhin no/ /bcad na yang 'o ma 'dzag go/ /rdzing bu dal gyis hūṃ'abab kyi kho ra khor yug na rdzing bu brgyad stong yod de/ de dag thams cad kyang dbyibs legs shing blta na sdug la mdzes pa chu bsil zhing sbrang rtsi lta bus gang ngo / /de dag gi nang gi pad+ma'i lo ma rnams kyang che zhing mchog tu che ste/ 'di lta ste/ba lang gi ko ba tsam mo/ /pad+ma'i sdong bu rnams che zhing mchog tu che ste/ 'di lta ste/ gshol mda' tsam mo/ /pad+ma'i me tog rnams che zhing mchog tu che ste/78—669

'di lta ste/ shing rta'i 'phang lo tsam mo/ /pad+ma'i rtsa ba rnams che zhing mchog tu che ste/ 'di lta ste/ skyes bu chen po'i brla tsam mo/ /ro mngar zhing mchog tu mngar te/ 'di lta ste/ sbrang bu'i sbrang rtsi ma bskol ba bzhin no/ /bcad na yang 'o ma 'dzag go/ /de'i lam srid du dpag tshad nyi shu/ zhing 1du dpag tshad phyed dang gnyis yod pa/ dbyibs legs shing blta 1na sdug la mdzes pa gser gye phye ma bdal zhing tsan+dan gyi ①chus chag chag btab pa zhig yod de / der yang yid du mi 'ong ba shing ngam/ gseg ma'am/ gang ci yang rung ba dag lhung 4na de mi ma lduyin pa rnams kyi rlung gi mthus phyi rol du 'dor ro//sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha rnams kyi glang po che'i rgyal po ④g.yul ngor chas pa rab tu brtan pa zhes bya ba gzugs bzang zhing blta ④/na sdug la mdzes pa zhig yod de/me tog ku mu ta'i ṣ+pemadog ltar thal kar du/du 'dug la/ yan lag bdun shin tu legs par gnas pa ste/ de ⑫mgo bo yang dbyibs legs shing blta skyen sdug la mdzes pa ste/ sngo zhing srog chags lham bu chu gsher gyi mdog ltar dbus dmar la mche ba drug yod de/ glang po che rab tu brtan pa ⑫srid du dpag tshad phyed dang gsum/ zheng du dpag tshad gcig 'phang du dpag tshad phyed dang gnyis / mtha' skor 3du dpag tshad bdun yod do/ /de'i 'khor glang po che brgyad thustong yod do/ /de thams cad kyang gzugs bzang zhing blta ⑫na sdug pa mdzes pa/ me tog ku mu ta'i kyemadog ltar thal kar du ⑫'dug cing yan lag bdun shin tu legs par gnas pa ste/ de dag gi mgo bo yang dbyibs legs shing blta ⑪na sdug la mdzes pa ste/ sngo zhing srog chags lham bu chu gsher gyi mdog ltar dbus dmar la mche ba drug yod pa sha stag ste/ glang po che'i rgyal po 78—670

rab tu brtan pa de 'khor dang bcas pa dgun zla ba bzhi ni brag bya skyibs lha ma yin gyi ngos kyi nang na gnas shing 'khod do/ /dpyid zla ba bzhi ni shing sā la'i /shesnargyal po rab tu brtan pa'i nang na gnas shing 'khod do/ /dbyar zla ba bzhi ni rdzing bu dal gyis 1'bab kyi nang na gnas shing 'khod do/ /gang gi tshe glang po che'i rgyal po rab tu brtan pa brag bya skyibs lha ma yin gyi ngos kyi nang na gnas shing 'dug pa de'i tshe ni glang po che brgyad stong po rnams 'di lta ste/ glang po che'i rgyal po rab tu brtan pa srung ba dang sba ba dang mdzes par bya ba'i phyir brag bya skyibs brgyad stong 1gi nang na nye bar gnas shing 'khod do/ /gang gi tshe glang po che'i rgyal po rab tu brtan pa brag bya skyibs lha ma yin gye ngos kyi nang na gnas shing sā la'i rgyal po rab tu brtan pa'i nang du 'gro ba na/ res 'ga' ni tha mal pa'i tshul gyis 'gro'o/ /res 'ga' ni 'di lta ste/ lha dang lha'i bu rdzu 'phrul che zhing gang yang rung ba dang 'dra bar bdag nyid mngon par sprul nas glang po che thams cad kyi ④nang na dbang che bar grags pa gang yin pa de nyid kyi mgo bo'am/ rgyab tu zhon te sil snyan dang pheg rdob pa dag tūcher byed cing 'gro'o—/ /gang gi tshe glang po che'i rgyal po rte/rab tu brtan pa'i nang na gnas shing 'dug pa de'i tshe ni glang po che brgyad stong po 'di dag kyang 'di lta ste/glang po che'i rgyal po rab tu brtan pa srung ⑦ba dang / sba ba dang / mdzes par bya ba'i phyir shing sā la'i phreng ba rim pa bdun po dag gi nang na kha nang du bltas shing 'khod do/ /shing sā la'i phreng ba dang po'i nang na 'dug pa gang yin pa de dag kyang kha nang du bltas te 'khod do/ /gnyis pa'i nang na 'dug pa gang yin pa de dag kyang kha nang du lta'o/ /gsum pa'i nang du 'dug pa gang yin pa de 78—671

dag kyang kha nang du lta'o/ /bzhi pa'i nang du 'dug pa de dag kyang kha nang du lta'o / /lnga pa'i nang na 'dug pa gang yin pa de dag kyang kha nang du lta'o/ /drug pa'i nang na 'dug pa gang yin pa de dag kyang kha nang du lta'o/ /bdun pa'i nang na 'dug pa gang yin pa de dag kyang kha nang du bltas te 'khod do/ /gang gi tshe glang po che'i rgyal po rab tu brtan pa shing sā la'i rgyal po rab tu brtan pa nas rdzing bu dal gyis 'bab par 'gro ba na/ res 'ga' ni tha mal pa'i tshul kyis 'gro'o/ /res 'ga' ni 'di lta ste/ lha'am lha'i bu rdzu 'phrul che zhing mthu che ba gang yang rung ba dang 'dra bar bdag nyid mngon par sprul nas glang po che de dag thams cad kyi nang na dbang che bar grags pa gang yin pa de nyid kyi mgo'am / rgyab tu zhon te sel nyusnyan dang pheg rdob pa dag rgya cher byed cing 'gro'o / /gang gi tshe glang po che'i rgyal po rab tu brtan pa rdzing bu dal gyis 'bab kyi — nang du zhugs nas rtse zhing dga' la dga' dgur spyod pa de'i tshe glang po che brgyad stong po de dag 'di lta ste/ glang po che'i rgyal po rab tu brtan pa de srung /3ba dang / sba ba dang / mdzes par bya ba'i phyir rdzing bu dal gyis 'bab kyi hūṃmatha' kho ra khor yug nas bskor te kha nang du bltas shing 'khod do/ /gang gi tshe glang po che'i rgyal po rab tu brtan pa rdzing bu dal gyis 'bab kyi nang nas rtse zhing dga' la dga' mgur byespyad nas phyir byung ba de'i tshe ④nang na glang po che dbang che bar grags pa gang yin pa de rdzing bu dal gyis 'bab kyi nang du zhugs nas pad+ma'i rtsa ba rnams blangs te/ shin tu bkrus shing rab tu bshal ④nas glang po che'i rgyal po rab tu brtan pa la 'bul lo/ /gang gi tshe glang po che'i rgyal po rab tu brtan pas zos shing 'thungs te 'grangs 3par gyur pa de'i tshe 78—672

glang po che gzhan brgyad stong po de dag kyang rdzing bu brgyad stong khyegi nang na rdzing bu re re zhugs na rjortse zhing dga' la dga' dgur spyod do/ /pad+ma'i rtsa ba dag blangs nas shin tu bkrus shing rab tu bshal te za'o/ /sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha rnams kyi glang po che 1rgyal po g.yul ngor spyad pa rab tu bstan drupa'i mthu ni de tsam mo/ /sems can thams cad ni srung skyem dang bcas shing srung 6ba dang /skyob pa dang sbed pa dang / mi 'bral ste⑦/ sems can gang dbang chung bar grags shing bsod nams chung la/ gzi brjid chung ba de dag ni brgya 8phrag mang po dang / stong phrag mang po la gcig srung spuste/ dper na ba lang ngam lug brgya phrag mang po dang stong phrag mang po la gcig srung ba de bzhin du/sems can gang dbang chung bar grags shing bsod nams chung la/ gzi brjid chung ba de dag ni brgya phrag mang po dang / stong phrag mang po la gcig bsrung /rngu ngo / /sems can gang dbang che bar grags shing bsod nams che la gzi brjid che ba de dag 4 nyuni brgya phrag mang po dang / stong phrag mang po dag gis gcig tu rmyebasrung ste/ dper na 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po'am/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas la brgya phrag mang po dang /stong phrag mang po dag gis gcig tu srung ⑫ba de bzhin du sems can gang dbang che bar grags shing bsod nams che la gzi brjid che ba de dag la brgya phrag mang po dang / stong phrag mang po dag gis gcig tu srung rngungo / /'dir smras pa/ji ste sems can thams cad srung ma dang bcas shing srung rmyeb dang / skyob pa dang / sbed pa dang mi 'bral na ci'i phyir 'tshe ba yod par 'gyur/ smras pa/srung ma mthu chung ba ⑫zhig yin na de la zil gyis gnon pa la ⑩'tshe ba yod do/ /78—673

srung ma bag med cing bag med par gnas pa zhig yin na ni bag med pa'i rgyu las kyang 'tshe ba rnams yod do/ /srung ma gnyis lhan cig mthun par gyur pas kyang tūzil gyis mnan nas 'tshe bar byed do/ /mi rnams chos ma yin pa spyod cing mi rigs pa spyod pa zhig yin na de dag gis duchos ma yin pa spyod pa dang /mi rigs pa spyod pa las kyang 'tshe ba yod do // //1'jig rten gzhag pa/ ④bam po gsum pa/ ④sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha rnams kyi mi rnams kyi srung ⑥ma 'di lta ste/ lam po che dang / srang dang /bzhi mdo dang / sum mdo dang / dri 'tshong ba'i gnas rnams dang / me tog phreng ba 'tshong ba'i gnas rnams dang / zong dgram pa'i gnas rnams dang /btung ba 'tshong ba'i gnas rnams dang / rtag tu stsos pa'i gnas rnams dang /gsod byed kyi gnas 3su bkod pa dag yod de/ zla ba phyed kyi tshes brgyad la rgyal po chen po bzhi po dag gi g.yog zho shas 'tsho ba rnams kyis 0lam po che dang /srang dang / bzhi mdo dang / sum mdo dang / dri 'tshong ba'i gnas rnams dang / me tog gi phreng ba 'tshong ba'i gnas rnams dang / zong dgram pa'i gnas rnams dang / btung ba 'tshong ba'i gnas rnams dang / rtag tu stsos pa'i gnas rnams dang / gsod byed kyi gnas rnams na su zhig 'dug ces 'jig rten 'di thams cad byul 4te/ ci ste de ⑩dag gis skyen par tshor na ni de dag gnas mthon po la 'god do/ /ji ste de dag gis skyen par ma tshor ba ⑪na ni de dag gnas dma' ba la 'god do/ /zla ba phyed kyi tshes bcu bzhi la ni rgyal po chen po bzhi po de dag gi bu rnams kyi ⑩lam po che dang / srang dang /bzhi mdo dang / sum mdo dang / dri 'tshong ba'i gnas rnams dang / me 78—674

tog gi phreng ba 'tshong ba'i gnas rnams dang / zong dgram pa'i gnas rnams dang / btung ①ba 'tshong ba'i gnas rnams dang / rtag tu myos pa'i gnas rnams dang / gsod byed kyi gnas rnams na su zhig 'dug ces 'jig rten 'di thams cad byul pete/ ci ste de dag gis skyen par tshor ①na ni/ de dag gnas mthon po la 'god do/ /ci ste de dag gis skyen par ma tshor na ni de dag gnas dma' ba la 'god do/ /zla ba phyed kyi tshe bcwa ④lnga la ni rgyal po chen po bzhi po de dag nyid kyi lam po che dang / srang dang / bzhi mdo dang / sum mdo dang / dri 'tshong ba'i gnas rnams dang / me tog gi phreng ba 'tshong ba'i gnas rnams dang / zong dgram pa'i gnas rnams dang / btung byeb 'tshong ba'i gnas rnams dang / rtag tu myos pa'i gnas rnams dang / gsod byed kyi gnas rnams na su zhig 'dug ces 'jig rten 'di thams cad byul hūṃte/ci ste de dag gis skyen par tshor na ni/ de dag gnas mthon po la 'god do/ /ci ste de dag gis skyen par ma tshor na ni de dag gnas ④dma' ba la 'god do/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis kyang 'di skad du dge slong dag zla ba phyed kyi tshes brgyad la ni rgyal po chen po bzhi po dag gi ④zho shas 'tsho ba rnams ni ci mi dang mi ma yin pa'i 'jig rten na mar 'dzin pa dang / phar 'dzin pa dang / dge sbyong du 'dzin pa dang / bram zer 'dzin pa dang / rigs kyi nang na rgan rabs la rim gro byed pa dang / don byed pa dang / bya ba'i rigs pa byed pa dang /bsod nams byed pa dang / tshe 'di dang tshe ⑪phyi ma la kha na ma tho ba rnams kyis 'jigs par lta ba dang / sbyin pa dag sbyin zhing bsod nams dag byed pa dang /gso sbyong la nye bar gnas pa dang / tshul khrims yang dag par blangs nas 78—675

'dug pa dag mang ngam zhes 'jig rten 'di thams cad du nyul stilo/ /zla ba phyed kyi tshes bcu bzhi la ni rgyal po chen po bzhi po dag gi bu rnams ci mi dang mi ma yin pa'i 'jig rten na mar 'dzin pa dang / phar 'dzin pa dang / dge sbyong du 'dzin pa dang / bram zer 'dzin pa dang / rigs kyi nang na rgan rabs la rim gro byed pa dang / don byed pa dang / bya ba'i rigs pa byed pa dang / bsod nams byed pa dang / tshe 'di dang tshe phyi ma la kha na ma tho ba rnams kyis 'jigs par lta ba dang / sbyin pa dag sbyin zhing / bsod nams dag byed pa dang / gso sbyong la nye bar gnas pa dang / tshul khrims yang dag par blangs nas 'dug pa dag mang ngam zhes 'jig rten 'di dag thams cad nyul 3lo/ /zla ba phyed kyi tshes bcwa 3lnga la ni rgyal po chen po bzhi po de dag nyid ci mi dang mi ma yin pa'i 'jig rten na mar 'dzin pa dang / phar 'dzin pa dang / dge spyong du 'dzin pa dang / bram zer 'dzin pa dang / rigs kyi nang na rgan rabs la rim gro byed pa dang / don byed pa dang / bya ba'i rigs pa byed pa dang / bsod nams byed pa dang / tshe 'di dang tshe phyi ma la kha na ma tho ba rnams kyis 'jigs par lta ba dang / sbyin pa dag sbyin zhing bsod nams dag byed pa dang / gso sbyong la nye bar gnas pa dang / tshul khrims yang dag par blangs nas 'dug pa dag mang ngam zhes 'jig rten 'di thams cad nyul jelo/ /ci ste mi dang mi ma yin pa'i 'jig rten na mar mi 'dzin pa dang / phar mi 'dzin pa dang / dge sbyong du mi 'dzin pa dang /bram zer mi 'dzin pa dang / rigs kyi nang na rgan rabs la rim gro mi byed pa dang / don mi byed pa dang / bya ba'i rigs pa dag mi byed pa dang /78—676

bsod nams mi byed pa dang / tshe 'di dang tshe phyi ma la kha na ma tho ba rnams kyis 'jigs par mi lta ba dang / sbyin pa dag mi sbyin zhing bsod nams dag mi byed pa dang / gso sbyong la nye bar mi gnas pa dang / tshul khrims yang dag par blangs te/ mi 'dug pa dag mang na ni rgyal po chen po bzhi po rnams sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha rnams lha'i 'dun sa chos bzangs su 'dus shing 'khod pa'i nang du song nas 'di skad du grogs po dag 'di shes par gyis shig /mi dang mi ma yin pa'i 'jig rten na mar mi 'dzin pa dang / phar mi 'dzin pa dang /dge sbyong du mi 'dzin pa dang / bram zer mi 'dzin pa dang / rigs kyi nang na rgan rabs la rim gro mi byed pa dang / don mi byed pa dang / bya ba'i rigs pa dag ①mi byed pa dang / bsod nams mi byed pa dang / tshe 'di dang tshe phyi ma la kha na ma tho ba rnams kyis 'jigs par mi lta ba dang / sbyin pa dag mi gesbyin zhing bsod nams dag mi byed pa dang / gso sbyong la nye bar mi gnas pa dang / tshul khrims yang dag par blangs te mi 'dug pa dag mang ngo zhes bsnyad zhudo—/ /de dag las thos nas sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha rnams yi ④ma rangs shing mi mgu bar gyur nas yi phyom rangs pa nyid kyang phyir zlog bupar byed de/ kye ma grogs po dag 'di ltar ⑦mi dang mi ma yin pa'i 'jig rten na mar mi 'dzin pa dang / phar mi 'dzin pa dang / dge sbyong du mi 'dzin pa dang / bram zer mi 'dzin pa dang / rigs kyi nang na rgan rabs la rim gror mi byed pa dang /don mi byed pa dang / bya ba'i rigs pa mi byed pa dang / bsod nams mi byed pa dang / tshe 'di dang tshe phyi ma la kha na ma tho ba rnams kyis 'jigs par mi lta ba dang / sbyin pa dag mi sbyin zhing bsod nams dag mi byed pa dang /78—677

gso sbyong la nye bar mi gnas pa dang / tshul khrims yang dag par blangs te/mi 'dug pa mang ba ni mi rnams kyi chos mdzes pa ma yin no/ /rkyen du bab pa ma yin no/ /legs pa ma yin no/ /dge ba ma yin no/ /de ltar na lha rnams kyi tshogs ni yongs su 'grib par 'gyur la/ lha ma yin rnams kyi tshogs ni mngon par 'phel bar 'gyur ro zhes zlos so/ /ji ste mi dang mi ma yin pa'i 'jig rten na mar 'dzin pa dang / phar 'dzin pa dang / dge sbyong du 'dzin pa dang / bram zer 'dzin pa dang / rigs kyi nang na rgan rabs la rim gro byed pa dang / don byed pa dang / bya ba'i rigs pa byed pa dang / bsod nams byed pa dang / tshe 'di dang tshe phyi ma dang kha na ma tho ba rnams kyis 'jigs par lta ba dang / sbyin pa dag sbyin zhing bsod nams dag byed pa dang /gso sbyong la nye bar gnas pa dang / tshul khrims yang dag par blangs nas 'dug pa dag kyemang na ni rgyal po chen po bzhi po rnams sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha rnams lha'i mdun rngus chos bzangs zudu 'dus shing 'khod pa'i nang du song nas 'di skad du grogs po dag 'di shes par gyis shig /mi dang mi ma yin pa'i 'jig rten na mar 'dzin pa dang / phar 'dzin pa dang / dge sbyong du 'dzin pa dang / bram zer 'dzin pa dang / rigs kyi nang na rgan rabs la rim gro thu byed pa dang / don byed pa dang / bya ba'i rigs pa byed pa dang / bsod nams byed pa dang / tshe 'di dang tshe phyi ma la kha na ma tho ba rnams kyis 'jigs par lta ba dang / sbyin pa dag sbyin zhing bsod nams dag byed pa dang / gso sbyong la nye bar gnas pa dang / tshul khrims yang dag par blangs nas 'dug pa dag mang ngo zhes bsnyad na ni de dag las thos nas sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha 78—678

rnams yi kyerangs shing mgu bar gyur nas yi ②rangs pa nyid kyang zlos par byed de/kye ma'o grogs po dag 'di ltar mi dang mi ma yin pa'i 'jig rten na mar 'dzin pa dang / phar 'dzin pa dang / dge sbyong du 'dzin pa dang / bram zer 'dzin pa dang / rigs kyi nang na rgan rabs la rim gro byed pa dang / don byed pa dang / bya ba'i rigs pa byed pa dang / bsod nams byed pa dang /tshe 'di dang tshe phyi ma la kha na ma tho ④/ba rnams kyis 'jigs par lta 3ba dang /sbyin pa dag sbyin zhing bsod nams dag byed pa dang / gso sbyong la nye bar gnas pa dang / tshul khrims yang dag par blangs nas 'dug pa dag mang ba ni mi rnams kyi chos mdzes so/ /rkyen du bab bo/ /legs so/ /dge'o/ /de ltar na lha rnams kyi tshogs ni mngon par 'phel bar 'gyur la/ lha ma yin kyi tshogs ni yongs su 'grib par 'gyur ro zhes zlos so/ /de nas lha rnams kyi dbang po brgya byin gyis lha'i 'khor rab tu dga' la bde zhing yid bde ba skyes par rig ༷nas/ de'i tshe tshigs su bcad de smras pa/ 'di ni zla phyed tshes brgyad dang / /de bzhin bcu bzhi bco lnga dang / /cho 'phrul kyi ni zla phyed la 'ang / /gso sbyong yan lag brgyad pa la/ /shin tu mnyam gzhag gnas byed 'dir/ /nga ci 'dra bar de bzhin 'gyur/ /dge slong dag lha rnams kyi dbang po brgya byin gyis ④gang 'di skad du/ 'dir ni zla phyed tshes brgyad dang / /de bzhin bcu bzhi bco lnga dang / /cho 'phrul gyi ni zla phyed la'ang / /gso sbyong yan lag brgyad pa la/ /shin tu mnyam gzhag gnas byed 'dir/ /nga ci 'dra bar de bzhin 'gyur/ /zhes tshigs su bcad pa smras pa de ni nyes par smras pa yin gyi legs par smras ①pa ma yin no/ /nyes par bstod pa yin 78—679

kyi / legs par bstod pa ma yin no/ /nyes par brjod pa yin kyi legs par brjod pa ma yin no/ /dge slong dag de ci'i phyir zhe na/ lha'i dbang po brgya byin de ni 'dod chags dang bcas pa/ zhe sdang dang bcas pa/ gti mug dang bcas pa ste/ skye ba dang / rga ba dang / na ba dang / 'chi ba dang /mya ngan dang / smre sngags 'don pa dang / sdug bsngal ba dang / yid mi bde ba dang / 'khrugs hupa rnams las yongs su ma grol zhing sdug bsngal las yongs su ma grol lo zhes nga smra'o/ /de bas na des gang 'di skad du/ 'dir ni zla phyed tshes brgyad dang / /de bzhin bcu bzhi bco lnga dang / /cho 'phrul gyi ni zla phyed la'ang / /gso spyong yan lag brgyad pa dang / /shin tu mnyam gzhag gnas byed 'dir/ /nga ci 'dra ba de bzhin 'gyur/ /zhes tshigs su bcad pas smras pa 'di nyes par smras pa yin gyi ②legs par smras pa ma yin no/ /nyes par bstod ldupa yin gyi legs par bstod pa ma yin no/ /nyes par brjod pa yin byi jelegs par brjod pa ma yin no/ /dge slong dag dge slong gang dgra bcom pa yin zhing zag pa zad pa/ bya ba byas pa/ byed pa byas pa/ khur bor ba/ bdag gi phyidon rjes su thob pa/ srid pa kun tu sbyor ba/ yongs su zad pa/ yang dag pa'i shes pas sems shin tu rnam par grol ba des ni gang 'di skad du/ 'dir ni zla phyed tshes brgyad dang / /de bzhin bcu bzhi bco lnga dang / /cho 'phrul gyi ni zla phyed la'ang / /gso sbyong yan lag brgyad pa la/ /shin tu mnyam gzhag gnas byed 'dir/ /nga ci 'dra bar de bzhin 'gyur/ /zhes tshigs su bcad pa 'di smras na legs par smras pa yin te nyes par smras pa ma yin no/ /legs par bstod pa yin te/ nyes par bstod pa ma yin no/ /78—680

legs par brjod pa yin te nyes par brjod pa ma yin no/ /dge slong dag de ci'i phyir zhe na/ dge slong de ni 'dod chags dang bral ba/ zhe sdang dang bral ba / gti mug dang bral ba ste/ skye ba dang / rga ba dang / na ba dang /'chi ba dang / mya ngan dang / smre sngags 'don pa dang / sdug bsngal ba dang / yid mi bde ba rnams las yongs su grol zhing sdug bsngal las yongs su grol ba'o zhes smra ste/ de bas na des ni gang 'di skad du/ 'dir ni zla phyed tshes brgyad dang / /de bzhin bcu bzhi bco lnga dang / /cho 'phrul kyi ni zla phyed la'ang / /gso sbyong yan lag brgyad pa la/ /shin tu mnyam gzhag gnas byed 'dir / /nga ci 'dra bar de bzhin 'gyur/ /zhes tshigs su bcad pa 'di smras na legs par smras pa yin te/ nyes par smras pa ma yin no/ /legs par bstod pa yin te nyes par bstod pa ma yin no/ /legs par brjod pa yin te nyes par brjod pa ma yin no zhes gsungs so/ /'dzam bu'i gling gi kho ra khor yug na/ 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po'i lam dpag tshad gcig tu gser kyi bye ma bdal te/ rgya mtsho chen po'i chus pus mo nub pa tsam du yongs su khyab po—/ /gang gi tshe 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po 'jig rten du 'byung ba'i tshe rgya mtsho chen po dpag tshad gnyis kyi bar du chu skam zhing med par 'gyur te/'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po gang nas gling du 'gro ba de ni 'khor los sgyur ba'i lam yin no/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis kyang 'di skad du/ dge slong dag sngon byung ba 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal pos ①glang po rin po che brtag 3par 'dod pas nyi ma shar ba'i dus kyi tshe glang po rin po che la zhon nas sa chen po rgya mtsho la thug pa 'di nyid bskor te/ rgyal po'i pho brang nas 3'khor de nyid du song nas thu 78—681

khye'u sus kyi bya ba byed do// /dge slong dag gzhan yang 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal pos 2rta rin po che brtag par 'dod pas nyi ma shar ba'i dus kyi tshe rta rin po che la zhon nas sa chen po rgya mtsho la thug tshepa 'di nyid bskor te/ rgyal po'i pho brang 'khor de nyid du song nas khye'u sus kyi bya ba byed do/ /zhes gsungs so/ /basbus pa'i mdo la/ ri dang skye gnas dag dang ni/ /nam mkha' lding dang nyo tshong dang / /grang ba dag ni lnga par byas/ /dus tshigs kyang ni tha ma yin/ /'jig rten gzhag pa las tshigs drug pa'o / /①mdo la/ srung ma lha'i grong khyer srang rnams rgyal byed pa/ /chos bzangs thurgyu ba'i lam dang 'obs dang skyed mos tshal/ /sa gzhi dang ni yongs 'du rdo dang glang chen rnams/ /lha ma yin rnams kyi yang de dang 'dra ba yin/ /lha'i grong khyer dang lha ma yin gyi grong gi dhibar du sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha rnams kyi srung ma rnam ṅkupa lnga bkod pa la 'di lta ste/ chu na gnas pa'i klu rnams dang /lag na gzhong thogs kyi lha rnams dang / phreng thogs kyi lha rnams dang / rtag tu myos kyi lha rnams dang / rgyal po chen po bzhi rnams so/ /gang gi tshe lha ma yin rnams sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha rnams dang / lhan cig tu g.yul 'gyed par 'dod par gyur pa de'i tshe/ dpung gi tshogs yan lag bzhi pa 'di lta ste/glang po che'i tshogs dang / rta'i tshogs dang / shing rta'i tshogs dang / dpung bu chung gi tshogs rnams go cha gyon no/ /go cha rnam pa bzhi gyon pa la 'di lta ste/gser las byas pa dang / dngul las byas pa dang / be+e ḍūr+ya las byas pa dang / shel las byas pa rnams so/ /go cha rnam pa bzhi gser las byas pa 78—682

dang / dngul las byas pa dang / bai ḍūr+ya las byas pa dang / shel las byas pa rnams bgos nas/ mtshon cha bzhi la 'di lta ste/ ral gri dang /mdung dang / 'phang mdung dang / gzhu rnams so/ /mtshon cha rnam pa bzhi ral gri dang / mdung dang / 'phang mdung dang / gzhu rnams blangs nas sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha rnams dang 'gyed pa'i phyir lha ma yin gyi grong khyer nas byung ngo / /lha ma yin de dag gi dpung gi tshogs yan lag bzhi pa glang po che'i tshogs dang / rta'i tshogs dang / shing rta'i tshogs dang / dpung bu chung gi tshogs rnams kyis go cha bgos te/ go cha rnam pa bzhi gser las byas pa dang /dngul las byas pa dang / bai ḍūr+ya las byas pa dang / shel las byas pa rnams bgos nas/ mtshon cha rnam pa bzhi ral gri dang / mdung dang /'phang mdung dang / gzhu rnams blangs te/ sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha rnams dang 'gyed pa'i phyir lha ma yin gyi grong khyer nas byung ba de dag chu na gnas pa'i klu rnams kyis mthong ngo / /mthong nas chu na gnas pa'i klu rnams kyang dpung gi tshogs yan lag bzhi pa 'di lta ste/ glang po che'i tshogs dang / rta'i tshogs dang / shing rta'i tshogs dang / dpung bu chung gi tshogs rnams kyang go cha bgos te ①go cha rnam pa bzhi gser las byas pa dang / dngul las byas pa dang /be+e ḍūr+ya las byas pa dang / shel las byas pa rnams bgos nas/ mtshon cha rnam pa bzhi ral gri dang / mdung dang / 'phang mdung dang na / gzhu rnams blangs te/ lha ma yin rnams dang / lhan cig tu g.yul 'gyed do/ /der ji ste klu rnams rgyal te/ lha ma yin rnams pham par gyur na ni klu rnams kyis lha ma yin thub cing rdugs par byas te pham par byas shing rgyab kyis phyogs 78—683

par byas nas lha ma yin gyi grong khyer du 'gro bar 'gyur ro/ /ji ste lha ma yin rnams rgyal te/ klu rnams pham na ni lha ma yin rnams kyis sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha rnams kyi srung ma dang po klu rnams thub cing rdugs par byas te/ pham par byas nas hūṃrgyab kyis phyogs par byas nas/ rgya mtsho chen po nas ri'i rgyal po ri rab kyi bang rim dang po gang na lag na gzhong thogs kyi lha rnams 'khod par brje zhing khye'agro'o/ /de nas lag na gzhong thogs kyi lha rnams dang / chu na gnas pa'i klu rnams dang / srung ma gnyis gcig tu 'dus par gyur nas/lha ma yin dang lhan cig tu g.yul 'gyed do/ /der ji ste srung ma gnyis rgyal te/lha ma yin rnams pham na ni/ srung ma gnyis kyis lha ma yin rnams thub cing rdugs par byas te/ pham par byas shing rgyab kyis phyogs par byas nas lha ma yin gyi grong khyer du 'gro bar 'gyur ro/ /ji ste lha ma yin rnams rgyal te/srung ma gnyis pham na ni sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha rnams kyi srung ma gnyis lha ma yin rnams kyis thub cing rdugs par byas te/ pham par byas shing rgyab kyis phyogs par byas nas / ri'i rgyal po ri rab kyi bang rim dang po nas bang rim gnyis pa lag na phreng thogs kyi lha rnams 'khod par brje zhing ④'gro'o/ /de nas phreng thogs kyi lha rnams dang / lag na gzhong thogs kyi lha rnams dang /chu na gnas pa'i klu rnams dang / srung ma gsum po rnams gcig tu 'dus par gyur nas lha ma yin rnams dang lhan cig tu g.yul 'gyed do/ /der ji ste srung ma gsum po rnams rgyal te/ lha ma yin rnams pham na ni srung ma gsum ④po dag gis lha ma yin rnams thub cing rdugs par byas te/ pham par byas shing rgyab kyis phyogs par byas nas lha ma yin gye grong khyer du 'gro bar 'gyur ro/ /ji ste 78—684

lha ma yin rnams rgyal te/ srung ma gsum po rnams pham na ni sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha rnams kyi srung ma gsum po rnams lha ma yin rnams kyis thub cing rdugs par byas te/ pham par byas shing rgyab kyis phyogs par byas nas/ ri'i rgyal po ri rab kyi bang rim gnyis pa nas bang rim gsum pa gang na rtag tu myos pa'i lha rnams 'khod par brje zhing ① 'gro'o/ /de nas rtag tu myos pa'i lha rnams dang / phreng thogs kyi lha rnams dang / lag na gzhong thogs kyi lha rnams dang /chu na gnas pa'i klu rnams dang / srung ma rnam pyepa bzhi po rnams gcig tu 'dus par gyur nas lha ma yin rnams dang lhan cig tu g.yul 'gyed do/ /der ji ste srung ma bzhi po rnams rgyal te/ lha ma yin rnams pham na ni srung ma bzhi po rnams kyis lha ma yin rnams thub cing rdugs par byas te/ pham par byas shing rgyab kyis ①phyogs par byas nas lha ma yin gyi grong khyer du 'gro bar 'gyur ro/ /ji ste lha ma yin rnams rgyal te/ srung ma bzhi po rnams pham na ni sum cu rtsa gsum gyi dulha rnams kyi dhisrung ma bzhi po dag lha ma yin rnams kyis thub cing rdugs par byas te/ pham par byas shing rgyab kyis phyogs par byas nas/ri'i rgyal po ri rab kyi bang rim gsum pa nas bang rim bzhi pa gang na rgyal po chen po bzhi rnams 'khod par brje zhing du 'gro'o/ /de nas rgyal po chen po bzhi po rnams dang / rtag tu stsos pa'i lha rnams dang / phreng thogs kyi lha rnams dang / lag na gzhong thogs kyi lha rnams dang / chu na gnas pa'i klu rnams dang / srung ma lnga po rnams gcig tu 'dus par gyur nas lha ma yin rnams dang lhan cig tu g.yul 'gyed do/ /de ④ji ste srung ma lnga po rnams rgyal te/ lha ma yin rnams pham na ni srung ma lnga po rnams kyis lha ma yin rnams thub cing rdugs 78—685

par byas te/ pham par byas shing rgyab kyis phyogs par byas nas lha ma yin gyi grong khyer du 'gro bar 'gyur ro/ /ji ste lha ma yin rnams rgyal te srung ma lnga po rnams pham na ni sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha rnams kyi srung ma lnga bo rnams lha ma yin rnams kyis thub cing rdugs par byas te/ pham par byas shing rgyab kyis phyogs par byas nas/ ri'i rgyal po ri rab kyi bang rim bzhi pa nas steng gi gzhi gang na sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha rnams 'khod par brje zhing ①'gro'o/ /de nas rgyal po chen po bzhi lha pe/rnams kyis lha'i ④dbang po brgya byin gang na ba der song ste phyin nas lha rnams kyi dbang bo brgya byin la 'di skad ces smras so/ /kau shi ka gang bdag cag srung ma lnga po rnams lha ma yin rnams kyis thub cing rdugs par byas te/ pham par byas shing rgyab kyis phyogs par byas nas ri'i rgyal po ri rab kyi ④bang rim gyi steng gi gzhir brjes phyete mchis par mkhyen par mdzod cig /kau shi ka da byultar gang gi dus la bab par dgongs shig /de nas lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis rgyal po chen po bzhi rnams kyi ltar mnyan nas sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha rnams la smras pa/ grogs po dag gang srung ma lnga po rnams lha ma yin rnams kyis thub cing rdugs par byas te/ pham par byas shing rgyab kyis phyogs par byas shing spruri'i rgyal po ri rab kyi steng gi gzhir brjes te/ 'ongs khrupa shes par gyis shig /grogs po dag da ltar gang gi dus la bab pa soms shig de nas lha rnams kyi dbang po brgya byin gyis glang po che'i rgyal po rab tu brtan pa la bsams so/ /de nas glang po che'i rgyal po rab tu brtan pas lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyi mtshan mo byertogs nas/ dper na skyes bu stobs dang ldan pa lag pa bskum ⑫ pa las brkyang pa'am/ brkyang ba las bskum ⑫pa bzhin du glang po che'i 78—686

rgyal po rab tu brtan pa 'dzam bu'i gling nas mi snang bar byas 1te/ sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha rnams kyi ④nang du song ngo / /song nas mayo sum cu rtsa gnyis mngon par sprul te/ mgo re re la mche ba drug drug /mche ba re re la rdzing bu bdun bdun/ rdzing bu re re la pad+ma bdun bdun/ pad+ma re re la sdong bu bdun bdun/ sdong bu re re la lha'i bu mo bdun bdun/ lha'i bu mo re re la g.yog mo bdun bdun/ g.yog mo re re la sel ༷snyan bdun bdun mngon par sprul te/ mgo ④de dag thams cad kyi nang na khyad par du 'phags pa gang yin pa de la lha'i dbang po brgya byin zhon no/ /de las gzhan pa'i mgo lhag ma rnams la ni nye ba'i dbang po sum cu rtsa gnyis po rnams zhon no/ /de las gzhan pa'i glang po che rnams la ni de las 3gzhan pa'i sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha rnams zhon no/ /de shin tu mgyogs te/ dper na 'jig pa'i rlung ngam/ 'chags pa'i rlung bzhin te—/ de ltar na lha 'am (gyelha'i bu mo su yang 'di skad du 'di ni bdag gi 3mdun du 'gro'o zhe'am phyi nas 'ong ngo snyam du sems pa med do/ /de nas glang po che'i rgyal po rab tu brtan pa sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha rnams kyi grong khyer lho phyogs kyi sgo nas byung ste/ de nas ④skyed mos tshal rtsub 'gyur tshal du phyin nas/rdzu 'phrul mngon par 'du byed pa de btang ste/ 'di lta ste lha'am/ lha'i bu rdzu 'phrul che zhing mthu che ba gang yang rung ba dang 'dra bar bdag nyid mngon par sprul te/ sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha rnams dang lhan cig tu lha'i 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga la 'byor cing ldan par 'gyur te/ rtse zhing dga' la dga' dgur spyod do—/ /rang gi las kyi 'bras bu nyams su pyong ngo / /ji tsam du sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha rnams skyed mos tshal rtsub 'gyur tshal du rtse zhing dga' la dga' 78—687

dgur spyod pa de tsam du lus kyang rtsub par 'gyur la/ sems kyang rtsub par 'gyur te/ de dag lus rtsub pa dang / sems rtsub pa dang / g.yul 'gyed pa la mngon par mos par gyur nas dpung gi tshogs yan lag bzhi pa 'di lta ste/glang po che'i tshogs dang / rta'i tshogs dang / shing rta'i tshogs dang /dpung bu chung gi tshogs rnams go cha gyon te/ dpung gi tshogs yan lag bzhi pa glang po che'i tshogs dang / rta'i tshogs dang / shing rta'i tshogs dang /dpung bu chung gi tshogs rnams kyi go cha rnam pa bzhi 'di lta ste/ gser las byas pa dang / dngul las byas pa dang / bai ḍūr+ya las ① byas pa dang / shel las byas pa rnams bgos so/ /②mtshon cha rnam pa bzhi 'di lta ste/ ral gri dang /mdung dang / 'phang mdung dang / gzhu rnams so/ /mtshon cha rnam pa bzhi ④ral gri dang / mdung dang / 'phang mdung dang / gzhu rnams blangs nas lha ma yin rnams dang lhan cig tu g.yul 'gyed do/ /ji ste lha ma yin rnams rgyal te/ lha rnams pham na ni lha ma yin rnams kyis lha rnams thub cing rdugs par byas te/ pham par byas shing rgyab kyis ④phyogs par byas nas shib rta byang phyogs su lha'i grong khyer gang na ba der phyir ldog go/ /'on kyang lha ma yin rnams lha rnams kyi phyi bzhin du snyegs par byed nas ⑪ der lha rnams 'di snyam du sems te/ 'di ltar lha ma yin 'di dag bdag cag gi phyi bzhin du snyegs pa las na yang lan gnyis su g.yul 'gyed par 'dod do snyam du shes nas lha rnams phyir log ste/ lha ma yin rnams dang lhan cig tu g.yul 'gyed do/ /ji ste lan gnyis su yang lha ma yin rnams rgyal te/ lha rnams pham na ni lha ma yin rnams kyis lha rnams thub cing rdugs par byas te/ pham par byas shing rgyab 78—688

kyis phyogs par byas nas shing rta byang phyogs su lha'i grong khyer gang na bar phyir ldog go/ /'on kyang lha ma yin rnams lha rnams kyi phyi bzhin du snyegs par byed na ni der lha rnams 'di snyam du sems te/ 'di ltar lha ma yin 'di dag bdag cag gi phyi bzhin du stegs pa las na yang lan gsum du g.yul 'gyed par 'dod do snyam du shes nas lha rnams phyir log ste①/ lha ma yin rnams dang lhan cig tu g.yul 'gyed do/ /ji ste lha ma yin rnams 'ba' zhig rgyal te/ lha rnams pham na ni lha ma yin rnams kyis lha rnams thub cing rdugs par byas te/ pham par byas shing rgyab kyis phyogs par byas nas lha'i grong khyer du 'jug go/ /lha'i grong khyer du zhugs nas sgo rnams bcad de/ lha rnams la lha ma yin rnams kyis mi tshugs kyang 'jigs shing skrag ①pa dang ldan pa'i sems kyis shas cher gnas so/ /'on kyang lha ma yin rnams kyis der mi brdzi 4bzhin du lha ma yin rnams kyang 'di ltar lha rnams ni lha'i grong khyer na 'dug kyang 'jigs shing skrag pa dang ldan pa'i sems kyis shas cher gnas mod kyi/ bdag cag gis geder mi brdzi'o thusnyam du shes pa'i mthong ba 'jug go/ /ji ste lha rnams rgyal te/ lha ma yin rnams pham na ni lha rnams kyis lha ma yin rnams thub cing rdugs par byas te/ pham par byas shing rgyab kyis phyogs par byas nas shing rta lho phyogs su lha ma yin gyi grong khyer gang na bar phyir ldog go/ /'on kyang lha rnams lha ma yin rnams kyi phyi bzhin du snyegs par byed na ni/ de ltar lha ma yin rnams 'di snyam du sems te/'di ltar lha 'di dag bdag cag gi phyi bzhin du snyegs pa las na yang lan gnyis su g.yul 'gyed par 'dod do snyam du shes nas lha ma yin rnams phyir ldog tesgo /lha rnams dang lhan cig g.yul 'gyed do/ /ji ste lan gnyis su yang lha rnams 78—689

rgyal te/ lha ma yin rnams pham na ni lha rnams kyis lha ma yin rnams thub cing rdugs ①par byas te/ pham par byas shing rgyab kyis phyogs par byas nas/shing rta lho phyogs su lha ma yin kyi grong khyer gang na bar phyir ldog go/ /'on kyang lha rnams lha ma yin rnams kyi phyi bzhin du snyegs par byed na ni/ der lha ma yin rnams 'di snyam du sems te/ 'di ltar lha 'di dag bdag cag gi phyi bzhin du snyegs pa las na lan gsum du g.yul 'gyed par 'dod do snyam du shes nas lha ma yin rnams phyir log ste/ lha rnams dang lhan cig tu g.yul 'gyed do//ji ste lan gsum du lha rnams 'ba' zhig rgyal te/ lha ma yin rnams pham na ni lha rnams kyis lha ma yin rnams thub cing rdugs par byas te/ pham par byas shing rgyab kyis phyogs par byas nas/ lha ma yin gyi grong khyen du 'jug go/ /lha ma yin gyi grong du zhugs nas sgo rnams bcad do1/ /lha ma yin rnams la lha rnams kyis mi tshugs kyang 'jigs shing skrag pa dang ldan pa'i sems kyis shas cher gnas so/ /'on kyang lha rnams kyis der mi brdzi ④bzhin du lha rnams kyang 'di ltar lha ma yin rnams ni lha ma yin gyi grong khyer na 'dug kyang / 'jigs shing skrag pa nga/nga ldan pa'i sems kyis shas cher gnas mod kyi/ bdag cag gis ni der mi brdzi'o ④snyam du shes pa'i mthong ba 'jug go/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis kyang 'di skad du/ dge slong dag sngon byung ba lha dang lha ma yin khyagayul du zhugs pa lha ma yin rnams rgyal te/ lha rnams pham na ni lha ma yin rnams kyis lha rnams thub cing rdugs par byas te/ pham par byas shing rgyab kyis phyogs par byas nas/ shing rta byang phyogs su lha'i grong khyer gang na bar phyir ldog go/ /'on kyang lha ma yin rnams lha rnams kyi phyi bzhin du snyegs par 78—690

byed na ni/ der lha rnams 'di snyam du sems te/ 'di ltar lha ma yin 'di dag bdag cag gi phyi bzhin du snyegs pa las na yang lan gnyis su g.yul 'gyed par 'dod do ①shes nas lha rnams phyir log ste/ lha ma yin rnams dang lhan cig tu g.yul 'gyed do/ /ji ste lan gnyis su yang lha ma yin rnams rgyal te/lha rnams pham na ni lha ma yin rnams kyis lha rnams thub cing rdugs par byas te/pham par byas shing rgyab kyis phyogs par byas nas/ shing rta byang phyogs su lha'i grong khyer gang na bar phyir ldog go/ /'on kyang lha ma yin rnams kyis ②phyi bzhin du snyegs par byed na ni der lha rnams 'di snyam du sems te/ 'di ltar lha ma yin 'di dag bdag cag gi phyi bzhin du snyegs pa las na yang lan gsum du g.yul 'gyed par 'dod do snyam du shes nas lha rnams phyir ldog ste/ lha ma yin rnams dang lhan cig tu g.yul 'gyed do/ /dge slong dag ji ste lha ma yin rnams 'ba' zhig rgyal te/ lha rnams pham na ni lha ma yin rnams kyis lha rnams thub cing rdugs par byas te/ pham par byas shing rgyab kyis phyogs par byas nas/lha'i grong khyen mchog tu 'jug go/ /lha'i grong khyer du zhugs nas sgo rnams bcad do/ /lha rnams la lha ma yin rnams kyis mi tshugs ⑦kyang 'jigs shing skrag pa dang ldan pa'i sems kyis shas cher gnas so/ /'on kyang lha ma yin rnams kyis der mi brdzi rngubazhin du lha ma yin rnams kyang 'di ltar lha rnams ni lha'i grong khyer na 'dug kyang 'jigs shing skrag pa dang ldan pa'i sems kyis shas cher gnas mod kyi/ bdag cag gis ni der mi brdzi'o 3snyam du shes pa'i mthong ba 'jug go/ /dge slong dag 'di ltar snga ma 'das pa'i dus na/ lha dang lha ma yin g.yul du zhugs pa na lha rnams rgyal te/ lha ma yin rnams pham 78—691

na ni lha rnams kyis lha ma yin rnams thub cing rdugs par byas te/ pham par byas shing rgyab kyis phyogs par byas nas/ shing rta lho phyogs su lha ma yin gyi ①grong khyer gang na bar phyir ldog go/ /'on kyang lha rnams lha ma yin rnams kyi ② phyi bzhin du snyegs par byed na ni der lha ma yin rnams 'di snyam du sems te/'di ltar lha 'di dag bdag cag gi phyi bzhin du snyegs pa las na yang lan gnyis su g.yul 'gyed par 'dod do snyam du shes nas/ lha ma yin rnams phyir ldog ste/lha rnams dang lhan cig tu g.yul 'gyed do/ /ji ste lan gnyis su yang lha rnams rgyal te/ lha ma yin rnams pham na ni lha rnams kyis lha ma yin rnams 1thub cing rdugs par byas te pham par byas shing / rgyab kyis phyogs par byas nas shing rta lho phyogs su lha ma yin gye grong khyer gang na bar phyir ④ldog go/ /'on kyang lha rnams lha ma yin rnams kyi phyi bzhin du snyegs par byed na ni der lha ma yin rnams 'di snyam du sems te/ 'di ltar lha 'di dag bdag cag gi phyi bzhin du snyegs pa las na yang lan gsum du g.yul 'gyed par 'dod do snyam du shes nas/lha ma yin rnams phyir log ste lha rnams dang lhan cig tu g.yul 'gyed do/ /ji ste lan gsum du lha rnams 'ba' zhig rgyal te/ lha ma yin rnams pham na ni lha rnams kyis lha ma yin rnams thub cing rdugs par byas te/ pham par byas shing rgyab kyis phyogs par byas nas lha ma yin gyi grong khyer du 'jug go/ /lha ma yin gyi grong khyer du zhugs nas sgo rnams bcad de/ lha ma yin rnams la lha rnams kyis mi tshugs kyang 'jigs shing skrag pa dang ldan pa'i sems kyis shas cher gnas so/ /'on kyang lha rnams kyis der mi brdzi ⑪bzhin du lha rnams kyang 'di ltar lha ma yin rnams ni lha ma yin gyi grong khyer na 'dug kyang 'jigs shing skrag 78—692

pa dang ldan pa'i sems kyis shas cher gnas mod kyi/ bdag cag gis ni der mi brdzi'o ①snyam du shes pa'i mthong ba 'jug go/ /dge slong dag sngon byung ba 'das pa'i dus na de lta bur gyur pa'i tshe①/ 'di skad du/ gang tshe lha dang lha min lhan cig tu/ /gnyi ga 'dus shing g.yul ni 'gyed pa na/ /shing rta pa ni nyi zla mtshungs med de/ /lha yi shing rta pa ni chamachog yin no/ /zhes kyang bya'o—/ /ri'i rgyal po ri rab kyi steng gi gzhi ni ④sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha rnams kyi grong khyer blta ⑤ na sdug ces bya ba chur dpag tshad nyis stong lnga brgya/ zheng du yang nyis stong lnga brgya/ mtha' skor du dpag tshad khri yod pa/ dbyibs legs shing blta ⑥na sdug la mdzes pa zhig yod de/ gser gyi ra bas bskor te ra ba'i 'phang du ni dpag tshad byed dang gsum yod do/ /ra ba de la rtsig skyabs rnam pa bzhi las byas pa yod de/ gser las byas pa dang / dngul las byas pa dang / bai ḍūr+ya las byas pa dang / shel las byas pa rnams so/ /gyen du 'phang ba'i mda' yab dang / thur du 'phang ba'i mda' yab dang /zam pa brgyud ma rnam pa bzhi yod de/ gser las byas pa dang / dngul las byas pa dang / be+e ḍūr+ya las byas pa dang / shel las byas pa rnams so/ /de'i nang gi sa gzhi dbyibs legs shing blta ④na sdug la mdzes te/ zis shing legs par bris pa tshon sna brgya rtsa gcig gis bris pa ste/ 'jam zhing shin tu 'jam pa ni dper na shing bal kyi 'dab ma'am 'aras bal gyi 'dab ma bzhin du⑪/rkang pa bzhag na ni ṣ+pems zhes byed de/ rkang pa bteg ⑩na ni par ⑪zhes byed de—/ me tog man da ra ba mang pos pus mo nub pa tsam du yongs su khebs te/rlung gi mthus me tog rnying pa rnams ni 'thor/ me tog gsar pa rnams ni 78—693

legs par bkram stekhye/ 'di skad du/ lha rnams bsod nams dbang gi ⑤mthu stobs kyis/ /lha yi grong khyer dag na rlung chen ldang / /me tog rnying pa rnams ni 'dor 71bar byed/ /me tog gsar pa rnams ni legs par dgram④/ /zhes kyang bya'o/ /lha'i grong khyer de ni srisgo stong du gcig gis ma tshang ba yod do/ /sgo gcig gi yang 'phang du ni dpag tshad phyed dang gsum/ zheng du ni dpag tshad phyed dang gnyis yod do/ /sgo re re la yang skar ma'i gzugs su byas pa bzhi bzhi yod de/ gser las byas pa dang / dngul las byas pa dang / bai ḍūr+ya las byas pa dang / shel las byas pa rjornams so/ /zla ba phyed pa lta bur yongs su grub pa dang / ba lang gi mgo lta bu dang / me long rnams kyang gser las byas pa dang / dngul las byas pa dang / bai ḍūr+ya las byas pa dang / shel las byas pa ⑦bzhi yod de/ dbyebs legs shing blta ⑧na sdug la mdzes pa yin no/ /sgo re re la yang sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha rnams srung ba'i phyir dang / bsgrub pa'i phyir dang / mdzes par bya ba'i phyir srung ma go cha bgos shing mtshon cha thogs pa lnga brgya bkod do/ /sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha rnams kyi ⑨lam srang srid du dpag tshad nyis stong lnga brgya yod la zheng du dpag tshad bcu gnyis yod do/ /dbyibs legs shing blta skyen sdug pa mdzes pa gser gyi bye ma bdal zhing tsan+dan gyi ⑪chus chag chag btab pa zhig yod do⑫/ /srang de'i glo g.yas g.yon na rdzing bu byas pa'i rdzing bu de dag gser las byas pa dang / dngul las byas pa dang / bai ḍūr+ya las byas pa dang / shel las byas pa'i pha gu rnam pa bzhi ⑫brtsigs so/ /rdzing bu de dag gi phyogs bzhi na them skas byas pa yod de/ them skas de dag 'di lta ste/ gser las byas pa 78—694

dang / dngul las byas pa dang / bai ḍūr+ya las byas pa dang / shel las byas pa'i pha gu rnam pa bzhi ①brtsigs so/ /rdzing bu de dag gi lan kan gser las byas pa dang / dngul las byas pa dang / bai ḍūr+ya las byas pa dang /shel las byas pa bzhi dukun nas bskor te/ gser gyi lan kan byu gtan ldu ma dang / gdang ④bu dang gzungs ⑤gzer ni dngul las byas so/ /dngul gyi ni gser las byas so/ /bai ḍūr+ya'i shel las byas so/ /shel gyi ༷lan kan gye gtan ma dang / gdong ⑦bu dang / gzungs gzer ni bai ḍūr+ya las byas te/dbyibs legs shing blta na sdug la mdzes so/ /rdzing bu de dag kyang chu bsel zhing chu sbrang rtsi lta bus gang ste/ me tog at+pal dang / pad+ma dang / ku mu ta ( dang / pad+ma dkar pos yongs su khebs te/ de dag la ni chu nas skyes pa'i bya sna ⑨tshogs skad snyan cing 'jebs pa dang / skad yid du 'ong ba dang /skad mnyen pa dang / 'dod dgur sgyur spyoba'i gzugs can rnams skad snyan pa 'byin no/ /rdzing bu de dag gi nye 'khor na me tog gi shing dang / 'bras bu'i shing sna tshogs pa rnams legs par skyes shing dbyibs legs la yongs su grub ste/me tog phreng bar bkod pa bzhin du gyur pa ni dper na me tog phreng rgyud dang /me tog phreng rgyud kyi slob ma mkhas pas me tog gi phreng ba tha gu la brgyus pa dang /me tog gi rna rgyan legs par byas pa bzhin te/ thang las skyes pa'i bya sna tshogs skad snyan cing 'jebs pa dang / skad yid du 'ong ba dang / skad mnyen kyepa dang / 'dod dgur sgyur ⑫ba'i gzugs can rnams skad snyan ⑫ pa 'byin to//de dag gi nye 'khor na dpag bsam kyi shing sngon po dang / ser po dang /dmar po dang / dkar po rnam pa bzhi yod do/ /gzhag gos sngon po dang /78—695
