ser po dang / dmar po dang / dkar po rnam pa bzhi yod do/ /dpag bsam shing las byung ba'i gos sngon po dang / ser po dang / dmar po dang /dkar po rnam pa bzhi yod do/ /rgyan sna tshogs lag rgyan dang / rkang rgyan dang / rgyan snang ba dang / mi snang ba rnams 'byung ba'i shing dag yod do①/ /lha'am lha'i bu mo dag gis ji lta bur 'dod pa'i ②sems bskyed ma thag tu de lta bur de dag gi lag tu 'ong bar 'gyur ro/ /rol mo'i cha byad sna tshogs pi wang dang / gling bu dang / pi wang rgyud gsum pa ①dang / 'khar rnga dang /ham shang rnams 'byung ba'i shing dag yod de/ lha'am lha'i bu mo rnams kyis ji lta bur 'dod par sems bskyed ma thag tu de lta bur de dag gi lag tu 'ong bar 'gyur ro/ /bdud rtsi rnam pa bzhi dang / sbrang rtsi dang / sbrang chang gi btung ba dag kyang yod do/ /yang thog rnams dang / khang pa brtsegs pa rnams dang / khyim rnams dang / khang bzangs rnams dang / bsil khang rnams dang / ltad mo lta ba'i sa rnams dang / zam pa rnams bud med kyi tshogs kyis mdzes par byas shing lha'i bu mo mang pos brten pa dang du/ sel snyan dang / pheg rdob pa dag gi sgra snyan pa sgogs pa dang / dri sna tshogs kyis legs par bsgos pa dang / kha zas dang btung ba ④dag kyang yod do/ /de na sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha rnams 'khor dang bcas pa rtse zhing dga' la dga' dgur spyod do/ /rang gi las kyi 'bras bu nyams su myong ngo // //du'ajig rten gzhag pa/④ bam po bzhi pa/ lha'i grong khyen gyi nang na lha rnams kyi dbang po brgya byin gyi khang bzangs rnam par rgyal ba zhes bya ba chur dpag tshad nyis brgya lnga bcu/ zheng du yang dpag tshad nyis brgya lnga bcu/78—696

mtha' skor ①du dpag tshad stong yod pa/ dbyibs legs shing blta /bye na sdug la mdzes pa zhig yod do1/ /lha'i grong khyer las dpag tshad phyed dang lngas gyen du 'phags so/ /khang bzangs rnam par rgyal ba de'i rmang rten rnam pa bzhi las byas pa la 'di lta ste/ gser las byas pa dang / dngul las byas pa dang /bai ḍūr+ya las byas pa dang / shel las byas pa rnams so/ /khang bzangs rnam par rgyal ba'i them pa rnam pa bzhi bkod pa la 'di lta ste/ gser las byas pa dang / dngul las byas pa dang / be+e ḍūr+ya las byas pa dang / shel las byas pa rnams so/ /khang bzangs ④rnam par rgyal ba'i ka ba rnam pa bzhi gtsugs pa la ⑤'di lta ste/ gser las byas pa dang / dngul las byas pa dang / be+e ḍūr+ya las byas pa dang / shel las byas pa rnams so/ /gser las byas pa'i ka tan rjodang / ka zhu dang / bye phul dang / gdung rnams dngul las byas so/ /dngul kyi ni gser las byas so/ /bai ḍūr+ya'i ni shel las byas so/ /shel gyi ka tan ④dang / ka zhu dang / bye phul dang gdung rnams bai ḍūr+ya las byas ⑧so/ /khang bzangs rnam par rgyal ba de'i phyam rten rnam pa bzhi las byas pa dag yod do⑨/ /'di lta ste/ gser las byas pa dang /dngul las byas pa dang / be+e ḍūr+ya las byas pa dang / shel las byas pa rnams so/ /⑪ khang bzangs rnam par rgyal ba la them skas rnam pa bzhi las byas pa dag yod do⑪/ /'di lta ste/ gser las byas pa dang / dngul las byas pa dang / be+e byur+ya las byas pa dang / shel las byas pa'i pha gu rnam pa bzhi skyebartsigs so/ /khang bzangs rnam par rgyal ba la lan kan gser las byas pa dang / dngul las byas pa dang / be+e ḍūr+ya las byas pa dang /⑫/ shel las 78—697

byas pa rnam pa bzhis kun nas bskor te/ gser gyi lan kan gyi gtan ①ma dang / gdang zubu dang / gzungs gzer ni dngul las byas so/ /dngul gyi ni gser las byas pa dang / bai ḍūr+ya'i ni shel las byas so/ /shel gyi gtan rngum dang / gdang thubu dang / gzungs gzer ni bai ḍūr+ya las byas so/ /bar gyi mdo la/ rmang ⑪ rten them pa ka ba dang / /phyam rten dang ni stobs ldan phyam/ /'khor sa dang ni spang leb khang / /ya phubs dag ni tha ma yin/ /khang bzangs rnam par rgyal ba la ba gam brgyad yod dorjo/ /ba gam re re la yang khang pa brtsegs pa bdun bdun yod do/ /khang pa brtsegs pa re re la yang gnas khang bdun bdun/ gnas khang re re la yang lha'i bu mo bdun bdun/lha'i bu mo re re la yang g.yog mo bdun bdun/ g.yog mo re re la sel snyan bdun bdun yod do/ /khang bzangs rnam par rgyal ba'i nang na rdzing bu byas pa yod doklu/ /rdzing bu de la chur dpag tshad lnga bcu/ zheng du yang dpag tshad lnga bcu—/ mtha' skor du dpag tshad nyis brgya yod do/ /rdzing bu de'i phyogs bzhi na them skas byas pa dag yod do/ /them skas de dag kyang / 'di lta ste/gser las byas pa dang / dngul las byas pa dang / be+e ḍūr+ya las byas pa dang / shel las byas pa'i pha gu rnam pa bzhi sdebartsigs so/ /rdzing bu de'i phyogs bzhi yang lan kan gyis kun nas bskor te/ lan kan rnam pa bzhi dag gis snga ma bzhin du/ dbyibs legs shing blta ⑨na sdug la mjes pa/bsil zhing chu sbrang rtsi lta bus gang ste me tog ut+pa la dang / pad+ma dang / ku mu ta ⑫ dang / pad+ma dkar pos yongs su khebs la/ chu nas skyes pa'i bya sna tshogs skad snyan cing 'jebs pa dang / skad yid du 'ong ba dang / skad 78—698

mnyen ①pa dang / 'dod dgur sgyur ④ba'i gzugs can rnams skad snyan pa 'byin to/ /rdzing bu de'i nyen 1'khor na me tog gi shing ④/ 'bras bu'i shing rnam pa sna tshogs yod pa rnams legs par skyes shing dbyibs legs la yongs su grub pa ste/ me tog phreng bas ⑤bkod pa bzhin du gyur pa ni dper na me tog phreng rgyud dam/ me tog phreng rgyud kyi slob ma mkhas pas me tog phreng ba tha gu la brgyus pa dang / me tog gi rna burgyan legs par byas pa bzhin te/ thang las skyes pa'i bya sna tshogs skad snyan cing 'arjebs pa dang / skad yid du 'ong ba dang /skad mnyen pa dang / 'dod dgur sgyur ⑦ba'i gzugs can rnams skad snyan cing ⑤'byin to/ /dpag bsam gyi shing sngon po dang / ser po dang /dmar po dang / dkar po rnam pa bzhi yod do/ /gzhag gos sngon po dang /ser po dang / dmar po dang / dkar po rnam pa bzhi yod do/ /dpag bsam shing las byung ba'i gos sngon po dang / ser bo dang / dmar po dang /dkar po rnam pa bzhi yod do/ /rgyan sna tshogs lag rgyan dang / rkang rgyan dang / rgyan snang ba dang / mi snang ba dag 'byung ba'i shing rnams yod do/ /rol mo'i cha byad sna tshogs 'di lta ste/ pi wang dang / gling bu dang / pi wang rgyud gsum pa dang / 'khar rnga dang / ham shang rnams 'byung ba'i shing dag yod de/ lha dang lha'i bu mo rnams kyis ji lta bur 'dod par sems bskyed ma thag tu de lta bur de dag gi lag tu 'ong bar 'gyur ro/ /bdud rtsi rnam pa bzhi dang / sbrang rtsi dang sbrang chang gi 1btung ba dag kyang yod do/ /yang thog rnams dang / khang pa brtsegs pa rnams dang / khyim rnams dang / khang bzangs rnams dang / bsel khang rnams dang / ltad mo lta ba'i sa rnams 78—699

dang / zam pa rnams bud med kyi tshogs kyis mdzes par byas shing lha'i bu mo mang pos brten kyepa dang / sil misnyan dang / pheg rdob pa dag gi 1sgra snyan pa sgogs pa dang / dri sna tshogs kyis legs par bsgos pa dang / kha zas dang / btung ba dang ldan pa dag kyang yod do/ /de nas lha'i dbang po brgya byen 'khor dang bcas pa rtse zhing dga' la dga' dgur spyod do④/ /rang gi las kyi 'bras bu nyams su myong ngo / /lha'i grong khyer gyi shar lho'i mtshams na sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha rnams kyi lha'i 'dun sa chos bzangs zhes bya ba yod de/chur dpag tshad sum brgya/ zheng du dpag tshad sum brgya mtha' skor du dpag tshad dgu brgya yod de/ lha'i grong khyer las dpag tshad phyed dang bzhis 'phags so—/ /lha'i mdun ⑤sa chos bzangs kyi sa gzhi dang / yang thog ⑥dang /ka ba dang / spyi 'dus kyi gdung dang / yang thog gi rtse bzhi dang / phyam gzum ④dang / phyam dgu po thams cad shel las byas pa dbyibs legs shing blta ④na sdug la mdzes pa ste/ lan kan gser las byas pa dang / dngul las byas pa dang / bai ḍūr+ya las byas pa dang / shel las byas pa rnam pa bzhis kun nas bskor terte/ de la sgo dang / ya ⑫phubs dang / gha na dang /yang thog gi rtse bzhi dang / lu na dang / phyam dgu po yod de/ phum ⑫dgu po re re la yang ka ba ⑫bcu drug gis ⑫brten to/ /rgyu ba'i lam ni rim pa bdun yod do④/ /de'i dbus su ⑫bai ḍūr+ya las byas pa'i ka ba zur brgyad pa/gsal ⑩zhing 'phan med la rigs dang ldan pa zhig yod de/ skra'i rtse mo tsam gyi ⑫khang pa brtsegs pa'i spyi 'dus kyi rten la mi reg ⑫go/ /de'i 'og na lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyi 0 gser gyi khri bzang po dang / sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha lhag ma 78—700

rnams kyi ①khri bshams pa yod do/ /der sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha rnams 'dus shing 'khod nas lha rnams dang / mi rnams kyi don dang / chos sems shing spyod de/ yongs su rtogs pār byed do/ /lha'i grong khyer nas rgyu ba'i lam srid du dpag tshad bcu gnyis/ zheng du yang dpag tshad bcu gnyis pa dbyibs legs shing blta ②na sdug la mdzes pa/ gser gyi bye ma bdal zhing shetsan+dan kyi chus chag chag btab pa zhig yod de/ de'i glo g.yas g.yon na me tog gi shing dang / 'bras bu'i shing sna tshogs yod pa rnams legs par skyes te/dbyibs legs la yongs su grub pa ste/ me tog phreng bar bkod pa bzhin du gyur pa ni dper na me tog phreng rgyud dam/ me tog phreng rgyud kyi slob ma mkhas pas me tog gi phreng ba tha gu la brgyus pa dang / me tog gi rna rgyan legs par byas pa bzhin te/ thang las skyes pa'i bya sna tshogs skad snyan cing 'jebs pa dang / skad yid du 'ong ba dang / skad snyan pa dang / 'dod dgur sgyur ④ ba'i gzugs can rnams skad snyan pa 'byin to/ /lha'i grong khyer 'obs bdun rim gyis kun nas bskor te/ 'obs de dag kyang zabs dang / rgyar dpag tshad gcig tsam yod de/ pha gu gser las byas pa dang / dngul las byas pa dang / bai ḍūr+ya las byas pa dang / shel las byas pa rnam pa bzhis brtsigs pa na⑤/ chu bsil zhing chu sbrang rtsi lta bus gang ste/ me tog ut+pa la dang 'u/pad+ma dang / ku mu ta ⑦dang / pad+ma dkar pos yongs su khebs la/ chu las skyes pa'i bya sna tshogs skad snyan cing 'jebs pa dang / skad yid du 'ong ba dang /skad snyan pa dang / 'dod dgur sgyur ④ba'i gzugs can rnams skad snyan pa 'byin to/ /'obs de dag na chu ka dang / rgyu mo gung dang / 'bru sna tshogs 78—701

rnams byas pa dag yod de/ sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha rnams chu'i rtsed mo la rtse zhing dga' la dga' dgur spyod do/ /'obs de dag gi nye 'khor na me tog gi shing dang / 'bras bu'i shing sna tshogs yod pa rnams legs par yongs su grub pa ste/ me tog phreng bar bkod pa bzhin du gyur pa ni dper na me tog phreng rgyud dam/ me tog phreng rgyud kyi slob ma mkhas pas me tog phreng ba tha gu la brgyus nyupa dang / me tog gi rna rgyan legs par byas pa bzhin te/ thang las buskyes pa'i bya sna tshogs skad snyan cing 'jebs pa dang / skad yid du 'ong ba dang /skad mnyen pa dang / 'dod dgur sgyur ①ba'i gzugs can rnams skad snyan pa 'byin to/ /de na sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha rnams 'khor dang bcas pa rtse zhing dga' la dga' dgur spyod de/ rang gi las kyi 'bras bu nyams su myong ngo / /lha'i grong khyer gyi shar phyogs dpag tshad nyi shu na sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha rnams kyi skyed mos tshal shing rta sna tshogs can zhes bya ba zhig yod de/ chur dpag tshad nyis brgya lnga bcu/ zheng du yang dpag tshad nyis brgya lnga bcu/ mtha' skor du dpag tshad stong yod pa/ dbyibs legs shing blta ④na sdug la mjos pa/gser gyi ra bas kun nas bskor te/ ra ba de'i 'phang du dpag tshad gcig yod la/ ra ba de la rtsig skyabs gser las byas pa dang / dngul las byas pa dang / bai ḍūr+ya las byas pa dang / shel las byas pa rnam pa bzhi yod do/ /gyen du 'phang ba dang / mthur du 'phang ba'i mda' yab dang / zam pa rgyu ba rnam pa bzhi yod de/ gser las byas pa dang / dngul las byas pa dang /bai ḍūr+ya las byas pa dang / shel las byas pa rnams so/ /de'i nang gi sa gzhi 1ni dbyibs legs shing blta na sdug byul mdzes par bris shing legs par zis pa/78—702

tshon sna brgya rtsa gcig gis bris pa ste①/ 'jam shing ⑤shin tu 'jam pa ni dper na shing bal gyi 'da' ba'am/ ras bal gyi 'da' ba bzhin du①/ rkang pa bzhag na ni ṣ+pems zhes byed rkang pa bteg na par ④zhes byed la/ me tog man da ⑤ra ba mang pos pus mo nub pa tsam du yongs su khebs te/ rlung gi mthus me tog rnying pa rnams ni 'thor⑦/ me tog gsar pa rnams ni legs par 'grems te/ 'di skad du/ lha rnams bsod nams dbang gi rkyen kyis na//shing rta sna tshogs can na rlung chen ldang / /me tog rnying pa rnams ni 'thor bar byed—/ /me tog gsar dze+epa rnams ni legs par 'grems/ /zhes kyang bya'o/ /skyed mos tshal shing rta sna tshogs can gyi nang na rdzing bu zhig yod de/ chur dpag tshad lnga bcu/ zheng du yang dpag tshad lnga bcu/ mtha' skor du dpag tshad nyis brgya yod de/ rdzing bu de yang gser las byas pa dang / dngul las byas pa dang / be+e ḍūr+ya las byas pa dang / shel las byas pa'i pha gu rnam pa bzhis brtsigs so/ /rdzing bu de'i phyogs bzhi na them skas byas pa yod de/ them skas de dag kyang gser las byas pa dang / dngul las byas pa dang / be+e ḍūr+ya las byas pa dang / shel las byas pa'i pha gu rnam pa bzhis brtsigs so/ /rdzing bu de'i lan kan gser las byas pa dang / dngul las byas pa dang /bai ḍūr+ya las byas pa dang / shel las byas pa rnam pa bzhis kun nas bskor pya te/chu bsil ba dang / chu sbrang rtsi lta bus ⑨gang zhing / me tog ut+pa la dang /pad+ma dang / ku mu ta ⑩dang / pad+ma dkar pos yongs su khebs la/ chu nas skyes pa'i bya sna ⑪tshogs skad snyan cing 'jibs pa dang / skad yid du 'ong ba dang / skad mnyen pa dang / 'dod dgur sgyur ⑫ba'i gzugs can rnams 78—703

skad snyan pa 'byin to/ /rjing bu de'i nye 'khor na me tog gi shing dang /'bras bu'i shing yod pa rnams legs par skyes ⑫ shing dbyibs legs la yongs su grub pa ste/ me tog phreng bar bkod pa bzhin du gyur pa — dper na me tog phreng rgyud dam/ me tog phreng rgyud kyi slob ma mkhas pas me tog gi phreng ba tha gu la brgyus ④pa dang me tog gi rna rgyan legs par byas pa bzhin te/ thang las skyes pa'i bya sna tshogs skad snyan cing 'jebs pa dang / skad yid du 'ong ba dang /skad snyan pa dang / 'dod dgur sgyur geba'i gzugs can rnams skad snyan pa 'byen to/ /dpag bsam gyi shing sngon po dang / ser po dang / dmar po dang / dkar po rnam pa bzhi yod do/ /gzhag gos sngon po dang / ser po dang / dmar po dang / dkar po rnam pa bzhi yod do/ /dpag bsam shing las byung ba'i gos sngon po dang / ser po dang / dmar po dang / dkar ngo/ rnam pa bzhi yod do/ /rgyan sna tshogs lag rgyan dang / rkang rgyan dang /rgyan snang ba dang / mi snang ba dag 'byung ba'i shing dag yod do/ /rol mo'i cha byad sna tshogs 'di lta ste/ pi wang dang / gling bu dang / pi wang rgyud gsum pa dang / 'khar rnga dang / ham shang rnams 'byung ba'i shing dag yod doske/ /lha'am lha'i bu mo rnams kyis ④ji lta bur 'dod par sems bskyed ma thag tu de lta bur de dag gi lag tu 'ong bar 'gyur ro/ /bdud rtsi rnam pa bzhi dang / sbrang rtsi dang / sbrang chang gi btung ba dag kyang yod do/ /yang thog rnams dang khang pa brtsegs pa rnams dang / khyem rnams dang khang bzangs rnams dang / bsel khang rnams dang / ltad mo lta ba'i sa rnams dang / zam pa rnams bud med kyi tshogs kyis mdzes par byas shing / lha'i bu mo mang pos 78—704

brten pa dang / sel snyan dang / pheg rdob pa dag gi sgra snyan pa sgogs pa dang / dri sna tshogs kyis legs par ①bsgos pa dang / kha zas dang /btung ba dang ldan pa dag yod de/ de na sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha rnams 'khor dang bcas pa rtse zhing dga' la dga' dgur spyod do①/ /rang gi las kyi 'bras bu nyams su pyong ngo / /de'i lam chur dpag tshad nyi shu/ zheng du dpag tshad phyed dang gnyis pa dbyibs legs shing blta 1na sdug la mdzes pa gser gyi phye ma bdal zhing ④tsan+dan gyi chus chag chag btab pa yod de/ de'i glo g.yas g.yon na me tog gi shing dang / 'bras bu'i shing sna tshogs yod pa rnams legs par skyes shing dbyibs legs la yongs su grub pa ste/ me tog phreng bar bkod pa bzhin du gyur pa ni dper na/ me tog phreng rgyud dam/ me tog phreng rgyud kyi slob ma mkhas pas me tog gi phreng ba tha gu la brgyus pa dang / me tog rna rgyan legs par byas pa bzhin te/ thang las skyes pa'i bya sna tshogs skad snyan cing 'jebs pa dang / skad yid du 'ong ba dang / skad snyan pa dang / 'dod dgur sgyur skyeba'i gzugs can rnams skad snyan pa 'byin to/ /dpag bsam kyi shing sngon po dang / ser po dang / dmar po dang / dkar po rnam pa bzhi yod do/ /gzhag gos sngon po dang / ser po dang / dmar po dang /dkar po rnam pa bzhi yod do/ /dpag bsam shing las byung ba'i gos sngon po dang / ser po dang / dmar po dang / dkar po rnam pa bzhi yod do/ /rol mo'i cha byad sna tshogs pi wang dang / gling bu dang / pi wang rgyud gsum pa dang / 'khar rnga dang / ham shang rnams 'byung ba'i shing dag yod do/ /rgyan sna tshogs lag rgyan dang / rkang rgyan dang / rgyan snang ba dang / mi 78—705

snang ba rnams 'byung ba'i shing dag yod do/ /lha'am lha'i bu mo rnams kyis ji lta bur 'dod par sems bskyed ma thag tu de lta bur de dag lag tu 'ong bar 'gyur ro / /lam de na bzhon pa sna tshogs bkod pa 'di lta ste/ glang po che'i bzhon pa dang / rta'i bzhon pa dang / shing rta'i bzhon pa dang / khyogs kyi bzhon pa dag yod de/ lha'am lha'i bu mo rnams kyi ①bzhon pa ji lta bur 'dod par sems bskyed ma thag tu de lta bu'i bzhon pa la zhon par gyur te/ skyed mos tshal shing rta sna tshogs can du dong nas rtse zhing dga' la dga' dgur spyod dorjo/ /rang gi las kyi 'bras bu nyams su stsong ngo / /ci'i phyir skyed mos tshal gyi ming shing rta sna tshogs can zhes bya zhe na/ smras pa/ skyed mos tshal shing rta sna tshogs can na rdzing bu sna tshogs zhes bya ba dang / shing sna tshogs dang / lo ma sna tshogs 3dang / me tog dang / 'bras bu sna tshogs dang / gos dang rgyan sna tshogs dang / lha'i bu mo sna tshogs yod la/ gang gi tshe sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha rnams skyed mos tshal shing rta sna tshogs can na rtse zhing dga' la dga' dgur spyod de/ de'i tshe yang rnam pa sna tshogs kyis ④shin tu rtse zhing dga' la dga' dgur spyod do/ /rang gi las kyi 'bras bu nyams su myong bas na de'i skyed mos tshal gyi ming shing rta sna tshogs can zhes bya'o/ /skyed mos tshal shing rta sna tshogs can gyi shar phyogs dpag tshad nyi shu na sa gzhi bzang po sna tshogs zhes bya ba zhig yod de/ chur dpag tshad nyis brgya lnga bcu/ zheng du yang dpag tshad nyis brgya lnga bcu/ mtha' skor du dpag tshad stong yod pa dbyebs legs shing blta shen sdug la mdzes pa/ lan kan gser las byas pa dang /dngul las byas pa dang / be+e ḍūr+ya las byas pa dang / shel las byas pa 78—706

rnam pa bzhis kun nas bskor te/ gser gyi lan kan gyi gtan ①ma dang /gdang bu dang / gzungs ②gzer ni dngul las byas so/ /dngul gyi ni gser las byas so/ /be+e ḍūr+ya'i ni shel las byas ⑪so/ /shel gyi ni gtan ④ma dang / gdang bu dang / gzungs gzer ni be+e ḍūr+ya las byas so/ /de'i nang gi sa gzhi ⑤dbyibs legs shing blta ⑥na sdug la mdzes par ⑦bris pa tshon sna brgya rtsa gcig gis bris pa ste/ 'jam zhing shin tu 'jam pa ni dper na shing bal gyi 'da' ba'am/ ras bal kyi 'da' ba bzhin te/ rkang pa bzhag na ni ṣ+pems zhes byed/ rkang pa bteg na ni par sgezhes byed la/ me tog man da ⑨ra ba mang pos pus mo nub btsam du yongs su khebs te/ de na mi ma yin pa rnams rlung gi mthus me tog rnying pa rnams ni 'dor/ me tog gsar pa rnams ni legs par 'grems te/ 'di skad du/ lha rnams las kyi dbang gi rkyen gyis na—/ /sa gzhi sna tshogs can na ⑫rlung chen ldang / /me tog rnying pa rnams ni 'thor bar byed/ /me tog gsar pa rnams ni legs par 'grems/ /zhes kyang bya'o/ /de'i lam srang ⑪du dpag tshad phyed dang gnyis yod de/ dbyibs legs shing blta na sdug la mdzes pa/ gser gyi bye ma bdal zhing tsan+dan gye chus chag chag btab pa zhig yod de/ de'i glo g.yas g.yon na me tog gi shing dang /'bras bu'i shing sna tshogs yod pa rnams legs par skyes shing dbyibs legs la yongs su grub pa ste/ me tog phreng bar bkod pa bzhin du gyur pa ni dper na/me tog phreng rgyud dam/ me tog phreng rgyud kyi slob ma mkhas pas me tog gi phreng ba tha gu la brgyus pa dang / me tog gi rna rgyan legs par byas pa bzhin te/thang las skyes pa'i bya sna tshogs skad snyan cing 'jibs pa dang / skad snyan yid 78—707

du 'ong ba dang / skad mnyen pa dang / 'dod dgur sgyur ①ba'i gzugs can rnams skad snyan par 'byin to/ /dpag bsam gyi shing sngon po dang /ser po dang / dmar po dang / dkar po rnam pa bzhi yod do/ /gzhag gos sngon po dang / ser po dang / dmar po dang / dkar po rnam pa bzhi yod do/ /dpag bsam gyi shing las byung ba'i gos sngon po dang / ser po dang / dmar po dang / dkar po rnam pa bzhi yod do/ /rol mo'i cha byad sna tshogs pi wang dang / gling bu dang / pi wang rgyud gsum pa dang /'khar rnga dang / ham shang rnams 'byung ba'i shing dag yod do/ /rgyan sna tshogs lag rgyan dang / rkang rgyan dang / rgyan snang ba dang / mi snang ba rnams 'byung ba'i shing dag yod do/ /lha'am lha'i bu mo rnams kyis ji lta bur 'dod par sems bskyed ma thag tu de lta bur de dag gi lag tu 'ong bar 'gyur ro/ /lam de ni 3 bzhon pa sna tshogs bkod pa 'di lta ste/ glang po'i bzhon pa dang /rta'i bzhon pa dang / shing rta'i bzhon pa dang / khyogs kyi bzhon pa dag yod do3 / /lha'am lha'i bu mo rnams kyi ④bzhon pa ji lta bur 'dod par sems bskyed ma thag tu de lta bu'i bzhon pa 'ong bar 'gyur te/ de la zhon nas sa gzhi sna tshogs can du dong zhing ci bder gnas par mngon par dga' bar byed do / /de na lha'i drang srong rnams rang dgar tshangs par spyad pa spyod do/ /de bzhin du lha'i grong khyer gyi lho phyogs dpag tshad nyi shu na/ skyed mos tshal rtsub 'gyur tshal zhes bya ba zhig yod dophya/ /chur dpag tshad nyis brgya lnga bcu/zheng du yang dpag tshad nyis brgya lnga bcu/ mtha' skor du dpag tshad stong yod la dbyibs legs shing blta na sdug la mdzes pa/ gser gyi ra bas kun 78—708

nas bskor ①te/ ra ba'i 'phang du dpag tshad gcig yod de/ shing rta sna tshogs can ji lta ba bzhin du rgyas par brjod par bya'o/ /khyad par ni 'di yod de/ ci'i phyir skyed mos tshal gye ming rtsub 'gyur tshal zhes bya zhe na/ smras pa—/ skyed mos tshal tsub 'gyur tshal na rdzing bu rtsub 'gyur tshal zhes bya ba dang /shing rnams dang / lo ma rnams dang / me tog rnams dang / 'bras bu rnams dang / rgyan rnams rtsub par 'gyur ba dang / lha'i bu mo rtsub par 'gyur ba rnams yod la/ gang gi tshe sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha rnams skyed mos tshal rtsub 'gyur tshal du rtse zhing dga' la dga' dgur spyod pa de'i tshe lus kyang rtsub par 'gyur zhing / sems kyang rtsub par 'gyur te/ g.yul la mos par 'gyur bas na de'i phyir skyed mos tshal gyi ming rtsub 'gyur tshal zhes bya'o/ /skyed mos tshal rtsub 'gyur tshal kyi lho phyogs ④dpag tshad nyi shu na/ sa gzhi bzang po rtsub 'gyur tshal ④bya ba yod de/ chur dpag tshad nyis brgya lnga bcu/ zheng du yang dpag tshad nyis brgya lnga bcu/ mtha' skor ④du dpag tshad stong yod de/sa gzhi bzang po sna tshogs can na ji lta ba bzhin du rgyas par brjod par bya'o/ /lha'i grong khyer gyi nub phyogs dpag tshad nyi shu na skyed mos tshal 'dres pa'i tshal zhes bya ba zhig yod de/ chur dpag tshad nyis brgya lnga bcu/ zheng du yang dpag tshad nyis brgya lnga bcu/ mtha' skor 'udapag tshad stong yod la/ gser kyi ra bas kun nas bskor ba ④/ ra ba'i 'phang du ⑦dpag tshad gcig yod de/snga ma rnams na ji skad bshad pa bzhin du rgyas par brjod par bya'o/ /khyad par ni 'di yod de/ ci'i phyir skyed mos tshal gyi ming 'dres pa'i tshal zhes bya zhe na/smras pa/ skyed mos tshal 'dres pa'i tshal ni ⑧rdzing bu 'dres pa zhes bya ba dang /78—709

shing rnams dang / lo ma rnams dang / me tog rnams dang / 'bras bu noms dang / gos rnams dang / rgyan rnams 'dres pa dang / lha'i bu mo rnams 'dres pa yod la/ gang gi tshe sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha rnams skyed mos tshal 'dres pa'i tshal na rtse zhing dga' la dga' dgur spyod pa de'i tshe yang 'chol khyepar 'dres te/ shing tu rtse zhing dga' la dga' dgur spyod de/ rang gi las kyi 'bras bu rnams dunyams su myong bas na de'i phyir skyed mos tshal gyi ming 'dres pa'i tshal zhes bya'o/ /byed mos tshal 'dres pa'i tshal gyi nub phyogs dpag tshad nyi shu na sa gzhi bzang po 'dres pa zhes bya ba yod ①de/ chur dpag tshad nyis brgya lnga bcu/ zheng du yang dpag tshad nyis brgya lnga bcu/ mtha' skor dudu dpag tshad stong yod de/ sa gzhi bzang po snga ma rnams na ji lta ba dude bzhin du rgyas par brjod par bya'o/ /lha'i grong khyer gyi byang phyogs dpag tshad nyi shu na/skyed mos tshal dga' ba'i tshal zhes bya ba zhig yod de/ chur dpag tshad nyis brgya lnga bcu/ zheng du yang dpag tshad nyis brgya lnga bcu/ mtha' skor ⑥du dpag tshad stong yod la/ gser gyi ra bas kun nas bskor te/ ra ba'i 'phang du dpag tshad gcig yod de/ snga ma rnams na ji skad bshad pa de bzhin du brjod par bya'o/ /khyad par ni 'di yod de/ ci'i phyir skyed mos tshal gyi ming dga' ba'i tshal zhes bya zhe na/ smras pa/ skyed mos tshal dga' ba'i tshal na rdzing bu dga' ba zhes bya ba dang / shing rnams dang / lo ma rnams dang /me tog rnams dang / 'bras bu rnams dang / gos rnams dang / rgyan rnams dga' ba dang / lha'i bu mo dga' ba rnams yod la/ gang gi tshe sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha rnams byed mos tshal dga' ba'i tshal du rtse zhing dga' la 78—710

dga' dgur spyod pa de'i tshe yang kun du dga' zhing rab tu dga' la/ dga' zhing yid bde bar gyur nas rtse zhing dga' la dga' dgur spyod de/ rang gi las kyi 'bras bu nyams su myong bas na de'i phyir skyed mos tshal gyi ming dga' ba'i tshal zhes bya'o/ /skyed mos tshal dga' ba'i tshal gyi byang phyogs dpag tshad nyi shu na sa gzhi bzang po dga' ba zhes bya ba zhig yod do①/ /chur dpag tshad nyis brgya lnga bcu/ zheng du yang dpag tshad nyis brgya lnga bcu/ mtha' skor tredu dpag tshad stong yod la dbyibs legs shing blta ①na sdug la mdzes pa ste/ sa gzhi bzang po snga ma rnams na ji lta ba ④bzhin du rgyas par brjod par bya'o/ /lha'i grong khyer gyi byang shar gyi mtshams na sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha rnams kyi shing yongs 'du sa brtol zhes bya ba ⑤yod de/ yongs 'du sa brtol gyi rtsa ba ni dpag tshad lnga bcu thur du zug go/ /'phang du ni dpag tshad brgya yod do/ /yal ga phyir gyes pa ni dpag tshad lnga bcu yod do/ /yongs 'du sa brtol gyi yal ga lnga yod de/ yal ga gcig ni shar phyogs dpag tshad lnga bcur 'dud do//yal ga gnyis pa ni lho phyogs su dpag tshad lnga bcur 'dud do/ /yal ga gsum pa ni nub phyogs su dpag tshad lnga bcur 'dud do/ /yal ga bzhi pa ni byang phyogs su dpag tshad lnga bcur 'dud do/ /yal ga steng ma ni dpag tshad lnga bcur steng gi nam mkha' khyab par 'dug go/ /yongs 'du sa brtol gyi chur dpag tshad brgya lnga bcu yod do/ /zheng du yang dpag tshad brgya lnga bcu yod do/ /mtha' skor du yang dpag tshad sum brgya lnga bcu yod do/ /yongs 'du sa brtol gyi dri rdzi phyogs su ni dpag tshad brgyar ngad ldang ngo / /rdzi phyogs ma yin par dpag tshad lnga bcur ngad ldang ngo / /dpag tshad brgyad cur ni 'od dang kha dog 78—711

gis lham me lhan ṣ+pe lhang nger 'dug go/ /sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha rnams kyi shing yongs 'du sa brtol kyi lo ma ser ba na de'i tshe sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha rnams kye ma/ yongs 'du sa brtol 'di lo ma ser ba las na da ni ring po mi thogs par 'dab ma lhags par 'gyur ro zhes nas kun du dga' shing rab tu dga' bas gnas pa gang yin pa de'i dus kyang yod la/ de'i skabs kyang yod do—/ /sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha rnams kyi shing yongs 'du sa brtol gyi 'dab ma lhags pa na de'i tshe sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha rnams kye ma yongs 'du sa brtol 'di 'dab ma lhags pa las na ring po mi thogs par sbal mig 'thon par 'gyur ro zhes nas kun du dga' zhing rab tu dga' bas gnas pa ①gang yin pa de'i dus kyang yod la de'i skabs kyang yod do/ /sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha rnams kyi shing yongs 'du sa brtol sbal mig 'thon pa na de'i tshe sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha rnams kye ma yongs 'du sa brtol 'di sbal mig 'thon pa las na da ni ring por ②mi thogs par sbal mig bye bar 'gyur ro zhes/ kun du dga' zhing rab tu dga' bas gnas pa gang yin pa de'i dus kyang yod la de'i skabs kyang yod do/ /sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha rnams kyi shing yongs 'du sa brtol sbal mig bye ba ①na de'i tshe sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha rnams kye ma yongs 'du sa brtol 'di sbal mig bye ba las na da ni ④ ring po mi thogs par me tog kha 'bu bar 'gyur ro zhes nas ④kun tu dga' zhing rab tu dga' bas gnas pa gang yang buyin pa de'i dus kyang yod la de'i skabs kyang yod do/ /sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha rnams kyi shing yongs 'du sa brtol gyi me tog kha 'bus na de'i tshe sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha rnams kye ma yongs 'du sa brtol 'di me tog gi ④kha 'bus pa las na da ni ring po mi thogs 78—712

par me tog kha 'bye bar 'gyur ro zhes nas kun du dga' zhing rab tu dga' bas gnas pa gang yin pa de'i dus yang steyod la de'i skabs kyang yod do/ /sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha rnams kyi shing yongs 'du sa brtol gyi me tog kha bye zhub na de'i tshe sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha rnams kye ma yongs 'du sa brtol 'di ldu/kha 'bye ba las na da ni ring po mi thogs par me tog gi 'dab ma thams cad yongs su rgyas par 'gyur ro zhes nas kun tu dga' zhing rab tu dga' bas gnas pa gang yin pa de'i dus kyang yod la de'i skabs kyang yod do/ /sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha rnams kyi shing yongs 'du sa brtol gyi me tog 'dab ma thams cad yongs su rgyas pa na yongs 'du sa brtol gyi me tog 'dab ma thams cad yongs su rgyas pa'i dri'i 9rdzi phyogs su ni dpag tshad brgyar ngad ldang ngo / /rdzi phyogs ma yin par ni dpag tshad lnga bcur ⑤ldang ngo / /dpag tshad brgyad cur ni 'od dang kha dog gis lham me lhan ṣ+pe lhang nger 'dug go/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis kyang 'di skad du/dge slong dag sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha rnams kyi shing yongs 'du sa brtol gyi rtsa ba ni dpag tshad lnga bcur thur du zug go/ /'phang du ni dpag tshad brgyad phyoyod do/ /yal ga dang / lo ma dang / yan lag rnams ni dpag tshad lnga bcur gyes so/ /dge slong dag sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha rnams kyi shing yongs 'du sa brtol gyi lo ma ser ba na de'i tshe sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha rnams kye ma yongs 'du sa brtol 'di lo ma ser ba las na da ni ring po mi thogs par 'dab ma lhags par 'gyur ro zhes nas kun du dga' zhing rab tu dga' bas gnas pa gang yin pa de'i dus kyang yod do/ /dge slong dag sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha rnams kyi shing yongs 'du sa brtol gyi 'dab ma lhags pa na de'i tshe sum cu rtsa 78—713

gsum pa'i lha rnams kye ma/ yongs 'du sa brtol 'di 'dab ma lhags pa las na da ni ring po mi thogs par sbal mig 'thon par/ 'gyur ro zhes nas kun nas ①dga' zhing rab tu dga' bas gnas pa gang yin pas de'i dus kyang yod do/ /dge slong dag sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha rnams kyi shing yongs 'du sa brtol sbal mig 'thon pa de'i tshe sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha rnams kye ma yongs 'du sa brtol 'di sbal mig 'thon pa las na da ni ring po mi thogs par sbal mig 'bye bar 'gyur ro zhes nas kun du dga' zhing rab tu dga' bas gnas pa gang yin pa de'i dus kyang yod do/ /dge slong dag sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha rnams kyi shing yongs 'du sa brtol sbal mig bye ba na de'i tshe sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha rnams kye ma yongs 'du sa brtol 'di sbal mig bye ba las na da ni ring po mi thogs par me tog kha 'bu bar 'gyur ro zhes nas kun du dga' zhing rab tu dga' bas gnas pa gang yin pa de'i dus kyang yod do/ /dge slong dag sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha rnams kyi shing yongs 'du sa brtol gyi me tog kha 'bus pa nas ④de'i tshe sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha rnams kye ma yongs 'du sa brtol 'di me tog kha 'bus pa las na da ni ring po mi thogs par me tog kha 'bye bar 'gyur ro zhes nas kun du dga' zhing rab tu dga' bas gnas pa gang yin pa de'i dus kyang yod do/ /dge slong dag sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha rnams kyi shing yongs 'du sa brtol gyi me tog kha phye ba na de'i tshe sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha rnams kye ma yongs 'du sa brtol 'di me tog kha bye ba las na da ni ring po mi thogs par me tog gi 'dab ma thams cad yongs su rgyas par 'gyur ro zhes nas kun du dga' zhing rab tu dga' bas gnas pa gang yin pa de'i dus kyang yod do/ /dge slong dag sum cu rtsa gsum 78—714

pa'i lha rnams kyi shing yongs 'du sa brtol gyi me tog 'dab ma thams cad yongs su rgyas pa na yongs 'du sa brtol gyi me tog thams cad yongs su rgyas pa'i dri rdzi phyogs su dpag tshad brgyar ngad ldang ngo / /rdzi phyogs ma yin par ni dpag tshad lnga bcur ngad ldang ngo / /dpag tshad brgyad cur ni 'od dang kha dog gis lham me lhan ṣ+pe lhang nger 'dug go/ /shing yongs 'du sa brtol thams cad yongs su rgyas pa'i 'og na sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha rnams dbyar zla ba bzhi lha'i 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga la 'byor cing ldan par 'gyur te/rtse zhing dga' la dga' dgur spyod de/ rang gi las kyi 'bras bu nyams su stsong ngo / /dge slong dag sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha rnams kyi shing yongs 'du sa brtol kyi mthu ni de tsam mo zhes gsungs so // //stibar gyi mdo la/ dang por lo ma ser ba dang / /de nas 'dab lhags sbal mig 'thon/ /sbal mig bye dang me tog 'bus/ /me tog kha 'bye thams cad rgyas/ /shing yongs 'du sa brtol kyi drung na sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha rnams kyi ar mo nig ②lta bu'i rdo leb yod de/ chur dpag tshad lnga bcu/ zheng du hūṃ dpag tshad lnga bcu/ mtha' skor du dpag tshad nyis brgya/ 'phang du dpag tshad byed dang drug dang dpag tshad rjobaco brgyad kyi cha gcig yod de/ dbyibs legs rgyashing blta na sdug la mjos par bris shing legs par bris pa tshon sna brgya rtsa gcig gis dz+res te/ 'jam zhing shin tu 'jam pa ni dper na shing bal gyi 'dab ma'am/ ras bal kyi 'dab ma bzhin te/ rkang pa bzhag na ni dems ṭuzhes byed/ rkang pa bteg na ni par dze+ezhes byed la/ me tog man da blur ba mang pos pus mo nub pa tsam du yongs su khebs te/ de'i dbus na lha'i dbang 78—715

po brgya byin byi seng ge'i khri bzang po dang / sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha lhag ma rnams kyi khri bshams pa yod do/ /de na sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha rnams dbyar zla ba bzhir ①lha'i 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga dag la 'byor cing ldan par gyur te/rtse zhing dga' ༄ 7la dga' dgur spyod de/ rang gi las kyi 'bras bu nyams su myong ngo / /ar mo nig 3lta bu'i rdo leb kyi kho ra khor yug na me tog gi shing dang 'bras bu'i shing sna tshogs yod pa dag legs par skyes shing dbyibs legs la yongs su grub pa ste/ me tog phreng bar bkod pa bzhin du gyur pa ni/dper na gre tog phreng rgyud dam/ ske tog phreng rgyud kyi slob ma mkhas pas me tog gi phreng ba tha gu la brgyus pa dang / me tog gi rna rgyan legs par byas pa bzhin te / thang las skyes pa'i bya sna tshogs skad snyan cing 'jebs pa dang / skad yid du 'ong ba dang / skad mnyen pa dang / 'dod dgur sgyur ④ba'i gzugs can rnams skad snyan pa 'byin to/ /de'i nye 'khor na dpag bsam gyi shing sngon po dang / ser po dang / dmar po dang / dkar po rnam pa bzhi yod de/ gzhag gos sngon po dang / ser po dang / dmar po dang /dkar po rnam pa bzhi yod do/ /dpag bsam gyi shing las byung ba'i gos sngon po dang / ser po dang / dmar po dang / dkar po rnam pa bzhi yod do/ /rol mo'i cha byad sna tshogs 'di lta ste/ pi wang dang / gling bu dang / pi wang rgyud gsum pa dang / 'khar rnga dang / ham shang rnams 'byung ba'i shing dag yod do/ /rgyan sna tshogs lag rgyan dang / rkang rgyan dang / rgyan snang ba dang / mi snang ba rnams 'byung ba'i shing dag yod do/ /lha 'am lha'i bu mo rnams kyis ji lta bur 'dod pa phyesems bskyed ma thag tu de lta bur de dag gi lag 78—716

tu 'ong bar 'gyur ro/ /bdud rtsi rnam pa bzhi dang / sbrang rtsi dang sbrang chang gi btung ba dag kyang yod do/ /yang thog rnams dang / khang pa brtsegs pa rnams dang / khyim rnams dang / khang bzangs ①rnams dang / bsel khang rnams dang / ltad mo lta ba'i sa rnams dang / zam pa rnams dang / pra skan+da na ka rnams dang / pra tsa ra ka rnams dang / gharga ⑤ra ka rnams dang /bud med kyi tshogs kyis mdzes par byas shing lha'i bu mo mang pos brten pa dang /sel snyan dang / pheg rdob pa dag gi sgra snyan pa sgogs pa dang / dri sna tshogs kyis 1 legs par bsgos pa dang / kha zas dang / btung ba dang ldan te/de na sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha rnams 'khor dang bcas pa rtse zhing dga' la dga' dgur spyod de/ rang gi las kyi ④'bras bu nyams su myong ngo / /sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha rnams kyi glang po che'i rgyal po skyed mos tshal du spyad pa sa srung gi bu zhes bya ba gzugs bzang zhing blta dun sdug la mdzes pa zhig yod dogye/ /me tog ku mu ta'i dze+emadog lta bur thal kar ④du 'dug la/ yan lag bdun legs par gnas pa ste⑨/ de'i mgo bo dbyibs legs shing blta na sdug la mdzes pa ste⑩/sngo zhing srog chags lham bu chu gsher gyi mdog ltar dbus dmar la mche ba drug yod de/ glang po che'i rgyal po sa srung gi bu'i srid du dpag tshad phyed dang gsum/zheng du dpag tshad gcig /'phang du dpag tshad phyed dang gnyis/ mtha' skor du dpag tshad bdun yod do/ /glang po che'i rgyal po sa srung gi bu'i 'khor glang po che brgyad stong yod do/ /de dag thams cad kyang gzugs bzang zhing blta ⑪na sdug la mdzes pa me tog ku mu ta'i ⑫mdog ltar thal kar /⑫du 'dug cing yan lag bdun shin tu legs par gnas te/ de dag gi mgo bo yang 78—717

dbyibs legs shing blta ༄pen sdug la mdzes te/ sngo zhing srog chags lham bu chu gsher gyi mdog ltar dbus dmar la mche ba drug yod pa sha stag ste/ gang gi tshe sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha rnams skyed mos tshal gyi sar 'gro bar 'dod pa de'i tshe glang po che'i rgyal po sa srung gi bus mgo sum cu rtsa gnyis mngon par sprul te/mgo re re la mche ba drug drug /mche ba re re la rdzing bu bdun bdun/ rdzing bu re re la pad+ma bdun bdun/ pad+ma re re la sdong bu bdun bdun/ sdong bu re re la lha'i bu mo bdun bdun/ lha'i bu mo re re la g.yog mo bdun bdun/g.yog mo re re la sel 3snyan bdun bdun mngon par sprul te/ mgo bo de dag thams cad kyi nang na khyad par du 'phags pa gang yin pa de la lha rnams kyi dbang po brgya byin zhon no/ /mgo bo lhag ma rnams la ni nye ba'i dbang po sum cu rtsa gnyis po rnams zhon no/ /glang po che lhag ma rnams la no sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha rnams zhon no/ /de shin tu mgyogs ④te dper na 'jig pa'i rlung ngam 'chags pa'i rlung bzhin te/ de na lha 'am lha'i bu mo su yang 'di ni bdag gi mdun du 'gro'o zhe'am/ phyi nas 'ong ngo snyam du sems pa med do/ /de nas glang po che'i rgyal po sa srung gi bus sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha rnams so sor grong khyer gyi sgo nas bton topya/ /bton nas so sor skyed mos tshal du phyin par byas te / rdzu 'phrul mngon par 'du byed pa de btang nas 'di lta ste/ lha'am lha'i bu mo phyerdzu 'phrul che zhing mthu che ba gang yang rung ba dang 'dra bar bdag nyid mngon par sprul nas/ lha'i 'dod pa lnga dag la 'byor cing ldan par gyur te/rtse zhing dga' la dga' dgur spyod do/ /ji ltar brgya byin lha'i dbang po sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha rnams kyi rgyal srid kyi dbang phyug la dbang byed pa de bzhin du/78—718

lha ma yin gyi dbang po thags zangs ①ris lha ma yin rnams kyi rgyal srid kyi dbang phyug la dbang byed do/ /sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha rnams kyi rgyal po'i pho brang 'khor grong khyer blta ⑤na snyug ji lta ba ①bzhin du/ lha ma yin rnams kyi rgyal po'i pho brang 'khor yang grong khyen gser ldan zhes bya'o/ /lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyi khang bzangs rnam par rgyal ba ji lta ba de bzhin du/ lha ma yin gyi dbang po thags zangs ④ris kyi khang bzangs kyang gtams dupa can zhes bya'o/ /sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha rnams kyi lha'i 'dun sa chos bzangs zhes bya ba ji lta ba de bzhin du/ lha ma yin rnams kyi lha ma yin gyi 'dun sa yang dunor bzangs zhes bya'o/ /sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha rnams kyi skyed mos tshal bzhi 'di lta ste/shing rta sna tshogs tshal dang / rtsub 'gyur tshal dang / 'dres pa'i tshal dang /dga' ba'i tshal ji lta ba de bzhin du lha ma yin rnams kyi skyed mos tshal bzhi yang 'di lta ste/ kun dga' ba dang / rab tu dga' ba dang / dga' ba dang /dga' ba'i kun dga' ra ba rnams yin no/ /sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha rnams kyi sa gzhi ⑦bzang po bzhi ④'di lta ste/ sna tshogs dang / rtsub 'gyur dang / 'dres pa dang / dga' ba ji lta ba de bzhin du lha ma yin rnams kyi sa gzhi bzang po bzhi yang kun tu dga' ba ma dang / rab tu dga' ba ma dang / dga' ba ma dang /dga' ba'i kun dga' ra ba ma rnams so/ /sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha rnams kyi shing yongs 'du sa brtol ji lta ba spude bzhin du lha ma yin rnams kyi shing yang tsi tra pa ta ⑩la zhes bya'o/ /sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha rnams kyi ar mo nig ⑪lta bu'i rdo leb ji lta ba de bzhin du lha ma yin rnams kyi yang lha ma yin gyi rdo ⑫leb ces bya'o—/ /sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha rnams kyi glang po che'i rgyal po skyed mos tshal du 78—719

spyad pa sa srung gi bu ji lta ba de bzhin du lha ma yin rnams kyi glang po che'i rgyal po skyed mos tshal du spyad pa yang ti se'i gangs ①brtsegs zhes bya'o/ /sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha rnams kyi glang po che'i rgyal po g.yul ngor spyad pa rab tu brtan pa ji lta ba de bzhin du lha ma yin rnams kyi glang po che'i rgyal po g.yul ngor spyad pa yang bzod par dka' ba zhes bya'o/ /sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha rnams kyi rta'i rgyal po sprin gyi shugs can zhes bya ba ji lta ba de bzhin du/ lha ma yin rnams kyi rta'i rgyal po yang brag 'dzin zhes bya'o/ /sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha rnams kyi lha'i grong khyer ji ltar 'khor dang ldan pa de bzhin du lha ma yin rnams kyi grong khyer yang 'khor dang ldan pa yin no/ /lha ma yin rnams kyi lha ma yin gyi rgyal srid kyang sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha rnams kyi ji lta ba bzhin du rgyas par brjod par bya'o/ /'jig rten gzhag pa las tshigs bdun pa'o// //'jig rten gzhag pa/rngu bam po lnga pa/ mdo la/ phyed dang drug dang thang cig snyematha'/ /thung dang grang dang 'grib pa dang / /zlog ④pa dang ni bsnyu ba dang / /phyogs dang shar phyogs 'du shes pa/ /zla ba drug tu nyi ma sgo phyogs su 'gro ste/ lho phyogs su 'gro ba na dpag tshad phyed dang drug dang dpag tshad kyi bco brgyad cha gcig tu 'dzam bu'i gling las yol te/ rgya mtsho chen po dpag tshad phyed dang drug dang dpag tshad kyi bco brgyad cha gcig khyab par byed do—/ /zla ba drug tu nyi ma byang phyogs su 'gro ste/ byang phyogs su 'gro ba na dpag tshad phyed dang drug dang dpag tshad kyi bco brgyad cha gcig tu rgya mtsho chen po las yol te/ 'dzam bu'i gling du dpag tshad phyed dang drug dang dpag tshad 78—720

kyi bco brgyad ①cha gcig khyab par byed do/ /zla ba drug tu nyi ma lho phyogs su 'gro ste/ lho phyogs su 'gro ba na nyin mo las thang cig spure re 'grib cing /mtshan mo las thang cig rju re re skye'o/ /zla ba drug tu nyi ma byang phyogs su 'gro ste/byang phyogs su 'gro ba na mtshan mo las thang cig ④ re re 'grib cing nyin mo las thang cig ⑤re re skye'o/ /zla ba drug tu nyi ma lho phyogs su 'gro ste/ lho phyogs su 'gro ba na 'dzam bu'i gling gi mtha' myur du spong ⑥ngo / /zla ba drug tu nyi ma byang phyogs su 'gro ste/ byang phyogs su 'gro ba na 'dzam bu'i gling gi dbus yun ring mo zhig gis spong ngo / /ci'i phyir dgun mtshan mo ring la nyin mo thung zhe na/smras pa/ zla ba drug tu nyi ma lho phyogs su 'gro ste/ lho phyogs su 'gro ba na 'dzam bu'i gling gi mtha' myur du spong ba de'i phyir na dgun mtshan mo ring la nyin mo thung ngo / /ci'i phyir na dbyed dang dbyar nyin mo ring la mtshan mo thung zhe na/smras pa/ zla ba drug tu nyi ma byang phyogs su 'gro ste/ byang phyogs su 'gro ba na 'dzam bu'i gling gi dbus yun ring du spong bas de'i phyir na dbyed dang dbyar nyin mo ring la mtshan mo thung ngo / /ci'i phyir dgun grang bar 'gyur zhe na/smras pa/ zla ba drug tu nyi ma lho phyogs su 'gro ste/ lho phyogs su 'gro ba na dpag tshad bzhi khri nas nyi ma'i 'od zer 'byung ba rnams rgya mtsho chen por 'bab pas gling rnams grang bar 'gyur te/ de'i phyir na dgun grang ngo / /ci'i phyir na ④dpyid dang dbyar dro bar 'gyur zhe na/ smras pa/ zla ba drug tu nyi ma byang phyogs su 'gro ste/ byang phyogs su 'gro ba na dpag tshad bzhi khri nas nyi ma'i snye'od zer byung ba rnams gling rnams su 'bab pas gling rnams dro bar 'gyur te/de'i phyir na dpyid dang dbyar dro bar 'gyur ro/ /ci'i phyir zla ba'i dkyil 78—721

'khor mar gyi ngo tshes brgyad dag ⑫phan chad 'od 'grib cing kha dog dang dkyil 'khor chu zhing 5du 'grib ce na/ smras pa/ nyi ma dang nye bar 1'gro zhing 'phrad ④par gyur to/ /'gro ba de rang gi dkyil 'khor las de'i grib ma byung ste/des de'i dkyil 'khor khebs shing de'i dkyil 'khor g.yogs ⑤par gyur te/mi snang bas de'i phyir na/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor mar gyi ngo tshes bcu drug phan chad 'od 'grib cing mdog dang dkyil 'khor dang chu zhing ④du 'grib bo/ /ci'i phyir zla ba'i dkyil 'khor mar gyi ngo gnam stong la rnam pa thams cad du mi snang zhe na/ smras pa/ nyi ma dang rnam pa thams cad du 'phrad ④cing 'grogs te/de'i rang gi dkyil 'khor las grib ma 'byung ba ⑧de'i dkyil 'khor khebs shing des de'i dkyil 'khor g.yogs par mi 'gyur du/te mi snang bas de'i phyir na zla ba'i dkyil 'khor mar gyi ngo gnam stong la rnam pa thams cad du mi snang ngo / /ci'i phyir zla ba'i dkyil 'khor yar gyi ngo tshes gcig phan chad 'od skye zhing kha dog dang dkyil 'khor dang chu zhing ⑩du skye zhe na/ smras pa/ nyi ma dang 'bral zhing 'gro ste/ nyi ma dang 'bral ⑪zhing 'gro ba de rang gi dkyil 'khor las grib ma chung ngur 'gyur shārkyete grib ma chung du stengur gyur pas de'i dkyil 'khor gyi phyogs snang bar gyur te/ de'i phyir na zla ba'i dkyil 'khor yar gye tshes gcig phan chad 'od skye zhing kha dog dang dkyil 'khor dang chu zhing ⑫du skye'o/ /ci'i phyir zla ba'i dkyil 'khor yar gyi ngo tshes bco lnga la rnam pa thams cad du yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur zhe na/ smras pa/ nyi ma dang rnam pa thams cad du bral te 'gro bas bral ba'i dkyil 'khor de las nyi ma'i 'od zer las gyur pa'i grib ma gang de'i dkyil 'khor la bsgribs ⑫pa de med par 'gyur te/ des de'i dkyil 'khor 78—722

snang bar 'gyur bas de'i phyir na zla ba'i dkyil 'khor yar gye ngo tshes bco lnga la rnam pa thams cad du yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /ci'i phyir zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus rnyog la mtha' rnam par dang zhing rnyog pa med ce na/ smras pa/gling gi rten ①kyis de'i dbus rnyog la/ chu'i rten 1gyes de'i mtha' rnam par dang zhing rnyog pa med do/ /gling rnams kyi gzugs brnyan gang yin pa des ni dbus rnyog la/ chu'i gzugs brnyan gang yin pa des ni mtha' rnam par dang zhing rnyog pa med do/ /gzhan yang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng na kun dga' ra ba dang / skyed mos tshal dang / khyim rnams dang / khang pa brtsegs pa rnams yod pas de'i phyir yang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor kyi dbus rnyog la mtha' rnam par dang zhing rnyog pa med do/ /gang gi tshe 'dzam bu'i gling du nyi ma shar ba de'i tshe shar gyi lus 'phags su ni ④nyi ma phyed do/ /byang gi sgra mi snyan na ni nyi ma nub po/ /nub kyi ba lang spyod na ni nam phyed do/ /gang gi tshe 'dzam bu'i gling du nyi ma phyed du gyur pa de'i tshe shar gyi lus 'phags su ni nyi ma nub po/ /byang gi sgra mi snyan na ni nam phyed do/ /nub kyi ba lang spyod kyi gling na ni nyi ma 'char ro—/ /gang gi tshe 'dzam bu'i gling na nyi ma nub pa de'i tshe/ shar kyi lus 'phags gling na ni nam phyed do/ /byang gi sgra mi snyan na ni nyi ma 'char ro/ /nub kyi ba lang spyod kyi gling na ni nyi ma phyed do/ /gang gi tshe 'dzam bu'i gling na nam phyed du gyur pa de'i tshe shar gyi lus 'phags kyi gling na ni nyi ma 'char ro/ /byang gi sgra mi snyan na ni nyi ma phyed do/ //nub kyi ba lang spyod kyi gling na ni nyi ma nub po/ /ji ltar 'dzam bu'i gling thog mar byas te bshad pa de bzhin du shar gyi lus 'phags dang / byang gi sgra mi snyan dang / nub kyi ba lang spyod kyang 78—723

thog mar byas te thams cad brjod par bya'o/ /'dzam bu'i gling gi shar phyogs gang yin pa de shar kyi lus 'phags kyi ni lho phyogs so/ /byang gi sgra mi snyan kyi ni nub phyogs so/ /nub kyi ba lang spyod kyi ni byang phyogs so/ /'dzam bu'i gling gi lho phyogs gang yin pa de shar kyi lus 'phags kyi ni nub phyogs so/ /byang gi sgra mi snyan gyi ni byang phyogs so/ /nub kyi ba lang spyod kyi ni shar phyogs so/ /'dzam bu'i gling gi nub phyogs gang yin pa de shar gyi lus 'phags kyi ni byang phyogs so/ /byang gi sgra mi snyan gyi ni shar phyogs so/ /nub kyi ba lang spyod kyi ni lho phyogs so/ /'dzam bu'i gling gi sdebyang phyogs gang yin pa de shar gyi lus 'phags kyi ni shar phyogs so/ /byang gi sgra mi snyan gyi ni lho phyogs so/ /nub kyi ba lang spyod kyi ni khyenub phyogs sozhu/ /ji ltar 'dzam bu'i gling thog mar byas te bshad pa de bzhin du byang gi sgra mi snyan dang / nub kyi ba lang spyod dang /shar gyi lus 'phags kyang thog mar byas te thams cad brjod par bya'o/ /phyogs ni bzhi yod de④/ shar phyogs dang / lho phyogs dang / nub phyogs dang / byang phyogs so/ /shar phyogs la sems can shar phyogs su 'du shes pa dag kyang yod/ sems can lho phyogs su 'du shes pa dag kyang yod/ sems can nub phyogs su 'du shes pa dag kyang yod/ sems can byang phyogs su 'du shes pa dag kyang yod do'u/ /lho phyogs la sems can sgo phyogs su 'du shes pa dag kyang yod/ sems can shar phyogs su 'du shes pa dag kyang yod/sems can nub phyogs su 'du shes pa dag kyang yod ④/ sems can byang phyogs su 'du shes pa dag kyang yod do pe/ /nub phyogs la sems can shar phyogs su 'du shes pa dag kyang yod/ sems can lho phyogs su 'du shes pa dag kyang yod/78—724

sems can nub phyogs su 'du shes pa dag kyang yod/ sems can byang phyogs su 'du shes pa dag kyang yod do/ /byang phyogs la sems can shar phyogs su 'du shes pa dag kyang yod/ sems can lho phyogs su 'du shes pa dag kyang yod/sems can nub phyogs su 'du shes pa dag kyang yod/ sems can byang phyogs su 'du shes pa dag kyang yod de/ phyogs de dang de dag la de ltar tha snyad 'dogs so/ /'jig rten gzhag pa las tshigs brgyad pa'o// //mdo la/ zla ba nyi ma gnyis kyi tshad/ /skar ma rnams kyang de bzhin te/ /zla drug nyi ma 'gro ba dang / /gnod par byed pa tha ma yin/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi tshad ji tsam zhe na/ smras pa/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor ni chur dpag tshad lnga bcu/ zheng du yang dpag tshad lnga bcu/ mtha' skor du dpag tshad brgya lnga bcu/ rngams su dpag tshad phyed dang drug dang dpag tshad kyi bco brgyad cha gcig yod de/ dbyibs legs shing blta ①na sdug la mdzes pa shel las grub pa ste/ gser kyi ra bas kun nas bskor ①ro/ /ra ba de'i 'phang du yang dpag tshad phyed do/ /ra ba de la rtsig skyabs 'di lta ste/ gser las byas pa dang / dngul las byas pa dang / bai ḍūr+ya las byas pa dang / shel las byas pa rnam pa bzhi dang / gyen du 'phang pa'i mda' yab dang / thur du 'phang ba'i mda' yab dang / zam pa brgyud 1ma rnam pa bzhi dag yod do/ /de'i nang gi sa gzhi dudabyibs legs shing blta ⑤na sdug la mdzes pa ste/ bris shing legs par bris pa tshon sna brgya rtsa bugacig gis bris te/ 'jam zhing shin tu 'jam pa ni dper na shing bal kyi 'dab ma ⑦'am/ ras bal gyi 'dab ma 78—725

bzhin du1/ rkang pa bzhag na ni ④ṣ+pems zhes byed/ rkang pa bteg na par zhes byed la me tog man da ①ra ba dag gis pus mo nub pa tsam du khebs te/de ni mi ma yin pa rnams kyi rlung gi mthus me tog rnying pa rnams ni 'thor gsar pa rnams ni legs par 'grems te 'di skad du/ zla ba'i bsod nams dbang gi rkyen gyis na/ /zla ba'i grong khyer dag na rlung chen ldang / /me tog rnying pa rnams ni 'thor bar byed/ /me tog gsar pa rnams ni legs par 'grems/ /zhes kyang bya'o/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi nang na lam srang chur dpag tshad lnga bcu—/ zheng du dpag tshad phyed dang gnyis pa cig ④yod de/ dbyibs legs shing blta phyen sdug la mdzes pa/ gser kyi bye ma bdal zhing dutsan+dan gyi chus chag chag btab pa/ de'i glo g.yas g.yon na rdzing bu byas pa dag yod de/rdzing bu de dag kyang gser las byas pa dang / dngul las byas pa dang / bai ḍūr+ya las byas pa dang / shel las byas pa'i pha gu rnam pa bzhis brtsigs so/ /rdzing bu de dag gi phyogs bzhi na yang them skas byas pa dag yod do/ /them skas byas pa ⑦dag kyang gser las byas pa dang / dngul las byas pa dang /bai ḍūr+ya las byas pa dang / shel las byas pa'i pha gu rnam pa bzhis snobartsigs so/ /rdzing bu de dag kyang gser las byas pa dang / dngul las byas pa dang / bai ḍūr+ya las byas pa dang / shel las byas pa'i lan kan rnam pa bzhis kun nas bskor te/ gser gyi lan kan gyi gtan ⑨ma dang / gdang bu dang /gzungs gzer ni dngul las byas pa dang / dngul gyi ni gser las byas so/ /be+e ḍūr+ya'i ni shel las byas so/ /shel kyi ni gtan ⑩ma dang / gdang bu dang /gzungs gzer ni bai ḍūr+ya las byas te/ dbyebs ⑫legs shing blta na sdug la 78—726

mdzes pa/ chu bsel ba dang / chu sbrang rtsi lta bus gang ba ste/ me tog at+pa la dang / pad+ma dang / ku mu ta ①dang / pad+ma dkar pos yongs su khebs shing chu nas skyes pa'i bya sna tshogs skad snyan cing 'jebs pa dang / skad yid du 'ong ba dang / skad snyan pa dang / 'dod dgur sgyur ②ba'i gzugs can rnams skad snyan pa 'byin to/ /de dag gi nye 'khor na me tog gi shing dang /'bras bu'i shing sna tshogs yod pa rnams legs par skyes shing dbyibs legs la yongs su grub pa ste/ me tog phreng bar bkod pa bzhin du gyur pa ni dper na me tog phreng rgyud dam/ me tog phreng rgyud kyi slob ma mkhas pas me tog gi phreng ba tha gu la brgyus pa dang / me tog gi rna rgyan legs par byas pa bzhin te/thang las skyes pa'i bya sna tshogs skad snyan cing 'jebs pa dang / skad yid du 'ong ba dang / skad snyan pa dang / 'dod dgur sgyur ⑩ba'i gzugs can rnams skad snyan pa 'byin to/ /dpag bsam kyi shing sngon po dang / ser po dang / dmar po dang / dkar po rnam pa bzhi yod do/ /gzhag gos sngon po dang / ser po dang / dmar po dang / dkar po rnam pa bzhi yod do//dpag bsam gyi shing las byung ba'i gos sngon po dang / ser po dang / dmar po dang / dkar po rnam pa bzhi yod do/ /rol mo'i cha byad sna tshogs pi wang dang / gling bu dang / pi wang rgyud gsum pa dang / 'khar rnga dang /ham shang rnams 'byung ba'i shing dag yod do/ /rgyan sna tshogs lag rgyan dang /rkang rgyan dang / rgyan snang ba dang / mi snang ba rnams 'byung ba'i shing dag yod do④/ /lha dang lha'i bu mo rnams kyis ji lta bur 'dod pa sems bskyed gyem thag tu de lta bur de dag gi lag tu 'ong bar 'gyur ro/ /bdud rtsi rnam pa bzhi 78—727

dang / sbrang rtsi dang sbrang chang ①gi btung ba dag kyang yod do/ /yang thog ②rnams dang / khang pa brtsegs pa rnams dang / khyim rnams dang / khang bzangs rnams dang / bsel khang rnams dang / ltad mo blta ba'i gnas 1rnams dang / zam pa rnams bud med kyi tshogs kyis mdzes par byas shing lha'i bu mo mang pos brten pa dang / sil snyan dang / pheg rdob pa rnams kyi sgra snyan par sgrogs pa dang / dri sna tshogs kyis legs par bsgos pa dang / kha zas dang / btung ba dang ldan pa dag yod do/ /de ni rjolha'i bu zla ba 'khor dang bcas pa rtse zhing dga' la dga' dgur spyod de/ rang gi las kyi 'bras bu nyams su myong ngo / /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor kyi tshad ni ji tsam zhe na/ smras pa/nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor ni chur dpag tshad lnga bcu rtsa gcig /zheng du yang dpag tshad lnga bcu rtsa gcig /mtha' skor du dpag tshad lnga bcu rtsa gsum/rngams su dpag tshad phyed dang drug dang dpag tshad kyi bco brgyad cha gcig yod de/ dbyibs legs shing blta na sdug la mdzes pa shel las grub pa ste/gser gyi ra bas kun nas bskor te④/ ra ba de'i 'phang du yang dpag tshad phyed yod la ra ba de'i rtsig skyabs ⑥'di lta ste/ gser las byas pa dang /dngul las byas pa dang / be+e ḍūr+ya las byas pa dang / shel las byas pa rnam pa bzhi dang / gyen du 'phang ba'i mda' dze+eyab dang / thur du 'phang ba'i mda' yab dang / zam pa brgyud ④ma rnam pa bzhi dag yod do/ /de'i nang gi sa gzhi dbyibs legs shing blta ⑫na sdug la mdzes pa ste/ bris shing legs par bris pa tshon ⑩sna brgya rtsa gcig gis bris te/ 'jam zhing shin tu 'jam pa ni dper na shing bal gyi 'dab ma'am/ ras bal gyi 'dab ma bzhin te/78—728

rkang pa bzhag na ni ṣ+pems zhes byed/ rkang pa bteg khyen ni par zhes byed la/me tog man da ②ra ba dag gis pus mo nub pa tsam du khebs te/ de na mi ma yin pa rnams kyi rlung gi mthus me tog rnying pa rnams ni 'dorabye / me tog gsar pa rnams ni legs par 'grems te/ 'di skad du/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dbang gi ④rkyen kyis na/ /nyi ma'i grong khyer dag na rlung chen ldang / /me tog rnying pa rnams ni 'dor ⑤bar byed/ /me tog gsar pa rnams ni legs par 'grems/ /zhes kyang bya'o/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi nang na lam srang chur dpag tshad lnga bcu rtsa gcig /zheng du dpag tshad phyed dang gnyis pa zhig yod de/ dbyibs legs shing blta ⑥na sdug la mdzes pa gser kyi bye ma bdal zhing tsan+dan gyi chus chag chag btab pa/ de'i glo g.yas g.yon na rdzing bu byas pa dag yod de/ rdzing bu de dag kyang gser las byas pa dang / dngul las byas pa dang / be+e ḍūr+ya las byas pa dang / shel las byas pa'i pha gu rnam pa bzhis brtsigs so/ /rdzing bu de dag gi phyogs bzhi na yang them skas byas pa dag yod de/them skas de dag kyang gser las byas pa dang / dngul las byas pa dang /bai ḍūr+ya las byas pa dang / shel las byas pa'i pha gu rnam pa bzhis brtsigs so/ /rdzing bu de dag kyang gser las byas pa dang / dngul las byas pa dang / bai ḍūr+ya las byas pa dang / shel las byas pa'i lan kan rnam pa bzhis kun nas bskor te/ gser gyi lan kan gyi gtan ⑦ma dang / gdang bu dang /gzungs gzer ni dngul las byas so/ /dngul kyi ni gser las byas so/ /bai ḍūr+ya'i ni shel las byas so/ /shel kyi ni gtan ⑤ma dang / gdang bu dang /gzungs gzer ni bai ḍūr+ya las byas so⑨/ /dbyibs legs shing blta na sdug la 78—729

mdzes pa/ chu bsel ba dang / chu sbrang rtsi lta bus gang ba ste/ me tog ut+pa pa hul dang / pad+ma dang / ku mru ta 3dang / pad+ma dkar pos yongs su khebs te/ chu las skyes pa'i bya sna tshogs skad snyan cing 'jebs pa dang /skad yid du 'ong ba dang / skad snyan pa dang / 'dod dgur sgyur 3ba'i gzugs can rnams skad snyan pa 'byin to/ /de dag gi nye 'khor na me tog gi shing dang 'bras bu'i shing sna tshogs yod pa rnams legs par skyes shing dbyibs legs la yongs su grub pa ste/ me tog phreng bar bkod pa bzhin du gyur pa ni dper na se tog phreng rgyud dam/ me tog phreng rgyud kyi slob ma mkhas pas me tog gi phreng ba tha gu la brgyus pa dang / me tog gi rna ④rgyan legs par byas pa bzhin te/ thang las skyes pa'i bya sna tshogs skad snyan cing 'jebs pa dang /skad yid du 'ong ba dang / skad snyan pa dang / 'dod dgur sgyur 1ba'i gzugs can rnams skad snyan pa 'byen to/ /dpag bsam gyi shing sngon po dang /ser po dang / dmar po dang / dkar po rnam pa bzhi yod do/ /gzhag gos sngon po dang / ser po dang / dmar po dang / dkar po rnam pa bzhi yod do/ /dpag bsam gyi shing las byung ba'i gos sngon po dang / ser po dang / dmar po dang / dkar po rnam pa bzhi yod do/ /rol mo'i cha byad rnam pa sna tshogs pa'i 6pi wang dang / gling bu dang / pi wang rgyud gsum pa dang / 'khar rnga dang / ham shang rnams 'byung ba'i shing dag yod do/ /rgyan sna tshogs lag rgyan dang / rkang rgyan dang / rgyan snang ba dang / mi snang ba rnams 'byung ba'i shing dag yod do④/ /lha 'am lha'i bu mo rnams kyis ①ji lta bur 'dod pa tsusems bskyed ma thag tu/ de lta bur de dag gi lag tu 78—730

'ong bar 'gyur ro/ /bdud rtsi rnam pa bzhi dang / sbrang rtsi dang sbrang chang gi btung ba dag kyang yod do/ /yang thog rnams dang / khang pa brtsegs pa rnams dang / khyem rnams dang / khang bzangs rnams dang / bsel khang rnams dang / ltad mo lta ba'i sa dang / zam pa rnams dang she/ bud rnged kyi tshogs kyis mdzes par byas shing lha'i bu mo mang pos brten pa dang / sel snyan dang / pheb rdob pa dag gi sgra snyan pa sgogs pa dang / dri sna tshogs kyis legs par bsgos pa dang / kha zas dang btung ba dang ldan pa dag yod de /de na lha'i bu nyi ma 'khor dang bcas pa rtse zhing dga' la dga' dgur spyod de/rang gi las kyi 'bras bu nyams su myong ngo / /skar ma'i gzugs rnams kyi tshad ni ji tsam zhe na/ smras pa/ skar ma'i gzugs rnams la thams cad kyi nang na che ba gang yin pa de buni rgyang grags bco brgyad pa'o/ /thams cad kyi nang na chung ba gang yin pa de dag ni rgyang grags gsum mo/ /phal cher ni rgyang grags bcu dang bcu gnyis pa yin te/ dbyibs legs shing blta na sdug la mdzes pa shel las grub pa ste/ gser gyi ra bas kun nas bskor to/ /ra ba de la rtsig skyabs gser las byas pa dang / dngul las byas pa dang / bai ḍūr+ya las byas pa dang / shel las byas pa rnam pa 1bzhi dang / mda' yab dang / ltad mo lta ba'i sa rnam pa bzhi yod do/ /de'i nang gi sa gzhi yang dbyibs legs shing blta na sdug la mdzes par bris shing legs par bris pa tshon sna brgya rtsa gcig gis bris te/ 'jam zhing shin tu 'jam pa ni dper na shing bal gyi 'dab ma'am—/ ras bal gyi 'dab ma bzhin te/ rkang pa bzhag na ni ṣ+pems zhes byed—/ rkang pa bteg na ni par ④zhes byed la/ me tog man da der ba dag 78—731

gis pus mo nub pa shetsam du khebs te/ rlung gi mthus me tog rnying pa rnams ni 'thor / me tog gsar pa rnams ni legs par 'grems te 'di skad du/ lha rnams bsod nams dbang gi rkyen gyes na/ /gzhal med khang mchog dag na rlung chen ldang / /rnge tog rnying pa rnams ni 'thor bar byed/ /me tog gsar pa rnams ni legs par 'grems/ /zhes kyang bya'o/ /de dag gi zhunang na rdzing bu byas pa dag yod de/ rdzing bu de dag kyang gser las byas pa dang /dngul las byas pa dang / be+e ḍūr+ya las byas pa dang / shel las byas pa'i pha gu rnam pa bzhis brtsigs so/ /rdzing bu de dag gi phyogs bzhi na yang them kyeskas byas pa dag yod de/ jem skas de dag kyang gser las byas pa dang / dngul las byas pa dang / bai ḍūr+ya las byas pa dang / shel las byas pa'i pha gu rnam pa bzhis brtsigs so/ /rdzing bu de dag kyang gser las byas pa dang / dngul las byas pa dang / bai ḍūr+ya las byas pa dang / shel las byas pa'i lan kan rnam pa bzhis kun nas bskor te/ gser gyi lan kan gyi gtan byem dang /gdang bu dang / gzungs gzer ni dngul las byas so/ /dngul gye ni gser las byas so/ /be+e ḍūr+ya'i ni shel las byas so/ /shel gyi gtan phyem dang /gdang bu dang / gzungs gzer ni bai ḍūr+ya las byas te/ dbyibs legs shing blta 6na snyug la mdzes pa/ chu bsel ba dang / chu sbrang rtsi lta bus gang ba ste/ gre tog ut+pa la dang / pad+ma dang / ku mu ta ④dang / pad+ma dkar pos yongs su khebs shing / chu nas skyes pa'i bya sna tshogs skad snyan cing 'jebs pa dang / skad yid du 'ong ba dang / skad snyan pa dang / 'dod dgur sgyur ba'i gzugs can rnams skad snyan pa 'byin to/ /de dag gi nye 78—732

'khor na me tog gi shing dang 'bras bu'i shing sna tshogs yod pa rnams legs par skyes shing dbyibs legs pa yongs su grub pa ste/ me tog phreng bar bkod pa bzhin du gyur pa ni dper na me tog phreng rgyud dam/ me tog phreng rgyud kyi slob ma mkhas pas me tog gi khyaphreng ba tha gu la brgyus 2pa dang / me tog gi rna 1rgyan legs par byas pa 'byin ④te/ thang las skyes pa'i bya sna tshogs skad snyan cing 'jebs phyepa dang / skad yid du 'ong ba dang / skad snyan pa dang / 'dod dgur sgyur ⑥ba'i gzugs can rnams skad snyan pa 'byin to/ /dpag bsam gyi shing sngon po dang / ser po dang / dmar po dang / dkar po rnam pa bzhi steklu / rgyas par snga ma bzhin no/ /de dag na gzhal med khang na gnas pa'i lha'i bu rnams rtse zhing dga' la dga' dgur spyod de/ rang gi las kyi 'bras bu nyams su myong ngo / /nyi mas zla ba drug tu bgrod pa gang yin pa de ni zla bas zla ba gcig la ⑧ 'gro ba dang 'ong bar byed do/ /ci'i phyir nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la bltas na mig la gnod par 'gyur la/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la bltas na ni mig la gnod par mi 'gyur zhe na/ smras pa/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor ni chu shel yang yin zhing / shel dang ba yang yin la/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor ni me shel yin pas de'i phyir na nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la bltas na ni mig la gnod par 'gyur la/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la bltas na ni gnod par mi 'gyur ro/ /'jig rten gzhag pa las tshigs dgu pa'o// //mdo la/ 'byung ba chen por 'du shes dang / /bdag tu yang ni 'du shes pa/ /nam mkha' la ni sar 'du shes/ /dus ni gnyis su byas pa dang / /78—733

skad cig pa ni tha ma yin/ /'byung ba chen po bzhi ni sa'i khams dang / chu'i khams dang / me'i khams dang / rlung gi khams dang / sems can sa la sar 'du shes pa dag kyang yod/ chur 'du shes pa dag kyang yod/ mer 'du shes pa dag kyang yod/ rlung du 'du shes pa dag kyang yod①/ sems can chu la sar 'du shes pa dag kyang yod/ chur 'du shes pa dag kyang yod/ mer 'du shes pa dag kyang yod/ rlung du 'du shes pa dag kyang yod do/ /sems can me la sar 'du shes pa dag kyang yod/ chur 'du shes pa dag kyang yod/mer 'du shes pa dag kyang yod/ rlung du 'du shes pa dag kyang yod do/ /sems can rlung la sar 'du shes pa dag kyang sneyod/ chur 'du shes pa dag kyang yod/ mer 'du shes pa dag kyang yod/ rlung du 'du shes pa dag kyang yod do/ /sems can sa la bdag tu 'du shes pa dag kyang yod/ chur 'du shes pa dag kyang yod/ mer 'du shes pa dag kyang yod/ rlung du 'du shes pa dag kyang yod do/ /sems can sa la bdag tu 'du shes pa dag kyang yod de/rtsisa'i khams gang yin pa de ni bdag yin la/ bdag gang yin pa de ni sa yin te/de ltar sa dang bdag gnyis su dbyer med cing tha dad ④pa ma yin te/ bdag gi bdag ni rdzogs pa yin no zhes nas de dag sa la bkur snyir byed/ btsun par byed/ ri mor byed/ mchod par byed do/ /de dag gis bkur ster byas / btsun pa/ra byas/ ri mor byas so/ /mchod par byas nas/dga' zhing mgu la yi derangs te/ bkur ster byed cing nye bar brten 9te/gnas la sems kyis lung bstan pa yin no/ /sems can chu dang me dang rlung la bdag tu 'du shes pa dag kyang yod de/ rlung gang yin pa de ni bdag yin la/78—734

bdag gang yin pa de ni rlung yin te/ de ltar rlung dang bdag gnyis su dbyer med cing tha dad pa ma yin te/ bdag gis bdag ni rdzogs pa yin no zhes nas de dag rlung las 1bkur ster byed/ btsun par byed/ ri mor byed/mchod par byed do/ /de dag gis bkur ster byas/ btsun par byas/ ri mor byas②/ mchod par byas nas dga' zhing mgu la yi ldurangs te/ bkur ster byed cing nye bar brten ④te gnas la sems kyis lung bstan pa yin no/ /sems can sa la nam mkhar 'du shes pa dag kyang yod do/ /nam mkha' la sar 'du shes pa dag kyang yod do/ /sa la nam mkhar 'du shes pa ji ltar srobu zhe na/nyil rmed ⑪pa'i mi la la zhig gis khron pa brko ba'i mi 'ga' zhig la 'di skad du/kye sdong po me reg ma dang 'dra ba'i mi glang mthong ngam zhes smras so/ /des smras pa—/ ma mthong ngo / /til za'am mi za/ smras pa mi za'o zhes so/ /de ltar na sa la nam mkhar 'du shes pa yin no/ /ji ltar na nam mkha' la sar 'du shes she na/ smras pa/ ji ltar bram ze la la zhig bong bu'i shing rtas song nas bong bu'i shing rta las babs te/ bong bu'i shing rta phur bu la btags nas phur bu nam mkha' la btab te⑫/ btsugs nas mgo la bas khyadakris te/ sa la gan rkyal du nyal ba de bzhin du nam mkha' la sar 'du shes pa yin no/ /lo gcig la dus gcig tu mtshan mo ni yud tsam bco brgyad/ nyin mo ni yud tsam bcu gnyis yod do/ /lo gcig la dus gcig tu mtshan mo ni yud tsam bco brgyad—/ nyin mo ni yud tsam bcu gnyis pa de gang zhe na/ dgun rdo/zla tha chungs yar gyi ngo tshes brgyad la mtshan mo ni yud tsam bco brgyad/ nyin mo ni yud tsam bcu gnyis yod do/ /tshes dgu phan chad ni mtshan mo ni 'bri/ nyin 78—735

mo ni skye ste/ mtshan mo ni thang cig re res 'azi'o/ /nyin mo ni thang cig re res skye'o/ /lo gcig la dus gcig tu nyin mo ni yud tsam bco brgyad/mtshan mo ni yud tsam bcu gnyis k+ṇiyod de/ lo gcig la dus gcig tu nyin mo ni yud tsam bco brgyad/ mtshan mo ni yud tsam bcu gnyis pa de gang zhe na/smras pa/ ston zla geb yar gyi ngo tshes brgyad la nyin mo ni yud tsam bco brgyad/mtshan mo ni yud tsam bcu gnyis yod do/ /tshes dgu phan chad ni nyin mo 'bri/mtshan mo ni skye ste/ nyin mo ni thang cig re res 'bri'o/ /mtshan mo ni thang cig re res skye'o/ /lo gcig la dus gnyis su mtshan mo yang yud tsam bco lnga/nyin mo la yang yud tsam bco lnga pa yod de/ lo gcig la dus gnyis su mtshan mo yang yud tsam bco lnga/ nyin mo yang yud tsam ldubaco lnga pa de dag ④gang zhe na/smras pa/ dpyid zla tha chungs yar gyi ngo tshes brgyad dang ston zla tha chungs yar gyi ngo tshes brgyad la mtshan mo yang yud tsam bco lnga/ nyin mo yang yud tsam bco lnga yod do/ /chos bzhi yod de/ bzhi gang zhe na④/ skad cig dang / de'i skad cig dang / thang cig dang / yud tsam rnams so/ /skad cig ⑥brgya nyi shu la ni de'i skad cig go/ /de'i skad cig drug cu la ni thang cig ④go/ /thang cig rkyesum cu la ni yud tsam cig go/ /yud tsam sum cu la ni nyin zhag gcig byego/ /nyin zhag sum cu'i cha gcig ni yud tsam gcig ⑫go/ /yud tsam gyi sum cu cha gcig ni thang cig te go/ /thang cig ⑪gi drug cu cha gcig ni de'i skad cig go/ /de'i skad cig gi skyebargya nyi shu'i cha gcig gi skad cig go/ /skad cig gi tshad ji tsam zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ bud med bal 'khal ba 'bring gis ha cang mi ring ha cang mi thung bar bal bsnyad pa de tsam gyi yun ni skad cig gi tshad yin no/ /de lta 78—736

bu'i skad cig brgya nyi shu la de'i skad cig go/ /de'i skad cig de lta bu drug cu la thang cig hūṃgo/ /thang cig 'de lta bu sum cu la yud tsam gcig go/ /yud tsam de lta bu sum cu la nyin zhag gcig go/ /nyin zhag de sum cu la zla ba gcig go/ /zla ba bcu gnyis la lo gcig go/ /'jig rten gzhag pa las tshigs ③bcu pa'o// //gleng gzhi ni yul mnyan du yod pa ste/ bcom ldan 'das kyis 'di skad du / bskal pa ni grangs med pa bzhi ste/ grangs med pa dag gis thubaskal pa 'jig go/ /grangs med pa dag gis bskal pa zhig par gnas so/ /grangs med pa dag gis 'chags pyeso/ /grangs med pa dag gis bskal pa 'chags dzi par gnas so zhes gsungs so/ /bar gyi bskal pa brgyad cu la ni bskal pa chen po gcig ste/ bar gyi bskal pa nyi shus ni 'jig rten 'jig go/ /bar gyi bskal pa nyi shus ni 'jig rten zhig par gnas so/ /bar gyi bskal pa nyi shus ni 'jig rten 'chags so/ /bar gyi bskal pa nyi shus ni 'jig rten 'chags par gnas so/ /'jig pa ni rnam pa gsum ste/ mes 'jig pa dang / chus 'jig pa dang / rlung gis 'jig pa'o/ /'jig pa gsum gyi tsortse mo ni 'od gsal ba byedang / dge rgyas dang / 'bras bu che ba rnams te/ gang gi /tshe mes 'jig pa 'byung ba de'i tshe 'od gsal kyi lha rnams la 'jig pa'i rtse mo thug go/ /gang gi tshe chus 'jig pa ⑫'byung ba de'i tshe/ dge rgyas kyi lha rnams la 'jig pa'i rtse mo thug go/ /gang gi tshe rlung gis 'jig pa 'byung ba de'i tshe 'bras bu che ba'i lha rnams la kye'ajig pa'i rtse mo thug go/ /mes 'jig pa lan bdun zhing chus 'jig pa lan gcig⑫ /chus 'jig pa lan bdun zhing rlung gis 'jig pa 78—737

lan bdun 'byung ngo / /bar gye bskal pa ni gsum ste/ mtshon kyi bar gyi bskal pa dang / nad kyi bar gyi bskal pa dang / mu ge'i bar gyi bskal pa ste/bskal pa ni mtshon dang nad dang mu ge gsum gyis mtha' nyuthug par 'gyur ro/ /gang gi tshe mtshon gyi bar gyi bskal pa 'ong du cha zhing 'byung du nye bar gyur pa de'i tshe mi rnams kyi tshe lo bcu thub par gyur te/ tshe lo bcu pa'i mi rnams kyi nang na gang yun ring du 'tsho ba des lo bcu thub ste dper na da ltar kyi mi rnams kyi nang na gang yun ring du 'tsho zhing ci legs ci bder rim gro byed pa des lo brgya'am/cung zad lhag par thub pa de bzhin du tshe lo bcu pa'i mi rnams kyi nang na yang zhuyun ring du 'tsho ba des lo bcu thub po/ /tshe lo bcu pa'i mi rnams kyi bu gcig pa snyug byung yid du 'ong ba la mas legs su smon pa na bdag gi bu lo bcu pa'i bar du yun ring du 'tsho bar gyur cig ces legs su smon par ldu byed de/dper na da ltar gyi mi rnams kyi bu gcig pa sdug cing yid du 'ong ba la mas legs su smon pa na 'di skad du/ bdag gi bu lo brgya'i bar du yun ring du 'tsho bar gyur cig ces legs su smon par byed pa de bzhin du/ tshe lo bcu pa'i mi rnams kyi bu gcig pa sdug cing yid du 'ong ba la mas legs su smon pa na 'di skad du/ bdag gi bu lo bcu pa'i bar du yun ring du 'tsho bar gyur cig ces legs su smon par byed do/ /tshe lo bcu pa'i mi rnams kyi bu mo btsas nas zla ba lnga lon pa na khyem thab la gtong bar 'gyur te/ dper na da ltar gyi mi rnams kyi bu mo lo bco lnga'am/ lo ④bcu drug lon pa na khyim thab la gtong ba de bzhin du/ tshe lo bcu pa'i mi rnams kyi bu mo btsas nas zla ba lnga lon pa na khyem thab la gtong bar 'gyur ro/ /tshe lo bcu pa'i mi rmams kyi gos kyi nang na skra'i 78—738

la ba mchog tu gyur te/ dper na da ltar kyi mi rnams kyi gos ka shi ka'i ras phra mo'am / zar ma'i ras phra mo'am/ du gu la'i ras phra mo'am/ ko tam pa'i ras phra mo mchog yin pa de bzhin du/ tshe lo bcu pa'i mi rnams kyi gos kyi nang na skra'i la ba mchog tu 'gyur ro/ /tshe lo bcu pa'i mi rnams kyi kha zas kyi nang na ko ṭa ba mchog tu 'gyur te/ dper na da ltar gyi mi rnams ① kyi nang na 'bras sā ṭulu'i chan nag bo'i bag gsal kyeb tshod ma dang / zhu thu ba dang / bya na thusna tshogs dang ldan pa mchog yin pa de bzhin du/ tshe lo bcu pa'i mi rnams kyi zas kyi ṭu nang na ko ṭa ba mchog tu 'gyur ro/ /tshe lo bcu pa'i mi rnams kyi ro rnam pa lnga nub par 'gyur te/ lnga gang zhe na/ 'o ma yang yod zho yang yod mod kyi mar mi 'byung ngo / /til yang yod til byi phye ma yang yod mod kyi til mar mi 'byung ngo / /sbrang bu yang yod spra tshil ④yang yod mod kyi sbrang rtsi mi 'byung ngo / /bu ram shing yang yod khu ba yang yod mod kyi bu ram du mi 'gyur ro//lan tshwa ⑧ni gtan med par 'gyur ro/ /tshe lo bcu pa'i mi rnams la 9snamatshon chas brgyan par 'gyur zhing mtshon chas bzhag par 'gyur te/ dper na da ltar bye mi rnams kyi rgyan mgul gdub bam/ gdu bu rgyan can nam/ rna cha gdub 'khor rnams sam/ dpung rgyan rnams sam/ lag pa'i rgyan rnams sam/rkang pa'i rgyan rnams sam/ sor gdub kyi rgyan rnams sam/ gser dngul kyi phreng ba thogs pa de bzhin du tshe lo bcu pa'i mi rnams mtshon chas brgyan cing mtshon chas bzhag par 'gyur ro/ /tshe lo bcu pa'i mi rnams kyi nang na gang mar mi 'dzin pa dang / phar mi 'dzin pa dang / dge sbyong du mi 'dzin pa dang /bram zer mi 'dzin pa de dag bkur ba dang / gces su byas pa dang / rab 78—739

tu bsngags par 'gyur te/ dper na da ltar gyi mi rnams kyi nang na gang mar 'dzin pa dang / phar 'dzin pa dang / dge spyong du 'dzin pa dang / bram zer 'dzin pa de dag bkur zhing gces par bya ba dang / rab tu bsngags pa de bzhin du/ tshe lo bcu pa'i mi rnams kyi nang na gang mar mi 'dzin pa dang /phar mi 'dzin pa dang / dge spyong du mi 'dzin pa dang / bram zer mi 'dzin pa de dag bkur zhing gces su bya ba shesnadang / rab tu bsngags par 'gyur ro//tshe lo bcu pa'i mi rnams sems can gcig gis gcig mthong na shas cher tūzhe sdang ba'i sems dang / gsad zhupa'i sems nye bar gnas par 'gyur te/dper na da ltar gye mi rnams la ri dwags kyi rngon pas dgon pa'i ri dwags mthong na shas cher zhe sdang ba'i sems dang / gsad ④pa'i sems nye bar gnas par 'gyur ba thude bzhin du tshe lo bcu pa'i mi rnams gcig gis gcig mthong na/shas cher zhe sdang ba'i sems dang / gsad ⑥pa'i sems nye bar gnas par 'gyur ro/ /tshe lo bcu pa'i mi rnams kyi gnas rnams su zhag bdun du mtshon 'byung bar 'gyur te/ de dag gis shing ngam/ gseg ma'am/ gyo mo'ang rung ste/ gang dang gang la nom pa de dag thams cad mtshon cha shin tu klurno zhing 'jebs par 'gyur te/ shin tu rno zhing 'jebs pa de dang / de dag gis gcig la/ gcig srog dang bral bar byed de/ gnyen 'dun zad pa dang /longs spyod zad pa dang / nor zad par 'gyur ro/ /mtshon gyi bar gyi bskal pa de yang zhag bdun kho nar zad de/ zhag bdun 'das nas mthar thug par brjod par bya'o/ /de'i tshe gang su yang rung ste/ shi ba de dag thams cad lus dang bral nas sems can dmyal ba rnams su skye bar 'gyur ro/ /de na mi gang 78—740

dag mtshon gyi bar gyi bskal pa des ldog ⑫cing 'dzem par 'gyur la/ smod cing rnam par smod pa de dag las kha cig ni chu'i rdzong dang / ri'i rdzong dang / rdza stug po dang / nags tshal stug po dag tu zhugs te/ der zhag bdun gyi bar du rtsa ba dang / chus 'tsho zhing 'dug nas grong dang / grong rdal dang / yul 'khor dang / rgyal po'i pho brang 'khor dag ④tu phyir log ste/ sems can de dag gcig gis gcig mthong na shas cher zhubyams pa dang / sdug pa dang / gus pa dang / snying brtse ba'i sems nye bar gnas par 'gyur te/ 'di skad du/ thukye ma sems can gson po mthong ngo / /⑤kye ma sems can gson po mthong ngo zhes khu'adzer to/ /dper na da ltar gyi mi rnams kyi ma la bu gcig pa sdug pa yid du 'ong ba zhig yod la/ zla ba brgyad dam zla ba dgu lon te phrad na shas cher tsu byams pa dang / snyug pa dang / gus pa dang / snying brtse ba'i sems nye bar gnas pa 'di skad du kye ma bu gson po mthong ngo kye ma bu gson po mthong ngo zhes zer ba de bzhin du/ sems can de dag spugacig mthong na shas cher byams pa dang / sdug pa dang / gus pa dang / snying brtse ba'i sems nye bar gnas par 'gyur te/ 'di skad du/ kyekye ma sems can gson po mthong ngo / /ṅkukye ma sems can gson po mthong ngo zhes kyang 'dzer to // //15bar kyi mdo la/ ring du gang 'tsho ma dang bu mo dang / /gos dang zas dang nub par 'gyur ba dang / /rgyan rnams dang ni bkur dang sdang ba dang / /zhag bdun gnas rnams su ni mtshon cha 'byung / /sems can de dag 'di skad du / bdag cag mtshon chas srog gcod pa 'dis gcig la gcig rnam par brlag pa la zhugs pas gnyen ⑫'dun zad par gyur cing longs spyod zad pa dang 78—741

nor zad par gyur gyi 2bdag cag gis 3 dge ba'i chos 'ga' zhig yang dag par blangs te 'khod par bya na bdag cag gi dge ba'i chos gang zhig yang dag par blangs te 'khod par bya snyam du sems so/ /de dag 'di snyam du kye ma bdag cag gi srog gcod pa yin gyi bdag cag gis zhumatshon chas srog gcod pa spang bar bya'o zhes nas de dag mtshon chas srog gcod pa spang ④ngo tshe lo bcu pa'i mis shematshon chas srog gcod pa spong ba de dag gi bu dang bu mo btsas pa rnams tshe lo nyi shu thub par gyur to/ /tshe lo nyi shu pa'i mi rnams 'di snyam du/kye ma dge ba'i chos rnams yang dag par blangs pa'i phyir tshe yang nur la kha dog dang stobs dang / bde ba dang longs spyod dag kyang 'phel bar snang gidu /yang lhag par dge ba'i chos 'ga' zhig yang dag par blangs te/ 'khod par bya na bdag cag gis dge ba'i chos gang zhig yang dag par blangs te 'khod par bya snyam du sems so/ /de dag 'di snyam du kye ma bdag cag ni ma byin par len pa yin gyi/ bdag cag gis ma byin par len pa spang bar bya'o zhes nas de dag ma byen par len pa spong ngo / /tshe lo nyi shu pa'i mi ma byin par len pa spong ba de dag gi bu dang bu mo btsas pa rnams tshe lo bzhi bcu thub par gyur te/ de dag las kha cig ni tshe lo lnga bcu thub par gyur to/ /tshe lo lnga gyebacu pa'i mi rnams 'di snyam du kye ༄8dge ba'i chos rnams yang dag par blangs pa'i phyir tshe yang nur la kha dog dang stobs dang bde ba dang longs spyod dag kyang 'phel bar snang gi/⑨/bdag cag gis yang lhag par dge ba'i chos 'ga' zhig yang dag par blangs te 'khod par bya na/ bdag cag gis dge ba'i chos gang zhig yang dag par blangs te 'khod par bya snyam du sems so/ /de dag 'di snyam du kye ma ⑫bdag 78—742

cag ni 'dod pa la ①log par g.yem pa yin gye/ bdag cag gis 'dod pa la log par g.yem pa spang bar bya'o zhes nas de dag 'dod pa la log par g.yem pa spong ngo / /tshe lo lnga bcu pa'i mi 'dod pa la log par g.yem pa spong ba de dag gi bu dang bu mo btsas pa rnams tshe lo brgya thub par gyur to/ /tshe lo brgya pa'i mi rnams 'di snyam du dge ba'i chos rnams yang dag par blangs pa'i phyir tshe yang nur la/ kha dog dang / sto bas dang bde ba dang / longs spyod dag kyang 'phel bar snang gitsa// bdag cag gis yang lhag par dge ba'i chos 'ga' zhig yang dag par blangs te 'khod par bya na/ bdag cag gis dge ba'i chos gang zhig yang dag par blangs te/ 'khod par bya snyam du sems so/ /de dag 'di snyam du kye pyabadag cag ni brdzun du smra ba yin gyi④/ bdag cag gis brdzun du smra ba spang bar bya'o zhes nas de dag brdzun du smra ba spong ngo / /tshe lo brgya pa'i mi brdzun du smra ba spong ba de dag gi bu dang bu mo btsas pa rnams tshe lo nyis brgya thub par gyur sprite/ de dag las kha cig ni tshe lo nyis brgya lnga bcu thub par gyur to/ /tshe lo nyis brgya lnga bcu pa'i mi rnams 'di snyam du kye dge ba'i chos rnams yang dag par blangs pa'i phyir tshe yang nur la/ kha dog dang stobs dang bde ba dang longs spyod kyang 'phel bar snang gi ⑪bdag cag gis yang lhag par dge ba'i chos 'ga' zhig yang dag par blangs te 'khod par bya na/ bdag cag gis byedage ba'i chos gang 8 zhig yang dag par blangs te 'khod par bya snyam du sems so/ /de dag 'di snyam du kye bdag cag ni phra ma can yin kyi⑫/ bdag cag gis phra ma spang bar bya'o zhes nas de dag phra ma spong ngo / /tshe lo nyis brgya lnga bcu pa'i mi phra ma spong ba de dag gi bu dang bu mo btsas pa rnams tshe lo lnga brgya thub par gyur te/ tshe lo lnga brgya 78—713

pa'i mi rnams shekye dge ba'i chos rnams yang dag par blangs pa'i phyir tshe yang nur la/ kha dog dang stobs dang bde ba dang longs spyod kyang 'phel bar snang gi/bdag cag gis yang lhag par dge ba'i chos 'ga' zhig yang dag par blangs te 'khod par bya na/ bdag cag gis bye dge ba'i chos gang zhig yang dag par blangs te 'khod par bya snyam du sems so/ /de dag 'di snyam du kye bdag cag ni tshig rtsub po smra ba yin gyi / bdag cag gis tshig rtsub po spang bar bya'o zhes nas de dag tshig rtsub po spong ngo / /tshe lo lnga brgya pa'i mi tshig rtsub po spong ba de dag gi bu dang bu mo btsas pa rnams tshe lo stong thub par gyur to/ /tshe lo stong thub pa'i mi rnams 'di snyam du kye dge ba'i chos rnams yang dag par blangs pa'i phyir tshe yang nur la/ kha dog dang stobs dang bde ba dang longs spyod dag kyang 'phel bar snang gi4/ bdag cag gis yang lhag par dge ba'i chos 'ga' zhig yang dag par blangs te 'khod par bya na/ bdag cag gis dge ba'i chos gang zhig yang dag par blangs te 'khod par bya snyam du sems so/ /de dag 'di snyam du kye bdag cag ni tshig 'khyal pa can yin kyisri/ bdag cag gis tshig 'khyal pa ⑥sgong ngo / /tshe lo stong pa'i mi tshig 'khyal pa spong ba de dag gi bu dang bu mo btsas pa rnams tshe lo nyis stong thub par 'gyur te/ de dag las kha cig ni tshe lo nyis stong lnga brgya thub par gyur to/ /tshe lo nyis stong lnga brgya pa'i mi rnams 'di snyam du kye dge ba'i chos rnams yang dag par blangs pa'i phyir tshe yang nur la/ kha dog dang stobs dang bde ba dang longs spyod dag kyang 'phel bar snang gidze+e/ bdag cag gis yang she/lhag par dge ba'i chos 'ga' zhig yang dag par blangs te 'khod par bya na/ bdag cag gis dge ba'i chos gang zhig ⑨yang dag par blangs te 78—744
