bya zhe na/ smras pa/ sprul pa ni rnam pa gnyis te/ skyes nas thob pa dang /bsgoms pa las byung ①ba'o/ /de la skyes nas lduthob pa gang yin pa de ni sems yod pa zhes bya'o/ /bsgoms pa las byung ba gang yin pa de ni sems med pa zhes bya'o/ /sprul pa gang gi sems kyi dbang gis 'gyur zhes bya ①zhe na/ smras pa—/ sprul pa ni rnam pa gnyis te/ skyes nas thob pa dang / bsgoms pa las byung ba'o/ /de la skyes nas ④thob pa gang yin pa de ni/ sems can de'i sems kyi dbang gis phye'agyur zhes bya'o/ /bsgoms pa las byung ba gang yin pa de ni/ sprul pa po'i sems kyi dbang gis 'gyur zhes bya'o/ /bar ma do'i srid pa 'byung ba chen po bzhi las byung zhes bya'am/ 'on te 'byung ba chen po bzhi las byung ba ma yin zhes bya zhe na/ smras pa/ 'byung ba chen po bzhi las byung ba zhes bya'o/ /bar ma do'i srid pa rgyu las byung ba'i gzugs can zhes bya'am / 'on te rgyu las byung ba'i gzugs can ma yin pa zhes bya zhe na/smras pa/ rgyu las byung ba'i gzugs can zhes bya'o/ /bar ma do'i srid pa sems yod pa zhes bya'am pya/ 'on te sems med pa zhes bya zhe na/ smras pa/sems yod pa ④zhes bya'o/ /bar ma do'i srid pa gang gi sems kyi dbang gis 'gyur zhes bya zhe na/ smras pa/ rang gi sems kyi dbang gis 'gyur ba zhes bya'o—/ /sprul pas zos pa gang yin pa de/ sprul pa'am/ sprul pa po gang gi ltor 'ju bar du'agyur zhe na/ smras pa/ sprul pa ni rnam pa gnyis te/ skyes nas thob pa dang / bsgoms pa las byung ba'o/ /de la skyes nas (thob pas zos pa gang yin pa de ni/ sprul pa'i ltor 'ju bar ⑫'gyur ro/ /bsgoms pa las byung bas zos pa gang yin pa de ni sprul pa po'i ltor 'ju bar ⑫ 'gyur ro/ /78—1011

ci sprul pa med par 'gyur ba zhes bya'am/ 'on te med par 'gyur ba ma yin pa zhes bya zhe na/ smras pa/ sprul pa ni rnam pa gnyis te/ skyes nas thob pa dang /bsgoms pa las byung ba'o/ /de la bsgoms pa las byung ba gang yin pa de ni med par 'gyur ba zhes bya'o/ /skyes nas thob pa gang yin pa de la ni med par 'gyur ba yod/ med par mi 'gyur ba rmyeyang yod do/ /med par 'gyur ba gang zhe na/ smras pa/ dper na/ lha'am/ mi'am/ lha ma yin nam/gzugs bzang po'am/ gzugs ngan par sprul pa de ni med par 'gyur ba'o/ /med par mi 'gyur ba gang zhe na/ smras pa/ ring du song du ②zin kyang /de'i 'og tu rang bzhin ji lta ba kho na bzhin du gnas pa gang yin pa de ni ④med par mi 'gyur ba'o/ /ci'i phyir sprul pa dud par 'thul zhe na/ smras pa/sprul pa po'i dbang gis 'gyur te/ gang gi tshe sprul pa po 'di snyam du sems te/sprul pa dud par 'thul bar gyur cig snyam pa de'i tshe/ dud par 'thul bar 'gyur te/ rgyu des na sprul pa dud par 'thul lo/ /ci'i phyir sprul pa ④mer 'bar zhe na/ smras pa/ sprul pa po'i dbang gis 'gyur te/ gang gi tshe sprul pa po 'di snyam du sems te/ kye ma sprul pa mer 'bar bar gyur cig snyam pa de'i tshe mer 'bar bar 'gyur te/ rgyu des na sprul pa mer 'bar ro ci'i phyir sprul pa rang gi gos dang / rang gi lus sreg par byed la/ gzhan gyi gos dang / gzhan gyes lus sreg par mi byed ce na/ smras pa/ sprul pa po'i dbang gis 'gyur te/ sprul pa pos 'di tshig par gyur cig snyam du bsams na de tshig par 'gyur te/ rgyu des na sprul pas rang gi rgyagos dang / rang gi lus sreg par byed kyi/ gzhan gyi gos dang / gzhan gyi lus sreg par mi byed do/ /78—1012

ci'i phyir tshe dang ldan pa gyad bu nor gyis/ nam mkha' la bdag nyid kyi nang gi me'i khams kyis/ lus bsregs ①te tshig par byas na②/ dud pa yang med/thal ba'am/ lhag ma lus pa yang med ce na/ smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa gyad bu nor gyis/ nam mkha' de la sa gzhi sprul te/ stegs bu dang / 'chags dang / khri dang ldan pa'i sa gzhi sprul nas/ stegs bu dang / 'chags dang /khri dang / me dang / rnge'i rgyur 1sprul to/ /me dang me'i rgyur sprul nas kyang /bdag nyid kyi nang gi rnge'i khams kyis lus bsregs ④te/ de'i bdag nyid kyi me'i khams kyis lus bsregs rngushing tshig par byas na/ dud pa yang med/ thal ba'am / lhag ma lus pa yang med de/ rgyu des na tshe dang ldan pa gyad bu nor gyis/bdag nyid kyi nang gi me'i khams kyis lus bsregs te tshig par byas na⑥/ dud pa yang med/ thal ba'am/ lhag ma lus pa tsam yang med do/ /chos mngon pa'i bstan bcos chen po rgyu gdags ④pa las tshigs bcu gcig pa'o// //rgyu gdags pa/ bam po drug pa/ sdom ni/ gzhol dang gang zag dus rlabs dang / /lan tshwa 3rin chen chen po gnas/ /rul pa'i ro dang gcig mi gnas / /chu klung ⑫rgyan dang sna tshogs mdog⑫ /rgya mtsho chen po ni byin gyis ⑪gzhol zhing byin gyis 'bab la/ byin gyis bab ste mu kho na nas gang bar 'dug pa ma yin no zhes gsungs pa de/ ci'i phyir rgya mtsho chen po byin gyis gzhol zhing byin gyis 3'bab la byin gyis ⑪ bab ste/ mu kho na nas gang bar 'dug pa ma yin zhe na/ smras pa/ rgya mtsho chen po ni byin gyis gzhol zhing byin gyis 'bab la/ byin gyis bab pa yang ma yin mu kho na ⑫nas gang bar 'dug pa yang 78—1013

ma yin gyi/ gling de dag de ltar 'dug ste/ dper na nas kyi phung po'am/'bras kyi phung po byin gyis gzhol zhing byin gyes 'bab 1la/ byin gyis 'bab ༷pa bzhin te/ rgyu des na rgya mtsho chen po byin kyis gzhol zhing byin byus 'bab 1la / byin gyis bab ste mu kho na nas gang bar 'dug pa ma yin no/ /rgya mtsho chen po ni zab cing mur thug par dka' ba'o ④ zhes gsungs pa/ de ci'i phyir rgya mtsho chen po zab cing mur thug par dka' zhe na/ smras pa/ rgya mtsho chen po ni zab cing mur thug par dka' ba ma phyeyin te/ rgya mtsho chen po ni zab du kyi tshad dang / rgya'i tshad kyang yod kyi/ de'i nang na 'dug pa'i chu la chu 'di tsam zhig yod do zhe'am/ chu bum pa gcig gam/ chu bum pa brgya 'am/ chu bum pa stong ngam/ chu bum pa 'bum zhes gzhal bar mi nus te/ rgyu des na rgya mtsho chen po zab cing mur thug par dka'o/ /rgya mtsho chen po ni dus rlabs la bab na/ yol bar mi 'gyur ro zhes gsungs pa de/ ci'i phyir rgya mtsho chen po dus rlabs la bab na yol bar mi 'gyur zhe na/ smras pa dus rlabs ni lngaganyis te/ nang par dang phye ma red kyi dus rlabs dang / dus rlabs chen po'o / /nang par dang phye ma red kyi dus rlabs gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ rgya mtsho'i nang na gnas pa'i srog chags bkres shing nyam chung bar gyur te/ zas tshol she ba rnams nang par sngar chu'i nang nas byung ste thang la 'gro la/ de dag bkres bzhin du phye ma red phyir ldog ste/ de dag gyen du 'byung ba dang /phyir sdog pa las dus rlabs kyi rlabs 'byung bar 'gyur ba 'di ni/ nang par dang phye ma red kyi dus rlabs zhes bya'o/ /dus rlabs chen po gang zhe na/'di lta ste/ rgya mtsho chen po'i nang na gnas pa rnams/ tshes brgyad dang /78—1014

tshes bcu bzhi dang / cho ①'phrul gyi zla ba phyed dang / de la sogs pa'i tshes grangs dag tu chu'i nang nas thang la byung nas/ zla ba la dad pa rnams ni zla ba la phyag 'tshal/ nyi ma la dad pa rnams ni nyi ma la phyag 'tshal/ skyem cho byed la dad pa rnams ni skyem dhibyed la phyag 'tshal/ sangs rgyas la dad pa'i dge bsnyen rnams ni gso sbyong la gnas par byed de/ de dag gyen du 'byung ba dang /phyir ldog pa las dus rlabs chen po'i rlabs 'byung bar 'gyur te/ rgyu des na rgya mtsho chen po dus rlabs la bab na yol bar mi 'gyur ro/ /rgya mtsho chen po ni 'dra bar lan tshwa'i ④ ror ro gcig go zhes gsungs pa de/ ci'i phyir rgya mtsho chen po 'dra bar lan tshwa'i ṭuror ro gcig ce na/ smras pa/ rgya mtsho chen po'i nang nas/ srog chags skye yang skye/ rga yang rga/ 'chi yang 'chi ba dag yod de—/ de dag gi lus kyi dri ma dang / lus kyi snyag snyig gis rgya mtsho chen po lan bo'i du ro bro bar 'gyur ro/ /gzhan yang rgya mtsho chen po'i nang na lan bo'i tso ro dag yod de/ de dag zhu ba las rgya mtsho chen po la lan bo'i ro dubro bar 'gyur ro/ /gzhan yang gling rnams la mi 'khod pa rnams kyis rtswa dang / shing dang yal ga dang / lo ma dang / lo ma gre'u kyedang / 'dab ma rnams chu klung gi nang du bor ba de dag kun du rul ba las rgya mtsho chen po lan tshu'i ⑫ro bro bar 'gyur te/ rgyu des ⑪na rgya mtsho chen po 'dra bar lan tshwa'i 3ror ro gcig go—/ /rgya mtsho chen po rin po che mang po dang / rin po che sna tshogs kyis gang ngo zhes gsungs pa de/ ci'i phyir rgya mtsho chen po rin po che mang po dang /rin po che sna tshogs kyis gang bar gyur ce na/ smras pa/ 'jig rten chags pa na / rgyu'i mchog dang / snying po'i mchog dang / bzang po'i mchog dang /78—1015

zong gi mchog gang yin pa ①phyogs der bsdus ②te/ de las ri'i rgyal po ri rab dang / gser gyi ri bdun po rnams grub bo/ /khams bzang po lhag ma rnams ni de nyid du byeng ba'i phyir ro/ /gzhan yang rgya mtsho chen po'i nang na klu dbang che bar grags pa rnams kyi gnas/ rin po che mang po dang / rin po che sna tshogs kyis ④gang ba yod de/ rgyu des na rgya mtsho chen po rin po che mang po dang / rin po che sna tshogs kyis gang ngo / /rgya mtsho chen po'i nang na sems can chen bo rnams gnas so zhes gsungs pa de/ ci'i phyir rgya mtsho chen bo'i nang na sems can chen po rnams gnas she na/ smras pa/ sems can gang dag sngon mir gyur cing 'dug 'dug pa rnams kyis/ chos ma yin pas longs spyod rnams bsgrubs nas/ bdag nyid kyang bde bas tshim par byas/ bu dang /chung ma dang / khrom gyi ru dang / zas dang / skom gyis rgyas par byas pa de dag nyes par spyad pa rjode dang / yang dag par blangs pa de lta bu dang /yang dag par gzung ⑤ba de lta bus lus zhig nas shi ba'i 'og tu ngan song ngan 'gro log par thong ba sems can dmyal ba rnams su skye bar 'gyur la/ de dag sems can dmyal ba rnams nas 'u/ shi 'phos nas kyang las kyi lhag ma des/ rgya mtsho chen po'i nang dze+edu dud 'gro rnams su skye bar 'gyur te/ de dag der lus che ba dang / mang du za bar 'gyur te/ de dag srog chags stong phrag dze+emang po dag gis ⑨bza' bar 'gyur la/ de dag kyang mang po rnams la za bar 'gyur te/ gling gang dag tu gnas nas/ sdig pa mi dge ba'i las kyi rnam par smin pa nyams su myong bar 'gyur ba'i go skabs med do ⑫/ /rgyu des na rgya mtsho chen po'i nang na/ sems can chen po rnams gnas so/ /rgya mtsho chen po 78—1016

ni shi ba'i ro dang lhan cig mi gnas so zhes gsungs pa de/ ci'i phyir rgya mtsho chen po shi ba'i ro dang lhan cig mi gnas she na/ smras pa/ rgya mtsho chen po'i nang na klu gtsang sbra spyod pa rnams kyi gnas dag yod de/ klu'i gnas gang gi steng du shi ba'i ro gnas par gyur pa des de'i mtshan mo nyid du klu'i gnas gnyis par phul lo/ /gnas gnyis pa nas gsum par phul lo/ /gsum pa nas bzhi par phul te/ de lta bu'i rim pas 'gram du bskyal nas thang la 'dor te/ rgyu des na rgya mtsho chen po shi ba'i ro dang lhan cig mi gnas so/ /rgya mtsho chen por ni 'dzam bu'i tshal gyi chu klung 'bab pa gang yin pa rnams dang / bar snang las char gyi rgyun shing rta'i srog shing tsam 'bab kyang des rgya mtsho chen po de 'grib par 'gyur ba yang med gang bar 'gyur ba yang med do zhes gsungs pa de/ ci'i phyir 'dzam bu'i tshal nas/ chu klung 'bab pa gang yin pa rnams dang / bar snang las char gyi rgyun shing rta'i srog shing tsam 'bab kyang / des rgya mtsho chen po de 'grib par 'gyur ba yang med/ gang bar 'gyur ba yang med ce na/ smras pa / rgya mtsho chen po'i nang na gnas pa'i srog chags rnams kyi longs spyod du 'gro la/ lhag ma rlung dang nyi ①/ tshan gyis zad cing gtugs par 'gyur te/rgyu des na rgya mtsho chen po 'grib par 'gyur ba yang med/ gang bar 'gyur ba yang med do/ /rgya mtsho chen po'i nang na srog chags kha dog sna tshogs dang /rtags sna tshogs dang / dbyibs sna tshogs 1dang / kha dog du ma dang /rtags du ma dang / dbyibs du ma yod do zhes gsungs pa de/ ci'i phyir rgya mtsho chen po'i nang na/ srog chags kha dog sna tshogs dang / rtags sna tshogs dang / dbyibs sna tshogs dang / kha dog du ma dang / rtags du ma dang /78—1017

dbyibs du ma yod ce na/ smras pa/ sems can gang sngon mir gyur cing 'dug rmye'adug pa rnams kyibye/ lus kyis sdig pa mi dge ba'i las ji lta bu byas pa dang / ngag gis lceji lta bu smras pa'i nyes par spyad pa de dang / yang dag par blangs pa de lta bu dang / yang dag par bzung ba de lta bus lus zhig nas shi ba'i 'og tu ngan song ngan 'gro log par ltung ba/ sems can dmyal ba rnams su skye bar 'gyur la/ de dag sems can dmyal ba rnams nas shi 'phos nas kyang / las kyi lhag ma des rgya mtsho chen po'i nang du/ dud 'gro rnams su skye bar 'gyur te/ de dag der kha dog sna tshogs dang / rtags sna tshogs dang / dbyibs sna tshogs dang / kha dog du ma dang / rtags du ma dang /dbyibs du mar 'gyur te/ rgyu des na rgya mtsho chen po'i nang na srog chags kha dog sna tshogs dang / rtags sna tshogs dang / dbyibs sna tshogs dang / kha dog du ma dang / rtags du ma dang / dbyibs du ma yod do/ /chos mngon pa'i bstan bcos chen po rgyu gdags pa las tshigs bcu gnyis pa'o // //④sdom ni/ gcig tu gyur dang gnyis ma yin/ /rtsig pas chod dang sa la 'dzul / /chu dang nam mkha' nyi zla dang / /tshangs gnas 'chag dang 'greng 'dug nyal/ /de gcig tu gyur nas mang por 'gyur zhes gsungs pa de ji ltar na gcig tu gyur nas mang por 'gyur zhe na/ smras pa/ 'di la dge slong 'jig rten pa'i ting nge 'dzin gang dang gang la ci 'dod pa bzhin 'thob pa dang /dka' ba med par 'thob pa dang / tshegs med par 'thob ④pa des/ de skyed cing bskrun du te yang dag par skyed ④yang dag par sgrub par byed la gsal 78—1018

bar byed do/ /des de bskyed cing bskrun kyete yang dag par bsgrun khrucing yang dag par bsgrubs la gsal bar byas nas glang po che'i lus sam/ rta'i lus sam/shing rta'i lus sam/ dpung bu chung gi lus sam/ khyu mchog gi lus sam/bya'i lus sam/ shing gi lus sam/ rtsig pa'i lus sam/ ci dang ci 'dod pa'i phyi rol du mngon par sgrub dzu cing / mngon par spyod de/ mngon par rtsom par byed la/ mngon par bsgrubs shing mngon par spyad de/ mngon par brtsams pa de dag gi sgo nas/ de ltar gcig tu gyur nas mang por 'gyur ro/ /de mang por gyur nas gcig tu 'gyur ro zhes gsungs pa de/ ji ltar na mang por gyur nas gcig tu 'gyur zhe na/ smras pa/ 'di na dge slong gi rnam pa gang dag dang / rtags gang dag dang thu/ mtshan ma gang dag gis glang po'i lus dang / rta'i lus dang / shing rta'i lus dang / dpung bu chung gi lus dang / khyu mchog gi lus dang / bya'i lus dang / shing gi lus dang /rtsig pa'i lus rnams phyi rol du mngon par bsgrubs shing / mngon par sbyad de/mngon par brtsams pa'i sbyor ba de dag des btang byeste/ mtshan ma rnams kyang mi snang bar byas nas/ sbyor ba rnams btang ⑪ zhing / mtshan ma rnams mi snang bar byas pa de ⑦lta bu la mang por gyur nas gcig tu 'gyur zhes bya'o//des snang bar gyur cing mi snang bar 'gyur ba shes pa dang / mthong bas nyams su myong ngo zhes gsungs pa de ji ltar na snang ba las mi snang bar 'gyur zhe na/smras pa/ des du sems can de dag la snang bzhin du 'dug pa las 'di snyam du sems te/ ci nas bdag mi shes par bya'o/ /ci nas bdag mi mthong bar bya'o snyam ste/ de der rtsig pas chod pa'am/ brag gis chod pa'am/ ra 78—1019

bas chod par mos par byed de/ de ltar na snang bzhin du 'dug pa las mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /ji ltar na mi snang zhing 'dug pa las snang bar 'gyur zhe na/smras pa/ de sems can de dag la mi snang zhing 'dug pa las 'di snyam du sems te / ci nas bdag shes par bya'o/ /ci nas bdag mthong bar bya'o snyam ste/de rmyede dag dang nye zhing thub par mos par byed de/ de ltar na de mi snang zhing 'dug pa las snang bar 'gyur ro/ /de ltar na snang bar gyur cing mi snang bar yang bye 'gyur ba rnams la snang zhing 'dug pa las zhumi snang bar 'gyur ba dang /mi snang zhing 'dug pa las snang bar 'gyur la/ shes pa yang de yin/ mthong ba yang de yin te/ dge slong gis shes pa dang mthong ba de myong zhing so sor myong la/ rig cing nyams su myong ngo / /de la shes pa dang / mthong ba ni rtogs pa dang / yang dag par rtogs pa dang / nye bar rtogs pa dang /rten ④pa dang / yang dag par khong du chud pa dang / mang du shes pa dang /yid gzhungs pa dang / blo dang / mkhas pa dang / shes rab dang / spyod pa dang / lhag mthong gang yin pa ste/ de ltar na snang bar gyur pa'am ⑤ /mi snang bar gyur pa shes pa dang / mthong bas nyams su myong ngo / /de rtsig pas chod pa'am/ brag gis chod pa'am/ ra bas chod pa las du lus mi thogs 3par 'gro ste/ dper na nam mkha' la bya ba bzhin no zhes gsungs pa de ji ltar rtsig pas chod pa'am/ brag gis tsachod pa'am/ ra bas chod pa la lus mi thogs par 'gro ste/ dper na nam mkha' la bya ba bzhin zhe na/ smras pa/nam mkha'i stoms par 'jug pa la snyoms par zhugs pas na/ rtsig pas chod pa'am / brag gis chod pa'am/ ra bas chod pa la lus mi thogs par 'gro ste/78—1020

dper na nam mkha' la bya ba bzhin te/ de ltar na rtsig pas chod pa'am/brag gis 3chod pa'am/ ra bas chod pa las zhulus mi thogs par 'gro ste/dper na nam mkha' la bya ba bzhin no/ /de sa la steng du 'byung ba dang /byi'u zul byed de/ dper na chu la bya ba bzhin no zhes gsungs pa ste④/ ji ltar na sa la steng du 'byung ba dang / byi'u zul byed de/ dper na/ chu la bya ba bzhin no zhe na/ smras pa/ chu'i snyoms par 'jug pa la snyoms par zhugs pas na sa la steng du 'byung ba dang / byi'u zul byed de/ dper na chu la bya ba bzhin te/ de ltar na sa la steng du 'byung ba dang / byi'u zul byed de/dper na nam mkha' la bya ba bzhin no/ /de chu'i rgyun la mi nub ④par 'gro ste/dper na/ sa la bya ba bzhin no zhes gsungs pa ste⑤/ ji ltar na chu'i rgyun la mi nub par 'gro ste/ dper na sa la bya ba bzhin zhe na/ smras pa/ sa'i snyoms par 'jug pa la snyoms par zhugs pas na/ chu'i rgyun la mi nub par 'gro ste/ dper na sa la bya ba bzhin te/ de ltar na chu'i rgyun la mi nub par 'gro ste/ dper na/ sa la bya ba bzhin no/ /de nam mkha' la skyil mo krung bcas bzhin du 'gro ste/ dper na 'dab duchags bya bzhin no zhes gsungs pa de ji ltar na nam mkha' la skyil mo krung bcas ④bzhin du 'gro ste/ dper na 'dab du chags bya bzhin zhe na/ smras pa/ 'di la dge slong 'jig rten pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa gang dang gang la/ ci 'dod pa bzhin thob pa dang /dka' ba med par thob pa dang / tshegs med par thob pa des de skyed cing bskrun du/ te yang dag par skyed cing yang dag pa ⑩sgrub par byed ⑪la gsal bar byed do/ /des de skyed cing bskrun te yang dag par bskrun cing yang dag par 78—1021

bsgrubs pa gsal bar byas nas/ phyogs gang na 'greng ngam/ 'dug gam nyal yang rung ste/ des der me'am/ me lce'am/ dud pa'am/ dud pa'i rtags can nam/ rlung ngam/ rlung gi dkyil 'khor du mos par byed de/de der me'am/ me lce'am/ dud pa'am/ dud pa'i rtags can nam/rlung ngam/ rlung gi dkyil 'khor du mos nas kyang de'i 'og tu bdag rlung gi dkyil 'khor gyis gyen du khyer bar gyur cig snyam du mos pa dang ①/ yang na glang po che'am/ rta'am/ shing rta'am/ dpung bu chung ngam/ bya'am/rtsig pa'am/ shing khyer bar gyur cig snyam du mos par byed de/ ji lta ji ltar mos pa de lta de ltar gzhan gyis khyesha'i mig thal 1bas mthong ngo / /de 'di snyam du sems te kye ma rdzu 'phrul 'di lta bu zhig myong bar bya'o/ /so sor myong bar bya'o—/ /rig par bya'o/ /nyams su pyong bar bya'o snyam du bsams na/ de bzhin du 'grub par 'gyur te/ 'di lta ste/ rdzu 'phrul kyi rkang pa rnams legs par bsgoms pa'i phyir ro/ /de ltar na nam mkha' la skyil ④mo krung bcas bzhin du 'gro ste/ dper na 'dab chags bya bzhin no/ /des nyi ma dang zla ba 'di gnyis lag pas 'dzin cing / kun du nyug par byed do zhes gsungs pa de/ ji ltar na nyi ma dang zla ba 'di gnyis la lag pas 'dzin cing kun du nyug par byed ce na/ smras pa/ nyi ma zhes bya ba ni nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor yin no/ /zla ba zhes bya ba ni zla ba'i dkyil 'khor yin te/ dge slong des nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'di dang / zla ba'i dkyil 'khor 'di la ñdzunye zhing thug par mos nas lag pas 'dzin cing kun du nyug par byed la/ nom zhing kun du nom ste/ de ltar na nyi ma dang zla ba 'di gnyis la lag pas ⑥'dzin 78—1022

cing kun du nyug go/ /de tshangs pa'i 'jig rten du lus dbang byed do zhes gsungs pa 1de/ ji ltar na tshangs pa'i 'jig rten du lus kyis zhudabang byed ce na—/ smras pa/ dge slong 'jig rten pa'i ting nge 'dzin gang la ci 'dod pa bzhin thob pa dang / dka' ba med par thob pa dang / tshegs med par thob pa des de skyed cing bsgrun bute/ yang dag par byed cing yang dag par sgrub par byed la/ gsal bar byed do/ /des de ④skyed cing bskrun te/ yang dag par bskrun cing / yang dag par bsgrubs pa la gsal bar byas nas/lus kyang sems la 'jog la/ sems kyang lus la 'jog par byed de④/ lus sems la gzhag la/ sems kyang lus la bzhag nas kyang / gcig tu gyur cing kun du 'dres te/ dper na mar ram/ til mar ram/ sbrang rtsi'am/bu ram gyi dbu ba chu dang gcig tu 'gyur zhing / kun du 'dres pa de bzhin du dge slong gis lus sems la bzhag cing sems kyang lus la bzhag nas lus la yang ba'i 'du shes dang / 'jam pa'i 'du shes bskyed nas 'phags par byed cing yang dag par byed la/ gyen du 'gro bar byed cing / kun du ⑫gyen du 'gro bar byed de/ dper na za ma tog khyer ba'i mis za ma tog ⑦blangs te/blangs nas kyang 'phags par byed cing kun du 'phags par byed la/ 'gro bar byed cing kun du 'gro bar byed pa dang / dge slong bsod stoms pas kha zas lhung bzed kyi snod du bcug nas 'phags par byed cing kun du 'phags par byed la/ 'gro bar byed cing kun du 'gro bar byed pa de bzhin du dge slong gis lus la yang pa'i 'du shes dang / 'jam pa'i 'du shes bskyed nas 'phags par byed cing kun du 'phags par byed la/ gyen du 'gro bar byed cing /78—1023

kun du gyen du 'gro bar byed de/ lus la tshangs pa'i 'jig rten bsams na sems bskyed pa'i mod la dbang yod pa dang / 'gro ba dang / rag las padang / bdag po dang / mthu yod pa dang / skal ba can dang / dbangabyed pa dang / tshangs pa'i 'jig rten na gnas pa zhes brjod do/ /de ltaran ①bcom ldan 'das kyis kyang tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la bka' pa tekun dga' bo yid kyi rdzu 'phrul 'dis tshangs pa'i gzhal med khang du phyin par ngas mngon par shes so/ /de skad ces bka' sprul pa dang / bcom ldan 'das la tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos 'di skad ces gsol to/ /gzugs can rags pa 'byung ba chen po bzhi las byung ba'i sku 'dis tshangs pa'i gzhal med khang du gshegs par bcom ldan 'das kyis mngon par mkhyen tam/ kunadaga' bo gzugs can rags rjo pa 'byung ba chen po bzhi las byung ba/ pha dngama'i mi gtsang bar khrumer mer po las byung ba/ 'bras chan krudang / zan dron gyis 'ubaskyed pa/ rtag pyatu dril ba dang / khrus bya ba ⑦dang / mnye dgos pa dang / 'gyes rtsepa dang / 'thor h+phub dang / rnam par 'jig pa'i chos can gyi lus 'dis kyang tshangs pa'i gzhal med khang du phyin par ngas mngon par shes so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis khya dpe bstan du gsol/ bde bar gshegs pas dpe bstan du gsol/ kun dga' bo dper na lcags kyi garabu 'am/ lcags kyi snod ni gang gi tshe tsha ba yod cing me yod pa de'i tshe shin tu ches yang ba dang / ches 'jam pa dang ches las su rung ba dang kye/ ches 'od gsal bar 'gyur la/ gang gi tshe grang mor gyur cing me med pa de'i tshe ni/ches lci ba dang / ches sra ba ⑫dang / ches las su mi rung ba dang / chos 78—1024

'od mi gsal bar 'gyur ba de bzhin du/ kun dga' bo gang gi tshe de bzhin gshegs pas lus sems la bzhag cing sems kyang lus la bzhag ste/ lus la yang ba'i 'du shes dang / 'jam pa'i 'du shes bskyed na ni/ kun dga' bo de'i de bzhin gshegs pa'i lus shin tu ches ⑨yang ba dang / ches 'jam pa dang / ches las su rung ba dang / ches 'od gsal bar 'gyur ba dang /sems kyi rgyu las 'byung ba dang / sems la brten ⑤pa dang / sems la rag las par 'gyur te/ sems la brten ①nas lus la dbang byed do/ /ci'i phyir sprul pa nam mkha' la 'chag ce na/ smras pa/ sprul pa po'i dbang gis 'gyur te/ sprul pa bos nam mkha' de la stegs bu 'am/ 'chags ④sprul par byed de/ rgyu des na sprul pa nam mkha' la 'chag go/ /ci'i phyir sprul pa nam mkha' la 'greng zhe na⑤/ smras pa/ sprul pa po'i dbang gis 'gyur te/sprul pa pos nam mkha' de la sa gzhi'am/ gnas sprul par byed de/ rgyu des na sprul pa nam mkha' la 'greng ngo / /ci'i phyir sprul pa nam mkha' la 'dug ce na / smras pa/ sprul pa po'i dbang gis 'gyur te/ sprul pa pos nam mkha' de la stan dunam 'dug sa sprul par byed de/ rgyu des na sprul pa nam mkha' la 'dug go/ /ci'i phyir sprul pa nam mkha' la nyal zhe na/ smras pa/ sprul pa po'i dbang gis 'gyur te/ sprul pa pos nam mkha' de la mal lam/ khri sprul par ⑦byed de/ rgyu des na sprul pa nam mkha' la nyal lo/ /rdzu 'phrul kyi yon tan lhag ma rnams kyang de bzhin du rtogs par byas nas gzhi ji lta ba bzhin du brjod par bya'o/ /chos mngon pa'i bstan bcos chen po rgyu gdags pa las tshigs bcu gsum pa'o // // ④78—1025

so ga 1chu thigs dang / /ser ba kha ba glog dang 'brug /phru ba dang ni bzhi drug bdun / /char pa ji tsam na 'dug ste 'bab ce na/ smras pa/ sprin ni brgyad yod do④/ /de la sprin dang po ni dpag tshad phyed dang gnyis na 'dug go/ /gnyis pa ni rgyang grags lnga'o/ /gsum pa ni dpag tshad gcig go/ /bzhi pa ni rgyang grags gsum mo/ /lnga pa ni dpag tshad phyed do/ /drug pa ni rgyang grags gcig go/ /bdun pa ni rgyang grags phyed do/ /brgyad pa ni rgyang grags kyi bzhi cha gcig na 'dug ste/ char 'bab bam yang na mi 'bab po ci'i phyir bskal pa dang po'i mi rnams kyis sprin dpag tshad phyed ⑤dang gnyis su badze+es te / sa thams cad du char 'bab la/ da ltar gyi mi rnams kyi ni dma' ba nas char 'bab ce na/ smras pa/ bskal pa dang po pa'i ⑥mi rnams ni dbang che bar grags par 'gyur te/ de dag la klu dbang che bar grags pa dag spro bar byed de/ des na sprin dpag tshad phyed dang gnyis su gyen du 'phags nas/sa thams cad du char 'bab la/ da ltar gyi mi rnams ni dbang chung bar grags pa yin te/ de dag la ④ni klu yang dbang che ①bar grags pa rnams spro bar byed de / des na da /kyeltar dma' ba nas char 'bab ste/ rgyu des na bskal pa dang po pa'i mi rnams kyi sprin dpag tshad phyed dang gnyis su gyen du 'phags te sa thams cad du char 'bab la/ da ltar gyi mi rnams kyi ni dma' ba nas ⑫char 'bab po/ /ci'i phyir char mi 'bab ce na/ smras pa/ rgyu rnam pa brgyad kyis skyochar mi 'bab ste/ brgyad gang zhe na/ sprin yang yod la/ glog kyang 'byung 78—1026

ba dang / 'brug kyang zer la/ phyogs bzhi nas kyang rlung ngad bsil ba dag ldang ba de'i dus kyang yod la/ de'i skabs yod de/ ltas pa rnams kyang ma rtogs par char 'bab bo zhes ston mod kyi/ 'on kyang sa chen po 'di las me'i khams gyen du 'phags nas char pa de bar ma dor zad par kyebyed de/ rgyu dang po 'dis na char mi 'bab po/ /gzhan yang sprin yang yod la/ glog kyang 'byung ba dang / 'brug kyang zer la/ phyogs bzhi nas kyang rlung ngad bsil ba dag ldang ba de'i dus kyang yod la/ de'i skabs kyang yod de/ ltas pa rnams kyang ma rtogs par char 'bab po zhes ston mod kyi 'on kyang nam mkha' la rlung drag po dag geldang ste/ de dag gi char pa de dan dka'i ②dgon pa rnams dang / ka ling ka'i dgon pa rnams dang / ma tang ka'i dgon pa rnams dang /dgon pa stong pa rnams ga la ba der 'dor bar byed de/ rgyu gnyis pa 'dis na char mi 'bab po/ /gzhan yang sprin yang yod la/ glog kyang 'byung ba dang ge/'brug kyang zer la/ phyogs bzhi nas kyang rlung ngad bsil ba dag ldang ba de'i dus kyang yod la/ de'i skabs kyang yod de/ ltas pa rnams kyang ma rtogs par char 'bab po zhes ston mod kyi/ 'on kyang lha a+yom yin gyi dbang po sgra gcan gyis/ char pa de dag lag pa gnyis kyis blangs nas rgya mtsho chen por 'dor bar byed de⑥/ rgyu gsum pa 'dis na char mi 'bab po/ /gzhan yang sprin yang yod la/ glog kyang 'byung ba dang / 'brug kyang zer la/ phyogs bzhi nas kyang ⑦rlung ngad bsil ba dag rjoldang ba de'i dus kyang yod la/ de'i skabs kyang yod de/ ltas pa rnams kyang ma rtogs par char 'bab po zhes ston mod kyi 'on kyang char 'bebs pa'i lha'i bu rnams bag med cing bag med par 78—1027

gnas pas char mi 'bab ste/ rgyu bzhi pa 'dis na char mi 'bab po/ /gzhan yang sprin yang yod la/ glog kyang 'byung ba dang / 'brug kyang zer la/phyogs bzhi nas kyang rlung ngad bsel ba dag ldang ba de'i dus kyang yod la de'i skabs kyang yod de/ ltas pa rnams kyang ma rtogs par char 'bab po zhes ston mod kyi/ 'on kyang mi rnams chos ma yin pa spyod cing / mi mthun par ①spyod de / de dag chos ma yin pa spyod cing mi mthun pa spyod pas char mi 'bab ste/rgyu lnga po 'dis ni char mi 'bab po/ /gzhan yang rdzu 'phrul gyis char mi 'bab pa yod de/ rdzu 'phrul che zhing mthu che ba 'ga'i rdzu 'phrul gyis char 'bab pa las gcod par byed de/ rgyu drug pa 'dis na char mi 'bab po/ /gzhan yang chos nyid kyis ②char mi 'bab pa yod de/ char mi 'bab pa gang yin pa 'di ni 'jig rten gyi chos nyid de/ rgyu bdun pa 'dis ni char mi 'bab po/ /gzhan yang bden pas bskul bas char mi 'bab pa yod de/ rdzu 'phrul che zhing mthu che ba 'gas bden pas bskul bas char 'bab pa las gcod par byed de/ rgyu brgyad pa 'dis na du char mi 'bab po/ /ci'i phyir char 'bab ce na/ smras pa/rgyu rnam pa brgyad kyis char ④'bab ste/ brgyad gang zhe na/ klu'i mthu dang /gnod sbyin kyi mthu dang / grul bum gyi mthu dang / lha'i mthu dang / mi'i mthu dang / rdzu 'phrul dang / chos nyid dang / bden pas bskul bar ⑤ char 'bab ste/ rgyu des na 'uchar 'bab po/ /ci'i phyir so ka ④dang /dbyar char cher 'bab ce na/ smras pa/ de'i tshe klu rnams bag ma len pa dang /bag ma gtong ba dang / dga' ston dang / dus ston dag byed de/ de dag dga' zhing de dang / de dag tu 'dong bar byed de/ de dag dga' zhing 78—1028

'dong ba na char cher ①'bab po/ /gzhan yang mi rnams kyis ④de lta bur 'gyur ba'i las rnams byas shing bstsags te/ de dag byas shing bstsags pas na so ga dang / dbyar char cher 'bab ste/ rgyu des na so ka 3dang / dbyar char cher ④'bab po/ /ci'i phyir chu'i thigs pa 'bab ce na/ smras pa/phyogs gnyis nas rlung chen po dag ldang ste/ de dag gisu zu de ⑤gcig tu bsdus pas na/ de la chu'i thigs par 'gyur ro/ /gzhan yang mi rnams kyis 'ude lta bu'i las rnams byas shing bstsags te/ de dag byas shing bstsags pas mi ma yin pa rnams 'khrugs nas chu'i thigs pa 'be+ebs te/ des de dag la gnod pa chen por thu'agyur te/ rgyu des na chu'i thigs pa 'bab po ci'i phyir ser ba 'bab ce na/ smras pa/ phyogs gnyis nas rlung shin tu bsel ba dag ldang ste/ de dag gis ldu chu'i khams de gcig tu bsdus la sa'i khams kyis kyang sra bar byas nas kha ba 'am/ ser bar gyur pa de rlung gis sputhur du phab ste/ rgyu des shā ) na ser ba 'bab po/ /ci'i phyir glog 'byung zhe na/smras pa/ phyogs gnyis nas rlung shin tu tsha ba dag ldang ste/ de dag thug pa las glog 'byung ste/ rgyu des na glog 'byung ngo / /ci'i phyir 'brug zer zhe na/ smras pa/ phyogs gnyis nas rlung chen po dag ldang ste/ de dag brdabs pa las sgra 'byung ste/ rgyu des na 'brug zer ro/ /ci'i phyir phru ba lud kyece na/ smras pa/ 'og na ⑫me 'joms pa 'bar bas me'i shas che bar gyur la me'i shas che bar gyur pas rlung gi shas che bar 'gyur ro/ /rlung gi shas che bar gyur pas chu phyi rol du bo bar 'gyur te/ rgyu des na phru ba ldud 3do/ /ci'i phyir kha dog sngo bar 'gyur zhe na/ smras pa/ chu'i khams 78—1029

shas che ba'i phyir ro/ /ci'i phyir ser ba dang / dmar bar 'gyur zhe na/smras pa/ me'i khams shas che ba'i phyir ro/ /ci'i phyir dkar bar 'gyur zhe na—/ smras pa/ khams rnams mnyam ①pa'i phyir te/ rgyu des na kha dog sngo ba dang / ser ba dang / dmar ba dang / dkar bar 'gyur ro/ /ci'i phyir ro kha ba budang / skrur ba dang / lan tshu'i 3ro dang / tsha ba dang / bska bar 'gyur zhe na/ smras pa/ khams mnyam pa'i phyir te ④ rgyu des na rjoro kha ba dang / sgyur ba dang / lan tshwa'i ⑪ro dang / bsta ⑦bar 'gyur ro/ /ci'i phyir mngar bar 'gyur zhe na/ smras pa/ khams mnyam pa'i phyir te/ rgyu des na mngar bar 'gyur ro/ /ci'i phyir lci ba dang / rtsub pa dang /mkhrang pa dang / sra bar 'gyur zhe na/ smras pa/ sa'i khams shas che ba'i phyir ro//ci'i phyir mnyen pa dang / 'jam pa dang / las su rung bar 'gyur zhe na/smras pa/ chu'i khams shas che ba'i phyir te/ rgyu des na mnyen pa dang /'jam pa dang / las su rung bar 'gyur ro/ /chos mngon pa'i bstan bcos chen po rgyu gdags pa las tshigs bcu bzhi pa'o // //chasdom ni/ skye gnas 'gro ba yod pa dang / /ci'i phyir dmyal sogs mtho ris dang / /lha mo ma la sogs pa drug /'o ma kha spu rgyal dang gdol/ /gleng gzhi ni mnyan yod na bzhugs te/ skye gnas ni bzhi yod de/ sgo nga las skye ba'i skye gnas dang / mngal nas skye ba dang / drod gsher las skye ba dang /rdzus te skye ba stespu/ 'di ni skye gnas yin par gsungs so/ /sgo nga las skye ba'i skye gnas gang zhe na/ smras pa/ sems can gang dag sgo nga las skye ba 78—1030

rnams dang / sgo nga na 'dug pa rnams dang / sgo nga'i sbubs kyi spris g.yogs 3 pa rnams dang / sgo nga'i sbubs brtol te skye zhing kun du skye la/ 'grub cing mngon par 'grub pa dang / yang dag par 'grub cing 'byung ba rnams te/de dag kyang gang zhe na/ smras pa/ 'di lta ste/ ngang pa dang / khrung khrung dang / rma bya dang / ṣ+pe tso dang / ri skegs dang / khu byug dang / shang shang te'u la sogs pa dang / klu kha cig dang / nam mkha' lding kha cig dang /mi kha cig dang / gzhan yang sems can gang dag sgo nga las skyes pa rngurnams dang /sgo nga na 'dug pa rnams dang / sgo nga'i sbubs kyi spris g.yogs 1pa rnams dang /sgo nga'i sbubs brtol te skye zhing kun du skye la/ 'grub cing mngon par 'grub pa dang / yang dag par 'grub cing 'byung ba rnams te/ 'di ni sgo nga las skye ba'i skye gnas zhes bya'o/ /mngal nas skye ba'i skye gnas gang zhe na/ smras pa/sems can gang dag mngal nas skye ba rnams dang / mngal na 'dug pa rnams dang / mngal kyi sbubs kyis ④g.yogs pa rnams dang / mngal gye sbubs brtol te skye zhing kun du skye la/ 'grub cing mngon par 'grub pa dang / yang dag par 'grub cing 'byung ba rnams te/ de dag kyang gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/glang po che dang / rta dang / rnga mo dang / ba lang dang / bong ⑤ bu dang /ma he dang / ri dwags dang / phag la sogs pa dang / klu kha cig dang /nam mkha' lding kha cig dang / yi dwags kha cig dang / mi kha cig dang /gzhan yang sems can gang dag mngal nas skye ba rnams dang / mngal na 'dug pa rnams dang / mngal kyi sbubs kyis ⑪g.yogs pa rnams dang /mngal gyi sbubs brtol te skye zhing kun du skye la 'grub cing mngon par 'grub pa 78—1031

dang / yang dag par 'grub cing 'byung ba rnams te/ 'di ni mngal nas skye ba'i skye gnas zhes bya'o/ /drod gsher las skye ba'i skye gnas gang zhe na/ smras pa / sems can gang dag phan tshun gyi drod dang / phan tshun gyi me dang /phan tshun gyi rdul dang / phan tshun gyi gnod pa dang / phan tshun btsir bas nyal nyil gyi phung po la brten tamaḥ/ stor khung dang / phyi sa'i gnas sam/sha rul dze+elam/ nya rul ①lam/ zan dron rul ba'am/ rtswa stug po'am④/nags tshal stug po'am/ rtswa'i spyil po'am/ lo ma'i spyil po'am/ chu rul ba'am / khyem gyi sang seng ngam/ sbrang bu'i tshangs la ⑤brten nas/ skye zhing kun du skye la 'grub cing mngon par 'grub pa dang / yang dag par 'grub cing 'byung ba rnams te/ de dag kyang gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ srin ④bu dang / sbur bu dang / phye ma leb dang / sbrang bu mchu rings ⑦dang / til dang / phub ma dang / shing za ba la sogs pa dang / klu kha cig dang /nam mkha' lding kha cig dang / mi kha cig dang / gzhan yang sems can gang dag phan tshun gyi drod dang / phan tshun gyi me dang / phan tshun gyi rdul dang /phan tshun gnod pa dang / phan tshun btsir ldubs/ skye zhing kun du skye la 'grub cing mngon par 'grub pa dang / yang dag par 'grub cing 'byung ba rnams te/ 'di ni drod gsher las skye ba'i spuskye gnas zhes bya'o/ /rdzus te skye ba'i skye gnas gang zhe na/ smras pa/ sems can gang dag yan lag dang /nying lag thams cad dang ldan zhing rdzogs pa dbang po ma tshang ba med pa rnams cig car skye zhing kun du skye la 'grub cing mngon par 'grub pa dang / yang dag par 'grub cing mngon par 'grub pa rnams te/ de dag kyang gang zhe na/ lha 78—1032

thams cad dang / sems can dmyal ba pa rmyethams cad dang / bar ma do'i srid pa pa khruthams cad dang / klu kha cig dang / nam mkha' lding kha cig dang /yi dwags kha cig dang / mi kha cig dang / gzhan yang sems can gang dag yan lag dang / nying lag thams cad dang ldan zhing rdzogs pa dbang po ma tshang ba med pa rnams cig car skye zhing kun du skye la 'grub cing mngon par 'grub pa dang / yang dag par 'grub cing 'byung ba rnams te/ 'di ni rdzus te skye ba'i skye gnas zhes bya'o/ /'gro ba lnga ni 'di lta ste/ sems can dmyal ba'i 'gro ba dang / dud 'gro'i 'gro ba dang / yi dwags kyi 'gro ba dang / lha dang mi'o—/ /sems can dmyal ba'i 'gro ba gang zhe na/ smras pa/ sems can dmyal ba pa rnams dang 'dra bar gyur pa dang / grogs su gyur pa dang / skal ba mnyam pa dang / gnas thob pa dang / gzhi thob pa dang / skye mched thob pa dang / sems can dmyal ba pa der skyes pa ④rnams kyi ma bsgribs la lung du ma bstan pa'i gzugs dang / tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed rnams dang / rnam par shes pa gang yin pa de yang sems can dmyal ba'i 'gro ba zhes bya'o/ /gzhan yang lus kyis ④nyes par spyod pa dang / ngag gis ⑤nyes par spyod pa dang / yid kyis ⑥nyes par spyod pa ④chen po kun du bsten zhing bsgoms te mang du byas pas sems can dmyal bar 'gro zhing sems can dmyal ba rnams su skye ste/ sems can dmyal ba rnams su nying mtshams sbyor ba de ni sems can dmyal ba'i 'gro ba zhes bya'o/ /gzhan yang ming dang rnam pa'i tshig dang / tshig bla dwags dang / ming du btags ④pa dang / kun du rig pa dang / gdags pa dang / tha snyad kyi sems can dmyal ba'i 'gro ba yang 78—1033

sems can dmyal ba zhes bya'o/ /dud 'gro'i 'gro ba gang zhe na/ smras pa/dud 'gro rnams dang 'dra bar gyur pa dang / grogs su gyur pa nas skye mched thob pa'i bar dang / dud 'gro'i skye gnas su gyur pa der skyes pa rnams kyi ma bsgribs la lung du ma bstan pa'i gzugs nas rnam par shes pa'i bar gang yin pa de yang dud 'gro'i 'gro ba zhes bya'o/ /gzhan yang lus kyi las dang /ngag gi las dang / yid kyi las yon po kun du bsten zhing bsgoms te mang du byas pas dud 'gror rmye 'gro zhing dud 'gro rnams su skyes te dud 'gro rnams su nying mtshams spyor ba de ni dud 'gro'i du'agro ba zhes bya'o/ /gzhan yang ming dang / rnam pa'i tshig dang / tshig bla dwags zhes bya ba nas snga ma bzhin du sbyar ro/ /yi dwags kyi 'gro ba gang zhe na/ smras pa/ yi dwags rnams dang 'dra bar gyur pa nas skye mched thob pa'i bar gang yin pa dang / yi dwags der skyes pa rnams kyi ma bsgribs la lung du ma bstan pa'i gzugs nas/ rnam par shes pa'i bar gang yin pa de yang yi dwags kyi 'gro ba zhes bya'o/ /gzhan yang ser sna kun du bsten cing bsgoms te mang du byas pas yi dwags su 'gro zhing yi dwags rnams su skye ste yi dwags rnams su nying mtshams sbyor ba de ni yi dwags kyi 'gro ba zhes bya'o/ /gzhan yang ming dang / rnam pa'i tshig dang / tshig bla dwags zhes bya ba nas snga ma bzhin du sbyar ro/ /lha'i 'gro ba gang zhe na/ smras pa—/ lha rnams dang 'dra bar gyur pa nas skye mched thob pa'i bar dang / lha der skyes pa rnams kyi ma bsgribs la lus du ma bstan ①pa'i gzugs nas/rnam par shes pa'i bar gang yin pa de yang lha'i 'gro ba zhes bya'o/ /gzhan yang lus kyis legs par spyod pa dang / ngag gis legs par spyod pa dang / yid 78—1034

kyis legs par spyod pa chen po kun du bsten zhing bsgoms te mang du byas pas lhar 'gro zhing lha rnams kyi nang du skye ste/ lha rnams kyi nang du nying mtshams sbyor ba de ni/ lha'i 'gro ba zhes bya'o/ /gzhan yang ming dang rnam pa'i tshig ces bya ba nas snga ma bzhin du sbyar ro/ /mi'i 'gro ba gang zhe na/ smras pa/ mi rnams dang 'dra bar 'gyur ba dang / grogs su gyur pa dang / skal ba mnyam pa dang / gnas thob pa dang / gzhi thob pa dang / skye mched thob pa dang /mi 'dir skyes pa 1rnams kyi ma bsgribs la lung du ma bstan pa'i gzugs dang /tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed rnams dang / rnam par shes pa gang yin pa de yang mi'i 'gro ba zhes bya'o/ /gzhan yang lus kyis chalegs par spyod pa dang / ngag gis ⑪legs par spyod pa dang / yid kyis ④legs par spyod pa ④chung ngu kun du bsten zhing bsgoms te mang du byas pas mir 'gro zhing mi rnams kyi nang du skye ste/ mi rnams kyi nang du nying mtshams sbyor ba de ni/mi'i 'gro ba zhes bya'o/ /gzhan yang ming dang / rnam pa'i tshig dang / tshig bla dwags dang / ming du btags khyepa dang / kun du rig pa dang /gdags pa dang / tha snyad kyi mi'i 'gro ba yang mi'i 'gro ba zhes bya'o/ /'gro ba gang la skye gnas du yod ce na/ smras pa/ sems can dmyal ba pa rnams ni rdzus te skye ba'i skye gnas gcig pu yod do/ /dud 'gro rnams la skye gnas du yod ce na/ smras pa/ bzhi po thams cad yod do/ /yi dwags rnams la skye gnas du yod ce na/ smras pa/ rdzus te skye ba gcig pu yod do/ /la la ni yi dwags rnams la mngal nas skye ba yang yod do zhes zer ba yang yod de/ ji lta zhe na/ smras pa/ dper na yi dwags mo zhig gis tshe dang ldan pa mod gal gyi 78—1035

bu'i mdun du tshigs su bcad ①pa smras pa/ 'dir ni nyin mo bu lnga btsas/ /mtshan ④mo gzhan lnga btsas gyur nas/ /zos su zin kyang de dag gis/ /bdag ni 'grangs ①par ma gyur to/ /zhes smras pa lta bu'o/ /lha rnams la skye gnas du yod ce na/ smras pa/ rdzus te skye ba gcig pu yod do/ /mi rnams la skye gnas du yod ce na/ smras pa/ bzhi ④po thams cad yod do/ /mi rnams la sgo nga las skye ba'i skye gnas ji ltar yod ce na/ smras pa/ dper na 'dzam bu'i gling pa'i tshong pa mang po rgya mtsho'i 'gram nas bskor ba rnams kyis khrung khrung gzhon nu ma gnyis mthong ba las gcig ni bros/ gcig ni de dag gis bzung ste / de dag de dang lhan cig tu 'tshos nas/ de dag phye'atshos pa'i rkyen gyes sgo nga gnyis byung ste/ de gnyis smin te brtol ba las byes pa gzugs bzang zhing blta na sdug skyel mdzes pa gnyis byung nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi ⑦bstan pa la rab tu byung ste/ de nyid ⑧kyis brtson pa dang sbyor ba dang / 'bad pa byas pas mchog gi /⑨'bras bu dgra bcom pa nyid mngon sum du byas te/ tshe dang ldan pa de gnyis rdzu 'phrul che zhing mthu che bar gyur te/ brag dang nye ba'i brag ces bya bar gyur pa ⑫ lta bu dang / dper na ri dwags dgra'i bu mo sa ga las sgo nga sum cu rtsa gnyis byung ste/ de dag smin te brdol /⑪ba las byis pa gzugs bzang zhing blta tren sdug pa ⑫mdzes pa/ tshan po che chen po'i stobs dang ldan pa sum cu rtsa gnyis byung ste/ de dag gis nyes pa 'ga' zhig byas pa'i phyir ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal skrag pas bsad pa lta bu dang / dper na 'das pa'i dus na lnga len gyi rgyal po'i btsun mo pad+ma can las sgo nga lnga brgya byung ste—/ de dag smin te brdol ④ba las byis pa gzugs bzang zhing blta na sdug 78—1036

la mdzes pa/ tshan po che chen po'i stobs dang ldan pa lnga brgya byung ste/ de dag 'ga' zhig las huskyo ba skyes nas skra dang kha spu rnams byegs te rab tu byung nas—/ de dag brtson pa dang sbyor ba dang / 'bad pas rang sangs rgyas kyi byang chub mngon par sangs rgyas pa lta bu'o/ /de la sogs pa gzhan dag kyang brjod par bya ste/ de ltar na mi rnams la sgo nga las skye ba'i skye laganas yod do/ /mi rnams la mngal nas skye ba'i skye gnas ji ltar yod ce na/ smras pa/ da ltar gyi mi rnams ji lta ba bzhin te/ de ltar na mi rnams la mngal nas skye ba'i skye gnas yod do/ /mi rnams la drod gsher las skye ba'i skye gnas ji ltar yod ce na/smras pa/ dper na rgyal po tshangs pas byin gyi brang nas/ thor bu 'di lta ste/shing bal gyi 'da' ba'am/ ras 1bal gyi 'da' ba lta bur 'jam zhing shin tu 'jam la gnod pa cung gezad kyang med pa zhig byung ste/ de smin te brdol byeb las bu mo gzugs bzang zhing blta na sdug la mdzes pa zhig skyes te/ phug ron phreng ldan zhes bya bar gyur nas/ de dus gzhan zhig na skyes shing dbang po rnams yongs su smin par bhugyur pa na/ sngon ma thos par tshigs su bcad pa 'di lta bu zhig dran te/ smras pa/ mtshon rnams gang nas ldog par gyur⑦/ /lam ni gang du ldog par 'gyur/ /bde dang sdug bsngal 'jig rten na/ /gang du ma lus 'gag par 'gyur/ /zhes smras so/ /de nas bram ze'i khye'u gcam bu mu ⑧cor smra ba spyi brtol can zhig gis bu mo de la 'di skad du/ bu mo de ni ci yang ma yin pa zhig go zhes smras te/ de skad smras pa dang / bu mo de ci yang med pa'i skye mched la snyoms par zhugs pa lta bu dang / dper na rgyal po gso sbyong 'phags kyi spyi bo las thor bu 'di lta ste/ shing bal lam/ ras ⑨78—1037

bal lta bur 'jam zhing shin tu 'jam la gnod pa cung zad kyang med pa zhig byung steske/ de smin te brdol ①ba las byis pa gzugs bzang zhing blta na sdug la mdzes pa skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis kyis brgyan pa zhig skyes te/spyi bo nas skyes so/ /⑤spyi bo nas skyes so zhes zer nas/ ming nga las nu nga las nu zhes bya bar gyur to/ /byis pa de rdzu 'phrul che zhing mthu che bar gyur te1—/ des kyang gling bzhir rgyal srid kyi dbang phyug la dbang byas pa lta bu dang /dper na rgyal po nga las nu'i brla g.yas pa las thor ④ bu 'di lta ste/ shing bal lam / ras khru/ bal lta bur 'jam zhing shin tu 'jam la/ cung zad kyang gnod pa med pa zhig byung ste/ de smin te brdol du ba las byis pa gzugs bzang zhing blta na sdug la mdzes pa skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis kyis brgyan pa zhig skyes te/ rkang pa g.yas pa nas skyes so/ /rkang pa g.yas pa nas skyes so zhes zer nas/ ming mdzes pa mdzes pa zhes bya bar gyur to/ /byis pa de khyerdzu 'phrul che zhing mthu che bar gyur te/ des kyang gling gsum du rgyal srid kyi dbang phyug la dbang byas pa lta bu dang / dper na rgyal po mdzes pa'i brla g.yon pa nas thor bu 'di lta ste/ shing bal kyi 'da' ba 'am ras tre bal gyi 'da' ba lta bur 'jam shing kyeshin tu 'jam la/ cung ⑩zad kyang gnod pa med pa zhig byung ste/ de smin te brdol ⑪ba las byes pa gzugs bzang zhing blta na sdug la mdzes pa skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis kyis brgyan pa zhig skyes te rkang pa g.yon pa nas skyes so/ /rkang pa g.yon pa nas skyes so zhes zer nas/ ming nye mdzes nye mdzes zhes bya bar gyur to/ /byis pa de rdzu 'phrul che zhing mthu che bar gyur te/ des kyang gling gnyis su rgyal srid kyi dbang 78—1038

phyug la dbang byas pa lta bu dang / dper na rgyal po nye mdzes kyi rkang pa'i steng gi ① bol nas thor bu 'di lta ste/ shing bal gyi 'da' ba'am/ ras tsa bal gyi 'da' ba lta bur 'jam zhing shin tu 'jam la/ gnod pa cung zad 1 med pa zhig byung ste/ de smin te brdol ④ba las byes pa gzugs bzang zhing blta na sdug la mdzes pa skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis kyis ⑪brgyan pa zhig skyes te/ rkang pa'i steng gi bol nas skyes so/ /rkang pa'i steng gi bol nas skyes so zhes zer nas/ ming mdzes ldan mdzes ldan zhes bya bar gyur to/ /byis pa de rdzu 'phrul che zhing mthu che bar gyur nas des kyang gling gcig tu rgyal srid kyi dbang phyug la dbang byas pa lta bu dang / dper na rgyal po mdzes ldan gye rkang pa'i 'og gi mthil byunas thor bu 'di lta ste/ shing bal gyi 'da' ba dang /ras bu bal kyi 'da' ba lta bur 2'jam zhing shin tu 'jam la gnod pa cung zad kyang khyamed pa zhig byung ste/ de smin te brdol ⑩ba las byis pa gzugs bzang zhing blta ⑩na sdug la mdzes pa/ skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis kyis brgyan pa zhig skyes te8/ rkang pa'i 'og gi mthil kyenas skyes so/ /rkang pa'i 'og gi mthil tshunas skyes so zhes zer nas/ ming mdzes can mdzes can zhes bya bar gyur to/ /byis pa de rdzu 'phrul che zhing mthu che bar gyur te/ des kyang 'dzam bu'i gling du rgyal srid kyi dbang phyug la dbang byas pa lta bu dang / dper na yangs pa can na ming chen gyi skyed mos tshal du shing a phra las bu mo gzugs bzang zhing blta na sdug la mdzes pa zhig skyes te/ ming a mras bskyangs skyem zhes bya bar gyur nas/ bu mo de yang tshogs kyis tshogs kyi spyad par byas pa lta bu'o / /de la sogs pa gzhan dag kyang brjod par bya ste/ de ltar na ⑫mi 78—1039

rnams la drod gsher las skye ba'i skye ⑫gnas yod do/ /de spyornams la rdzus te skye ba'i skye gnas ji ltar yod ce na/ smras pa/ dper na bskal pa dang po pa ①thams cad rdzus te skyes pa lta bu dang / dper na dge slong ma dgon pa ma skra byegs shing gos ngur smrig gon ④bzhin du dgon pa nas byung ba lta bu'o/ /de la sogs pa gzhan dag kyang brjod par bya ste/ de ltar na mi rnams la rdzus te skye ba'i skye gnas yod do/ /ci'i phyir sems can dmyal ba rnams zhes bya zhe na/smras pa/ yid du 'ong ba med cing bde ba dang yid bde ba dang bral ba'i phyir rgyu des na ⑤sems can dmyal ba rnams zhes bya'o/ /ci'i phyir dud 'gro rnams zhes bya zhe na/ smras pa/ dud de /dzo'agro zhing dud de 'ongs pas klun/de'i phyir dud 'gro rnams zhes bya'o/ /ci'i phyir yi dwags rnams zhes bya zhe na/smras pa/ da ltar yi dwags rnams kyi rgyal po gshin rje ji lta ba bzhin du de'i dus na yi dwags rnams kyi rgyal po pha zhes bya bar gyur te/ pha'i yul du 'gro'o/ /pha'i yul nas 'ong ngo zhes zer nas/ ming yi dwags yi dwags ghuzhes bya bar gyur te/ rgyu des na yi dwags rnams zhes bya'o/ /ci'i phyir mi rnams zhes bya zhe na/ smras pa/ rgyal po nga las nu des ⑨bstan pa'i mi rnams ni las chen po'o ⑫cog blos bskyed pa dang / bsams te 'jam zhing nye bar brtags nas byed pa dang / brtags shing gzhal te nye bar rtog par byed pas na mi mi zhes bya bar gyur te/ rgyu des na mi rnams zhes bya'o/ /ci'i phyir lha rnams zhes bya zhe na / smras pa/ 'bar ba'i phyir na lha rnams zhes bya'o/ /gzhan yang 'gro ba rnams dang / skye ba rnams dang / lus thob pa rnams kyi mchog yin pas na lha rnams zhes bya'o/ /ci'i phyir mtho ris zhes bya zhe na/ smras pa/ sems 78—1040

can de dag bde ba dang ldan zhing skyid la/ gnod pa med cing / gnod pa med pa'i chos dang ldan te/ bde ba dang / yid bde ba mchog dang / gnod pa med pa'i bde ba dang / bde ba'i tshor ①ba dang ldan pas na mtho ris zhes bya'o/ /ci'i phyir lha'i bu mo zhes bya zhe na/ smras pa/ gsal zhing rnyog pa med pa'i phyir lha'i bu mo zhes bya ba dang / bag byed cing dga' ba'i shas che ba'i phyir lha'i bu mo zhes bya ste/ rgyu des na lha'i bu mo rnams zhes bya'o // //zhurgyu gdags pa/ldu bam po bdun pa ste ④tha ma/ ci'i phyir ma zhes bya zhe na smras pa/ nu zho snun ⑤par byed pa dang / gso bar byed pa'i phyir ma zhes bya ba dang / mkhas shing blo dang ldan pa'i phyir ma zhes bya ste/ rgyu des na ma zhes bya'o/ /ci'i phyir pha zhes bya zhe na/ smras pa/ skye ba 'grub pa la bu rgyud kyi las dang 'byel pa'i rgyu dang po de yin pa dang / rkyen de yin pas na de'i phyir pha zhes bya'o/ /ci'i phyir zhang po zhes bya zhe na/ smras pa/ ma dang rigs gcig tu 'byel pas na/ de'i phyir zhang po zhes bya'o/ /ci'i phyir khu bo zhes bya zhe na/ smras pa/ skyed pa'i pha la ni pha zhes bya ste/ 'di ni bdag gi pha'i thabs so/ /zhes bya bas na de'i phyir khya bo zhes bya'o/ /ci'i phyir phu nu zhes bya zhe na/ smras pa/ rigs las skal ba gcod pas na de'i phyir phu nu zhes bya'o/ /ci'i phyir sring mo zhes bya zhe na/ smras pa/ rigs las bkur ster bya ba dang / bla mar bya ba dang / ri mor bya ba dang / mchod par bya ba dang / rim gror dubya ba'i skal ba dbang ba na/ de'i phyir sring mo zhes bya'o//ci'i phyir ma las 'o ma 'byung la pha las mi 'byung zhe na/ smras pa/ ma'i mngal nas skye ba dang 'brel bar 'gyur ⑦rmi/ pha dang 'brel ba med pa'i phyir 78—1041

ro—/ /gzhan yang ches lhag par ma bu la byams kyi pha ni de lta ma yin te/ rgyu des ①na ma las 'o ma 'byung gi pha las mi 'byung ngo / /ci'i phyir bud med la 'gram spu dang kha spu med ce na/ smras pa/ ma ning bzhin du de'i dbang po rnams zhan pas na/ de'i phyir bud med la 'gram spu dang kha spu med do/ /ci'i phyir ma ning la 'gram spu dang kha spu med ce na/ smras pa/ bud med bzhin du de'i dbang po rnams zhen ②pas na de'i phyir 'gram spu dang kha spu med do//ci'i phyir rgyal po zhes bya zhe na smras pa/ chos dang / ngang tshul dang / spyod tshul kun du spyod pas 'khor rangs par byed pas na/ de'i phyir rgyal po zhes bya'o / /ci'i phyir rgyal rigs zhes bya zhe na/ smras pa/zhu zhing rnams kyi bdag por gyur pas na de'i phyir rgyal rigs zhes bya'o/ /ci'i phyir bram ze zhes bya zhe na/ smras pa/ phyi rol du sems pas na de'i phyir bram ze zhes bya'o/ /ci'i phyir rje'u rigs zhes bya zhe na/ smras pa/dhi nyon mongs pa rnam pa ⑤sna tshogs dang ldan pa'i las byed pas na/ de'i phyir rje'u rigs zhes bya'o/ /ci'i phyir dmangs rigs zhes bya zhe na/ smras pa/ pya ngan las byed pa dang /gnod pa'i las byed pas na de'i phyir dmangs ④rigs zhes bya'o/ /ci'i phyir gdol pa zhes bya zhe na/ smras pa/ bskal pa dang po'i mi rnams su yang pha rol gye mi len pa las phyis mi zhig gis ⑧pha rol gyi ma byin par blangs nas de rgyal po'i srung ⑨ma'i mis bzung ste/ rgyal rigs spyi bo nas dbang bsgur ba'i rgyal po la phul nas/ lha mkhyen par mdzad du gsol/ mi 'dis ni pha rol gyi ma byin par blangs lags so/ /rgyal pos de dag la smras pa/ khyed deng la mi 'di sod cig ces byas na/ mi de dag las su yang mi de gsad ⑫par spro ba ⑪ma 78—1042

byung nas/ de dag la spyi bo nas dbang bskur ba'i rgyal pos 'di skad ces smras te/su mi 'di gsod pa de la ngas ①nor gyi phung po chen po sbyin no/ /de nas mi gzhan nor don du gnyer zhing nor 'dod la nor la brkam buzhing nor gyi nyes sdig can zhig gis mi de bsad do/ /mi de bsad nas de dag 'di snyam sems te/mi 'di ni gtum po zhig ste/ 'di ltar nor don du gnyer ba dang / nor 'dod pa dang / nor la brkam ④pa dang / nor gyi nyes sdig gis mi sun ma phyung zhing nyes pa med pa bsad kyis/ mi 'di ni dgos pa med do/ /mi 'di ni gtum po'i ④zhes zer nas ming ⑤gdol pa gdol pa ⑥zhes bya bar gyur te/rgyu des na gdol pa rnams zhes bya'o/ /chos mngon pa'i bstan bcos chen po rgyu gdags pa las tshigs bcwa lnga pa'o // //⑦sdom ni/ dud 'gro sbrul dang glang po rta/ /rnga mo ba lang phyugs ⑤dang glang / /rwa ⑨dang 'jam dang drag pa dang / /chu gnas bkren ⑩pa tshigs kyi sdom—/ /ci'i phyir dud 'gro zhes bya zhe na/ smras pa/ sems can las shin tu gnag 0pa dang ldan pa zhig 'od gsal gyi lha'i ris nas shi 'phos nas 'jig rten gyi khams 'dir mi rnams dang skal ba mnyam par bskal pa dang po'i mi rnams kyi nang du skyes so/ /de 'dir skyes nas des lag pa gnyis sa la btsugs te—/ dud de 'gro ba las ming dud 'gro dud 'gro zhes bya bar gyur te/ rgyu des na dud 'gro rnams zhes bya'o/ /ci'i phyir sbrul zhes bya zhe na/ smras pa/sems can las shin tu gnag pa dang ldan pa zhig 'od gsal gyi lha'i ris nas shi 'phos nas 'jig rten kyi khams 'dir mi rnams dang skal ba ⑫mnyam par bskal 78—1043

pa dang po'i mi rnams kyi nang du skyes so①/ /de 'dir skyes nas lag pa gnyis dang rkang pa gnyis med par gyur te/ de ltos 'phye bar gyur nas de dag 'di skad du/ sems can 'di ltos phye'o ④sems can 'di ltos phye'o 1zhes zer nas/ming lto 'phye lto 'phye zhes bya bar gyur te/ rgyu des na sbrul zhes bya'o/ /ci'i phyir glang po che zhes bya zhe na/ smras pa/ sems can las shin tu gnag pa dang ldan pa zhig 'od gsal gyi lha'i ris nas shi 'phos nas 'jig rten gyi ④khams 'dir mi rnams dang skal ba ⑤mnyam par bskal pa dang po'i mi rnams kyi nang du skyes te/ de 'dir skyes nas des bulag pa gnyis sa la btsugs te/de'i sna yang ring por gyur nas/ lag pas 'gro zhing lag ④pas 'ong bas ming glang po che glang po che zhes bya bar gyur te/ rgyu des na glang po che rnams zhes bya'o//ci'i phyir rta zhes bya zhe na/ smras pa/ sems can las shin tu gnag pa dang ldan pa zhig 'od gsal ④gyi lha'i ris nas shi 'phos nas 'jig rten gyi khams 'dir mi rnams dang skal ba mnyam par bskal pa dang po'i mi rnams kyi nang du skyes te/ de 'dir skyes nas dgon pa'i gnas rnams su rgyu bar gyur to/ /de nas sems can de dag gis mthong nas 'di skad du kye su'i zhes byas pa dang /smras pa/ kye 'di ni su'i yang ma yin no zhes zer nas ming rta rta zhes bya bar gyur te/ rgyu des na rta rnams zhes bya'o/ /ci'i phyir rnga mo zhes bya zhe na/smras pa/ sems can las shin tu gnag pa dang ldan pa zhig 'od gsal gye lha'i ris nas shi 'phos nas 'jig rten gyi khams 'dir mi rnams dang skal ba mnyam par bskal pa dang po'i mi rnams kyi nang du skyes te/ de 'dir skyes nas mchu gnyis 'phyang la mgrin bhupa yang gye gu can du gyur nas/ de dag 'di skad du/78—1044

mchu gnyis 'phyang 1ngo mchu gnyis 'phyang khyengo zhes zer nas/ de dag gis de'i ming rnga mo zhes btags sne te/ rgyu des na rnga mo rnams zhes bya'o/ /ci'i phyir ba lang zhes bya zhe na/ smras pa/ sems can las shin tu gnag pa dang ldan pa zhig 'od gsal gyi lha'i ris nas shi 'phos nas ④'jig rten gyi khams 'dir mi rnams dang skal ba mnyam par bskal pa dang po'i mi rnams kyi nang du skyes te/de 'dir skyes nas tshogs kyi nang nas byung ste/ dgon pa'i gnas dag na rgyu zhing / sems can de tshogs kyi nang nas byung nas dgon pa'i gnas dag na rgyu zhing tshogs kyi nang na mi gnas pa'i phyir de'i ming ba lang zhes bya bar gyur te/rgyu des na ba lang rnams zhes bya'o/ /ci'i phyir phyugs zhes bya zhe na/ smras pa/sems can las shin tu gnag pa dang ldan pa zhig 'od gsal gyi lha'i ris nas shi 'phos nas 'jig rten gyi khams 'dir mi rnams dang skal ba mnyam par bskal pa dang po'i mi rnams kyi nang du skyes te/ de 'dir skyes nas dgon pa'i gnas rnams su rgyu ba ⑤mi de dag gi ⑪glo nas 'dzin cing / glo nas 'dzin pas na ming phyugs zhes btags te rgyu des na phyugs rnams zhes bya'o/ /ci'i phyir glang bu zhes bya zhe na/ smras pa/ sems can las shin tu gnag pa dang ldan pa zhig 'od gsal gyi lha'i ris nas shi 'phos nas 'jig rten gyi khams 'dir mi rnams dang skal ba mnyam par bskal pa dang po'i mi rnams kyi nang du skyes te/ de 'dir skyes nas shin tu stobs che zhing khal khyer ba'i phyir ming glang bu glang bu zhes bya bar gyur te/ rgyu des na glang bu rnams zhes bya'o/ /ci'i phyir sems can kha cig ni rwa'i stobs dang ldan/ kha cig ni sder mo'i stobs dang ldan/ kha cig ni mche ba'i stobs dang ldan par gyur ce na/ smras pa/ sems can gang 78—1045

dag sngon mir gyur pa ①na mtshon chas brgyan pa dang / mtshon cha lag char thogs par gyur te/ de dag nyes par spyod pa kun du bsten cing bsgoms te mang du byas pas des lus zhig nas shi ba'i 'og tu ngan song ngan 'gro log par lhung ba sems can dmyal ba rnams su skyes te/ de dag sems can dmyal ba rnams nas shi 'phos nas las kyi lhag ma lus pa des dud 'gro rnams su skye bar gyur te/ der kha cig ni rwa'i stobs dang ldan/ kha cig ni sder mo'i stobs dang ldan/ kha cig ni mche ba'i stobs dang ldan par gyur te/ rgyu des na kha cig ni rwa'i stobs dang ldan/ kha cig ni sder mo'i stobs dang ldan/ kha cig ni mche ba'i stobs dang ldan par gyur to/ /ci'i phyir spu gshor bar gyur ce na/smras pa/ sa'i khams kyi shas che ba'i phyir ro/ /gzhan yang sems can gang dag sngon mir gyur pa na lus kyi las rtsub pa dang / ngag gi las rtsub pa dang /yid kyi las rtsub pa de dag nyes par spyod pa kun du bsten cing bsgoms te mang du byas pa des/ lus zhig nas shi ba'i 'og tu ngan song ngan 'gro log par ltung ba sems can dmyal ba rnams su skyes te/ de dag de nas shi 'phos nas gal te mi rnams dang skal ba mnyam par khams 'dir skyes khyen yang las kyi lhag ma lus pa des 1 sru gshor bar gyur to/ /ci'i phyir spu 'jam par gyur ce na/ smras pa/sems can gang dag sngon mir gyur pa na ④lus kyi las rtsub pa ma byas/ ngag gi las rtsub pa ma byas/ yid kyi las rtsub pa ma byas te/ de dag legs par spyod pa kun du bsten cing bsgoms te mang du byas pa des/ lus zhig nas ⑤shi ba'i 'og tu bde 'gro mtho ris kyi 'jig rten du lha rnams kyi nang du skyes te/de nas shi 'phos nas gal te mi rnams dang skal ba mnyam par khams 'dir skyes 78—1046

na yang las kyi lhag ma lus pa des spu 'jam par gyur te/ rgyu des na spu 'jam par gyur to/ /ci'i phyir dug drag par 'gyur zhe na/ smras pa/ gnod sems kyi shas che ba'i phyir ro/ /gzhan yang sems can gang dag dug drag pa de dag gi nang nas nye zhing du bas nye bar shi 'phos pa rnams yin te/ de dag kyang gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ sbrul dang / sdig pa dang / sbrang rgod mdung gsum pa ①dang / sbrang rgod mdung gsum pa chen po dang / srin gye med rkyel sogs pa ste/ rgyu des na dug drag por 'gyur ro/ /ci'i phyir dug drag por mi 'gyur zhe na/ smras pa/ gnod sems med pa'i khams shas che ba'i phyir ro/ /gzhan yang sems can gang dag dug drag pa ma yin pa de dag gi nang nas nye zhing du bas nye bar shi 'phos pa rnams yin te/ de dag kyang gang zhe na/'di lta ste/ drang srong rnams dang / rab tu byung ba rnams dang / khyem bdag rnams dang / gzugs dang / gzugs med pa na spyod pa'i lha rnams te—/ rgyu des na dug drag por mi 'gyur ro/ /ci'i phyir chu na gnas pa'i sems can rnams dang skal ba mnyam par skye bar 'gyur zhe na/ smras pa/sems can gang dag skom zhing gdungs la/ skams te chu 'dod bzhi na du 'chi ba de dag la lus zhig nas chu na gnas pa'i sems can rnams dang skal ba 1mnyam par skye bar 'gyur ro/ /ci'i phyir bya rnams dang skal ba mnyam par skye bar 'gyur zhe na/ smras pa/ sems can gang dag dog cing yongs su gzir bar 'gyur khyote/ go skabs yangs pa 'dod bzhin du 'chi ba de dag lus zhig nas bya rnams dang skal ba phye mnyam par skye bar ⑥'gyur ro/ /'gro ba der smin par 'gyur ba'i las byas shing bstsags pa las kyang 'gyur te/ chu na gnas pa 78—1047

rnams la yang de bzhin du brjod par bya'o/ /ci'i phyir sa'i phyogs bkren pa zas dang skom nyung ba rnams su skye bar 'gyur zhe na/ smras pa/ sems can gang dag sngon mir gyur pa na/ lus kyi las rtsub po dang / ngag gi las rtsub po dang / yid kyi las rtsub por gyur pa de dag nyes par spyod pa kun du bsten cing bsgoms te mang du byas pa des/ lus zhig nas shi ba'i 'og tu ngan song ngan 'gro log par ltung ①ba sems can dmyal ba rnams su skye bar 'gyur te/gal te de nas shi 'phos nas khams 'dir mi rnams dang skal ba mnyam par skyes na yang las kyi lhag ma lus pa des/ 'dir sa phyogs bkren pa zas dang skom nyung ba dag tu skye bar 'gyur te/ rgyu des na sa ④phyogs bkren pa zas dang skom nyung ba dag tu skye bar 'gyur ro/ /ci'i phyir sa phyogs gshin pa zas dang / skom mod pa dag tu skye bar 'gyur zhe na/ smras pa/ sems can gang dag sngon mir gyur pa na/ lus kyi las drang po dang / ngag gi las drang po dang / yid kyi las drang por gyur pa de dag legs par spyod pa kun du bsten cing bsgoms te mang du byas pa des/ lus zhig nas shi ba'i 'og tu bde 'gro mtho ris kyi 'jig rten lha rnams kyi nang du skyes par gyur 1te/ gal te de nas shi 'phos nas khams 'dir mi rnams dang skal ba mnyam par skye na yang las kyi lhag ma lus pa des 'dir sa phyogs gshin pa zas dang skom mod pa dag tu skye bar 'gyur te/rgyu des na sa phyogs gshin pa zas dang skom mod pa dag tu skye bar 'gyur ro/ /chos mngon pa'i bstan bcos dge ba dang mi dge ba'i rgyu dang 'bras bu bstan pa/rgyu gdags pa las tshigs bcu drug pa'o // //④78—1048

sdom ni/ sems dmyal sbrul dang byi ba khyi/ /glang chen rta dang rnga mo dang / /ba lang bong 1bu ri dwags dang / /ra lug khwa rnams tshigs kyi sdom/ /sems can dmyal ba dag nas shi 'phos pa rnams kyi rnam pa ni gang dag yin/mtshan ma ni gang dag yin/ rtags ni gang dag yin zhe na/ smras pa/sems can gang dag skem pa dang / ngan pa la dga' ba dang / mdog ngan pa dang / 'jigs bhupa dang / bag tsha ba dang / sdang skyen ④pa dang /'bros pa dang / lus mdog tshig pa ltar 'dug pa dang / rmi lam na ④me dang / ral gri dang / mdung thung dang / mda' bo che dang / mtshon nas 'bras lta bu dang / mde'u thung dang / lcags zangs dang / khar zangs kyi nang du bsregs pa rmi ba de dag ni nye zhing dubs nye bar sems can dmyal ba dag nas shi 'phos pa yin te/ sems can dmyal ba dag nas shi 'phos pa rnams kyi rnam pa ni de dag yin no/ /mtshan ma ni de dag yin no/ /rtags ni de dag yin no/ /sbrul dag gi nang nas shi 'phos pa rnams kyi rnam pa ni gang dag yin/ mtshan ma ni gang dag yin/ rtags ni gang dag yin zhe na/smras pa/ sems can gang dag shugs myur zhing mgyogs pa dang / rang bzhin kyis gnyid che ba dang / rgod bag can dang / khas bub tu nyal ba dang / nyal ba la rtag rngupa dang / lce 'byin pa dang / lce ldag pa dang / khro skyen pa dang / 'jems par 'dug pa dang / shas cher 'dug pa dang /khon du 'dzin pa de dag ni nye zhing ⑪dubs nye bar sbrul dag gi nang nas shi 'phos pa yin te/ sbrul dag gi ⑦nang nas shi 'phos pa rnams kyi rnam pa ni de dag yin no/ /mtshan ma ni de dag yin no/ /rtags ④ni de dag yin no/ /byi ba 78—1049

dag gi nang nas shi 'phos pa rnams kyi rnam pa ni gang dag yin/ mtshan ma ni gang dag yin rtags ni gang dag yin zhe na/ smras pa/ sems can gang dag shugs myur zhing mgyogs pa dang / spu ring ba dang / spu mang ba dang /gnod par (byed pa dang / 'tshe bar 3byed pa dang / khyim 'bigs pa dang /mun pa'i nang du dga' ba dang / kha zas myur ba myur bar za ba dang / kha zas nyung ngus kyang chog par 'dzin pa de ni zhi zhing du bas nye bar byi ba dag gi zhunang nas shi 'phos pa yin te/ byi ba dag gi nang nas shi 'phos pa rnams kyi rnam pa ni de dag yin no/ /mtshan ma ni de dag yin no/ /rtags ni de dag yin no/ /khyi dag gi nang nas shi 'phos pa rnams kyi rnam pa ni gang dag yin/mtshan ma ni gang dag yin/ rtags ni gang dag yin zhe na/ smras pa/sems can gang dag shugs myur zhing mgyogs pa dang / spu ring ba dang / spu mang ba dang / spu gshor ④ba dang / snying nye ba dang / zas la gdung ba ⑪dang / ngo mi shes pa la sdang dub de dag ni nye zhing dubs nye bar khyi dag gi nang nas shi 'phos pa yin te/ khye dag gi nang nas shi 'phos pa rnams kyi rnam pa ni de dag ma na no/ /mtshan ma ni de dag yin no/ /rtags ni de dag yin no//glang po che dag gi 3/nang nas shi 'phos pa rnams kyi rnam pa ni gang dag yin/mtshan ma ni gang dag yin/ rtags ni gang dag yin zhe na/ smras pa/sems can gang dag shugs myur zhing mgyogs pa dang / spu ring ba dang / spu mang ba dang / spu gshor ba dang / lus ring ba dang / che ba dang /stobs dang ldan pa dang / lto che ba dang / lus kyi mdog ngan pa dang / sna ring ba dang / zlan dupa 'bur ba dang / kha dog la dga' ba dang / rkang 78—1050

pa rlum pa dang / so drung mtho ba de dag ni nye zhing du bas nye bar rmye glang po che dag gi nang nas shi 'phos pa yin te/ glang po che dag gi nang nas shi 'phos pa rnams kyi rnam pa ni de dag yin no/ /mtshan ma ni de dag yin no/ /rtags ni de dag yin no/ /rta dag gi nang nas shi 'phos pa rnams kyi rnam pa ni gang dag yin—/ mtshan ma ni gang dag yin/ rtags ni gang dag yin zhe na/ smras pa/sems can gang dag shugs myur zhing mgyogs pa dang / spu ring ba dang / spu mang ba dang / sru gshor ba dang / rta skad 'byin pa dang / brgyan pa la dga' ba dang / nyon mongs pa'i shas che ba de dag ni nye zhing bye dubs nye bar rta dag gi nang nas shi 'phos pa yin te/ rta dag gi nang nas shi 'phos pa rnams kyi rnam pa ni de dag yin no/ /mtshan ma ni de dag yin no/ /rtags ni de dag yin no/ /rnga mo dag gi nang nas shi 'phos pa rnams kyi rnam pa ni gang dag yin/ mtshan ma ni gang dag yin/ rtags ni gang dag yin zhe na/smras pa/ sems can gang dag shugs myur zhing mgyogs pa dang / spu ring ba dang / spu mang ba dang / spu gshor ba dang / stobs che ba dang / skra ring ba dang / mchu 'phyang ba dang / mgrin pa gye gur 'dug pa de dag ni nye zhing dubs nye bar rnga mo dag gi nang nas shi 'phos pa yin te/ rnga mo dag gi nang nas shi 'phos pa rnams kyi rnam pa ni de dag yin no/ /mtshan ma ni de dag yin no—/ /rtags ni de dag yin no/ /ba lang dag gi khru nang nas shi 'phos pa rnams kyi rnam pa ni gang dag yin/ mtshan ma ni gang dag yin/ rtags ni gang dag yin zhe na/ smras pa/ sems can gang dag shugs myur zhing mgyogs pa dang / spu ring ba dang / spu mang ba dang / spu gshor ba dang /78—1051

lto che ba dang / stobs che ba dang / lu ba dang / zlos shing bldad pa byedang /mang du za ba dang / rwa'i sa 'bur ba de dag ni nye zhing dubs nye bar ba lang dag gi nang nas shi 'phos pa yin te/ ba lang dag gi nang nas shi 'phos pa rnams kyi rnam pa ni de dag yin no/ /mtshan ma ni de dag yin no/ /rtags ni de dag yin no/ /bong bu dag gi nang nas shi 'phos pa rnams kyi rnam pa ni gang dag yin/ mtshan ma ni gang dag yin/ rtags ni gang dag yin zhe na/smras pa/ sems can gang dag shugs myur zhing mgyogs pa dang / spu ring ba dang / spu mang ba dang / spu gshor ba dang / bum gsus por 'dug pa dang / sa rko ba dang / skad mi snyan pa dang / dung skad can dang / mi gtsang ba 'dam pa de dag ni nye zhing dubs nye bar bong bu dag gi nang nas shi 'phos pa yin te/ bong thu dag gi nang nas shi 'phos pa rnams kyi rnam pa ni de dag yin no/ /mtshan ma ni de dag yin no/ /rtags ni de dag yin no/ /ri dwags rnams kyi nang nas shi 'phos pa rnams kyi rnam pa ni gang dag yin/mtshan ma ni gang dag yin/ rtags ni gang dag yin zhe na/ smras pa/sems can gang dag shugs myur zhing mgyogs pa dang / sru ring ba dang / spu mang ba dang / sru gshor ba dang / 'jigs pa dang / bag tsha ba dang /sdang skyen pa dang / 'bros pa dang / dgon par dga' zhing der mngon par dga' ba de dag ni nye zhing dubs khrunye bar ri dwags dag gi nang nas shi 'phos pa yin te/ ri dwags rnams kyi nang nas shi 'phos pa rnams kyi rnam pa ni de dag yin no/ /mtshan ma ni de dag yin no/ /rtags ni de dag yin no/ /ra dag gi nang nas shi 'phos pa rnams kyi rnam pa ni gang dag yin/ mtshan ma ni 78—1052

gang dag yin/ rtags ni gang dag yin zhe na/ smras pa/ sems can gang dag shugs myur zhing mgyogs pa dang / spu ring ba dang / spu mang ba dang /spu gshor ba dang / shing 'cha' ba dang / yang bar rgyu ba dang / nyi ma la dga' ba dang / lhags pa la sdar ba de dag ni nye zhing dubs nye bar ra dag gi gyenang nas shi 'phos pa yin te/ ra dag gi ldunang nas shi 'phos pa rnams kyi rnam pa ni de dag yin no/ /mtshan ma ni de dag yin no/ /rtags ni de dag yin no/ /lug dag gi nang nas shi 'phos pa rnams kyi rnam pa ni gang dag yin/ mtshan ma ni gang dag yin/ rtags ni gang dag yin zhe na/ smras pa/ sems can gang dag shugs myur zhing mgyogs pa dang / spu ring ba dang / sru mang ba dang / spu 'jam pa dang / rmongs tsartul ba dang / sa rdul glong bar byed pa dang / mgo 'phang smad dze+ede 'gro ba dang / snabs khyemang ba dang / mi gtsang ba kun du spyod pa de dag ni nye zhing dubs nye bar lug gi ⑥nang nas shi 'phos pa yin te/ lug gi nang nas shi 'phos pa rnams kyi rnam pa ni de dag yin no/ /mtshan ma ni de dag yin no/ /rtags ni de dag yin no/ /khwa dag gi nang nas shi 'phos pa rnams kyi rnam pa ni gang dag yin/ mtshan ma ni gang dag yin/ rtags ni gang dag yin zhe na/ smras pa/ sems can gang dag gcam bu dang / mu cor smra ba dang / spyi rtol ④can dang / snying ring ④ba dang / byas pa mi gzo /spub dang / snying rje med pa dang / dgang dka' ba dang / ma byin par len pa dang / stsogs ⑫'jog byed pa dang / ca co can de dag ni nye zhing dubs nye bar khwa dag gi nang nas shi 'phos pa yin te/ khwa dag gi nang nas shi 'phos pa rnams kyi rnam pa ni de dag yin no/ /mtshan ma ni 78—1053

de dag yin no/ /rtags ni de dag yin no/ /chos mngon pa'i bstan bcos chen po rgyu gdags pa las tshigs bcu bdun pa'o // //①sdom ni/ phag dang spre'u zhudom rnams dang / /ce 1spyang spyang ki 'phar ba dred/ /gung dang stag dang seng ge dang / /klu dang de bzhin dri za dang / /yi dwags dang ni mi rnams dang / /lha rnams tshigs kyi sdom du byas/ /phag dag gi nang nas shi 'phos pa rnams kyi rnam pa ni gang dag yin/ mtshan ma ni gang dag yin/ rtags ni gang dag yin zhe na/ smras pa/ sems can gang dag shugs myur zhing mgyogs pa dang / spu ring ba dang / spu mang ba dang /spu gshor ba dang / bum gsus ④ por 'dug pa dang / gdong ring ba dang /sna 'khor lo ltar 'dug pa dang / sa rdul gyi nang du 'dre ba dang / ngan pa za ba dang / mi gtsang ba kun du spyod pa dang / so drung mtho ba de dag ni nye zhing dubs nye bar phag gi nang nas shi 'phos pa yin te/ phag dag gi nang nas shi 'phos pa rnams kyi rnam pa ni de dag yin no/ /mtshan ma ni de dag yin no/ /rtags ni de dag yin no/ /spre'u dag gi nang nas shi 'phos pa rnams kyi rnam pa ni gang dag yin/ mtshan ma ni gang dag yin/ rtags ni gang dag yin zhe na/smras pa/ sems can gang dag shugs myur zhing mgyogs pa dang / spu ring ba dang / spu mang ba dang / spu 'jam pa dang / spre'u 'dra ba dang / dmar ser du 'dug pa dang / shing la dga' ba dang / shing tog la dga' ba dang /'dzeg pa la dga' ba dang / shing la 'dzeg pa dang / 'dzegs nas kyang 'dzeg pa la yun ring ba dang / thams cad du yang mal gcig la ⑤mi 'dug 78—1054

pa de dag ni nye zhing dubs lku nye bar spre'u dag gi nang nas shi 'phos pa yin te/spre'u dag gi nang nas shi 'phos pa rnams kyi rnam pa ni de dag yin no/ /mtshan ma ni de dag yin no/ /rtags ni de dag yin no/ /dom dag gi nang nas shi 'phos pa rnams kyi rnam pa ni gang dag yin/ mtshan ma ni gang dag yin/rtags ni gang dag yin zhe na/ smras pa/ sems can gang dag shugs myur zhing mgyogs pa dang / spu ring ba dang / spu mang ba dang / spu gshor 3ba dang / ngam sdur da/can dang / tug rid can dang / lus 'gul ba dang /du ba dang / shing la dga' ba dang / shing tog la dga' ba dang / 'dzeg pa la dga' ba dang ④/ de dag ni nye zhing dubs nye bar dom dag gi nang nas shi 'phos pa yin te/ dom dag gi nang nas shi 'phos pa rnams kyi rnam pa ni de dag yin no/ /mtshan ma ni de dag yin no/ /rtags ni de dag yin no/ /ce ye spyang dag gi nang nas shi 'phos pa rnams kyi rnam pa ni gang dag yin/ mtshan ma ni gang dag yin/ rtags ni gang dag yin zhe na/ smras pa/ sems can gang dag shugs myur zhing mgyogs pa dang / spu ring ba dang / spu mang ba dang / spu gshor ba dang / g.yo byed pa dang / g.yo can dang / sgyu can dang / dbyen ⑥byed pa dang / mtshang 'dru peb dang / spyod yul spen pa de dag ni nye zhing dubs nye bar ce ( ༷spyang dag gi nang nas shi 'phos pa yin te/ce 1 spyang dag gi nang nas shi 'phos pa rnams kyi rnam pa ni de dag yin no//mtshan ma ni de dag yin no/ /rtags ni de dag yin no/ /spyang ki dag gi nang nas shi 'phos pa rnams kyi rnam pa ni gang dag yin/ mtshan ma ni gang dag yin⑫/rtags ni gang dag yin zhe na/ smras pa/ sems can gang dag shugs myur 78—1055

zhing mgyogs pa dang / sru ring ba dang / spu mang ba dang / spu gshor ba dang / gcam pa ⑫dang / mu cor smra ba dang / spyi brtol byeche ba dang /snying brtse ba med pa dang / snying rje med pa dang / snying ring ba dang / byas pa mi gzo ba dang / sha khrag za zhing 'thung ba de dag ni nye zhing dubs nye bar spyang ki dag gi nang nas shi 'phos pa yin te/ spyang ki dag gi nang nas shi 'phos pa rnams kyi rnam pa ni de dag yin no/ /mtshan ma ni de dag yin no/ /rtags ni de dag yin no/ /spyang ki ji lta ba bzhin du 'phar ba dang / dred dang / gung rnams kyang de dang 'dra bar sbyar ro/ /stag dag gi nang nas shi 'phos pa rnams kyi rnam pa ni gang dag yin/ mtshan ma ni gang dag yin/rtags ni gang dag yin zhe na/ smras pa/ sems can gang dag shugs myur zhing mgyogs pa dang / sru ring ba dang / sru mang ba dang / spu gshor ba dang / dpa' ba dang / gtum pa dang / rtsal che ba dang / gcam pa rngo dang / mu cor smra ba dang / spyi brtol ④che ba dang / snying brtse ba med pa dang /snying rje med pa dang / snying ring ba dang / byas pa mi gzo ba dang / sha khrag za zhing 'thung ba de dag ni nye zhing dubs nye bar stag dag gi nang nas shi 'phos pa yin te/ stag dag gi nang nas shi 'phos pa rnams kyi rnam pa ni de dag yin no / /mtshan ma ni de dag yin no/ /rtags ni de dag yin no/ /seng ge dag gi nang nas shi 'phos pa rnams kyi rnam pa ni gang dag yin/ mtshan ma ni gang dag yin/ rtags ni gang dag yin zhe na/ smras pa/ sems can gang dag shugs myur shing khyemagyogs pa dang / spu ring ba dang / spu mang ba dang /spu gshor ba dang / dpa' ba dang / gtum pa dang / stobs che ba dang /78—1056

snying brtse ba med pa dang / snying rje ba med pa dang / sha khrag za zhing 'thung ba dang / sar pa za ba de dag ni nye zhing dubs nye bar seng ge dag gi nang nas shi 'phos pa yin te/ seng ge dag gi nang nas shi 'phos pa rnams kyi rnam pa ni de dag yin no/ /mtshan ma ni de dag yin no/ /rtags ni de dag yin no/ /klu dag gi nang nas shi 'phos pa rnams kyi rnam pa ni gang dag yin/ mtshan ma ni gang dag yin/ rtags ni gang dag yin zhe na/ smras pa/ sems can gang dag shugs myur zhing mgyogs pa dang / rang bzhin gyis 1gnyid che ba dang /khas bub tu nyal ba dang / nyal ba la rtag pa dang / chu la dga' ba dang /ser sna che ba dang / yo byad rnams kun tu 'dzin pa dang / mi ster ba'i rang bzhin can 'ude dag ni nye zhing dubs nye bar klu dag gi nang nas shi 'phos pa yin te / klu dag gi nang nas shi 'phos pa rnams kyi rnam pa ni de dag yin no/ /mtshan ma ni de dag yin no/ /rtags ni de dag yin no/ /dri za dag gi nang nas shi 'phos pa rnams kyi rnam pa ni gang dag yin/ mtshan ma ni gang dag yin/rtags ni gang dag yin zhe na/ smras pa/ sems can gang dag gzugs bzang zhing blta na sdug la mdzes pa dang / rol mo la sred pa dang / sil snyan dang / pheg rdob pa la spyod pa dang / rtsed mo la sred pa dang / dga' dgur spyod pa la sred pa de dag ni nye zhing dubs nye bar dri za dag gi nang nas shi 'phos pa yin te/ dri za dag gi nang nas shi 'phos pa rnams kyi rnam pa ni de dag yin no/ /mtshan ma ni de dag yin no/ /rtags ni de dag yin no/ /yi dwags dag gi rngu nang nas shi 'phos pa rnams kyi rnam pa ni gang dag yin/mtshan ma ni gang dag yin/ rtags ni gang dag yin zhe na/ smras pa/78—1057

sems can gang dag skem pa dang / ngan pa la dga' ba dang / mdog ngan pa dang / gsus pa che ba dang / phra ma zer ba dang / ser sna che ba dang /'jungs pa dang / yo byad rnams kun tu 'dzin pa dang / lag gis ①kha zas rul bar byed pa dang / kha zas mang pos kyang mi 'grangs ④pa de dag ni nye zhing dubs nye bar yi dwags dag kyegi nang nas shi 'phos pa yin te/ yi dwags dag gi nang nas shi 'phos pa rnams kyi rnam pa ni de dag yin no/ /mtshan ma ni de dag yin no/ /rtags ni de dag yin no/ /mi dag gi nang nas shi 'phos pa rnams kyi rnam pa ni gang dag yin/ mtshan ma ni gang dag yin/ rtags ni gang dag yin zhe na/ smras pa/ sems can gang dag las la sred pa dang /bzo la sred pa dang / thabs shes pa dang / pha ma la gus pa dang / srid ④zhu che ba dang / rtog 'apa'i rang bzhin can dang / dge ba gang yin pa tshol yob de dag ni nye zhing dubs nye bar mi dag gi nang nas shi 'phos pa yin te/ mi dag gi nang nas shi 'phos pa rnams kyi rnam pa ni de dag yin no/ /mtshan ma ni de dag yin no/ /rtags ni de dag yin no/ /lha dag gi nang nas shi 'phos pa rnams kyi rnam pa ni gang dag yin/ mtshan ma ni gang dag yin/ rtags ni gang dag yin zhe na/ smras pa/ sems can gang dag gzugs bzang zhing blta na sdug la mdzes pa dang / kha na ma tho ba med pa dang / bden par grusmra ba de dag ni nye zhing dubs nye bar lha dag gi nang nas shi 'phos pa yin te/ lha dag gi nang nas shi 'phos pa rnams kyi rnam pa ni de dag yin no/ /mtshan ma ni de dag yin no/ /rtags ni de dag yin no/ /de rnams dang lus thob pa gzhan dag kyang rtogs bapar byas nas gzhi ji lta ba bzhin du brjod par bya ste/78—1058

yi ge mangs su dogs ①pa'i phyir ma smos so/ /chos mngon pa'i bstan bcos chen po rgyu gdags pa las tshigs bco brgyad pa'o // //byesdom ni/ shing bzhin dang ni lo mar bcas/ /ras bal dgun ldudang gye dgu ④ dang / /de bzhin drang po phyogs gcig ④dang / /'byung bcas 'di ni tshigs mtha' rdzogs/ /ci'i phyir 'dzam bu'i ⑥ gling pa'i shing thams cad kyi nang nas ⑦ shing 'dzam bu de dag gi mchog ces bya zhe na/ smras pa/ 'jig rten 'chags pa'i tshe khams kyi mchog dang / snying po'i mchog dang / bzang po'i mchog dang /④ zong gi mchog sa/nga yin pa de phyogs der rlung gis bsdus nas de las de grub par 'gyur zute/ rgyu des na 'dzam bu'i ⑪ gling gi shing thams cad kyi nang nas shing 'dzam bu de dag gi mchog ces bya'o/ /ci'i phyir rgya mtsho'i 'gram gyi shing thams cad kyi nang nas ⑪shing shal ma li mthon po ⑫de dag gi mchog ces bya zhe na/ smras pa/ 'jig rten 'chags pa'i tshe khams kyi mchog dang / snying po'i mchog dang / bzang po'i mchog dang / zong gi mchog gang yin pa de phyogs der rlung gis bsdus nas de las de grub par 'gyur zhete—/ rgyu des na rgya mtsho'i 'gram gyi shing thams cad kyi nang nas shing shal ma li mthon po de dag gi mchog ces bya'o/ /ci'i phyir lha ma yin gyi ris kyi shing thams cad kyi nang nas ⑩shing pa ta li sna tshogs can de dag gi mchog ces bya zhe na/smras pa/ 'jig ⑫rten 'chags pa'i tshe khams kyi mchog dang / snying po'i mchog dang / bzang po'i mchog dang / zong gi mchog gang yin pa de phyogs der rlung dag gis bsdus nas de las de grub par 'gyur ⑫te/ rgyu des na lha ma 78—1059

yin gyi ris kyi tshishing thams cad kyi nang na shing pa ta li sna tshogs can de dag gi mchog ces bya'o/ /ci'i phyir sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i shing thams cad kyi nang nas/shing yongs 'du sa brtol ldude dag gi mchog ces bya zhe na/ smras pa/ 'jig rten 'chags 3pa'i tshe khams kyi mchog dang / snying po'i mchog dang / bzang po'i mchog dang / zong gi mchog gang yin pa de phyogs der rlung gis bsdus nas de las de ④grub par gyur te/ rgyu des na sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i shing thams cad kyi nang na shing yongs 'du sa brtol de dag gi mchog ces bya'o/ /ci'i phyir so ga dang dbyar shing kha cig lo ma yod pa dang / me tog yod pa dang /'bras bu yod par 'gyur khrul/ shing kha cig ni lo ma med pa dang / me tog med pa dang / 'bras bu med par 'gyur zhe na/ smras pa/ zla ba drug nyi ma byang phyogs na 'dug ste byang phyogs na 'dug pa na dpag tshad bzhi khri nas nyi ma'i 'od zer rnams byung nas gling rnams su 'bab ste/ de nas rgya mtsho chen po'i chu bsil bar 'gyur la/ chu bsel ba de yang gling rnams kyi nang du 'gro ste/shing gang dag chu bsel ba des bde bar skye bar 'gyur ba'i shing de dag ni lo ma yod pa dang / me tog yod pa dang / 'bras bu yod par 'gyur ⑥la shing gang dag chu bsil ba des bde bar skye bar mi 'gyur ba de dag ni lo ma med pa dang /me tog med pa dang / 'bras bu med par 'gyur te/ rgyu des na so ga dang dbyar shing kha cig la lo ma yod pa dang / me tog yod pa dang / 'bras bu yod par 'gyur la/ shing kha cig ni lo ma med pa dang / me tog med pa dang /'bras bu med par 'gyur ro/ /ci'i phyir dgun shing kha cig lo ma yod pa dang /me tog yod pa dang / 'bras bu yod par 'gyur la/ shing kha cig ni lo ma 78—1060
